descricao: Ossa pneumatica (skeleton axiale et/aut appendiculare), typically evidenced by foramina et/aut pori pneumatica, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, of limited anatomical distribution (1);  present, of comparatively wide anatomical distribution, and ``simple'' (camerate) form (2);  present, encompassing all three major skeletal regions (below), and ``complex'' (camellate) form, including presence of presumptively plesiomorphic complex of ``Haversian canals'' (3);  present, encompassing all three major skeletal regions (below), and ``complex'' (camellate) form, but excluding presence of presumptively plesiomorphic complex of ``Haversian canals.'' (4).

Skeleton appendiculare, ossa longa, densitas et status histologica ossium (ordered)  : high, primary pachyostosis scaling with body mass (0);  low, nonpachyostotic, aerodynamic (1);  moderate, secondary pachyostosis associated with graviportality, burgeoned body mass, and (typically) secondary flightlessness (2).

Platycalvaria (new term)---dorsum cranii conspicuously flattened---status  : absent, associated with bilateral width being less than dorsoventral depth (0);  present, associated with bilateral width exceeding dorsoventral depth (1).

Pneumaticas cranii (new term)---cranial pneumatization, especially basis cranii, ossa basisphenoidales, as substantiated by ossa spongiosum of calvaria (planum transversus) and features of externum (e.g., fonticulae, fenestrae, et foramina) and (typically) ventral expansion---status (ordered)  : limited (0);  moderate (1);  substantial (2).

Regio ossium frontales et parietales (frons), pronounced thickening produced by multi-layered cellulae pneumaticae (os spongiosum), status  : absent, including thickening caused by undirected, densely spiculate bone (0);  present (1).

Depressio frontalis, status  : present, variably detectable at some point on midline of ossa frontales (0);  absent, both from planum interorbitalis and calvaria, resulting in region being variably convex (1).
Fossa musculorum temporalium, extension medially to closely approach on midline (typically of comparatively great depth), status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Lamina parasphenoidalis, ala parasphenoidalis, tectum tympanicum parasphenoidalis (new term), characterized in part by dorsolateral, subtriangular fossa musculorum, enclosing the recessi tympanici et cotylae quadratici squamosum et otici, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Condylus occipitalis (caudal perspective, planum transversus occipitalis), forma modalis  : essentially circular (0);  distinctly bilobate or reniform, lobae partitioned by incisura mediana condyli, lateromedially elongate (1).

Condylus occipitalis, collum condyli occipitalis (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent, essentially sessile condylus of less than hemiglobular form (0);  rudimentary, basis condylaris subcylindrical with diameter equal to or slightly less than that of condylus proprius (1);  present, condylus comparatively prominent, and variably subpedicellate or (sub)umbelliform with basis having (often slightly) smaller diameter than condylus proprius, aspect subglobular (2).
Condylus occipitalis, rostrocaudal position relative to os exoccipitale, processus paroccipitalis, forma  : rostral (0);  approximately equal or caudal (1).

Condylus occipitalis et foramen magnum, angulus (lateral perspective) between planae foraminis et basis cranii---e.g., lamina parasphenoidalis (ba sitemporalis) et especially palatum osseum---i.e., comparative dorsoventral position of articulatio craniovertebralis, forma  : articulatio comparatively ventral, angulus ``sharp,'' sur(supra)diagonal (> 45Â°), often approaching perpendicularity (0);  articulatio comparatively dorsal, angulus ``shallow,'' subdiagonal (< 45Â°), often approaching coplanarity (1).

Foramen magnum, pronounced ventrorostral shift placing occiput co-planar with palatum osseum, with associated changes in relative positions of lamina basiparasphenoidalis, foramen magnum, and basis cranii interna, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Foramen magnum, forma modalis sensu lobation  : unilobate, circular, oblong, or elliptical (0);  distinctly bilobate, with dorsal, lesser lobus having rounded margo dorsalis (1).

Prominentia cerebellaris, marked, abrupt caudal extension---extending caudad to crista (linea) nuchalis transversa---and conformation as smooth, rounded, subglobular bulla lacking distinguishable linea aut carina medialis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Crista (linea) nuchalis transversa (largely ossa supraoccipitales), status  : present and pronounced (0);  indistinct or absent (1).

Crista (linea) nuchalis transversa, caudal deviation on midline of cranium onto caudally promi nent, rounded, ventrally concave, lamina medialis nuchalis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Cristae laminae externae cranii---elongate, concave, triangular lamina bordered by cristae (i) nuchalis transvera, (ii) nuchalis lateralis, (iii) otica dorsalis, et (iv) post zygomatica, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Lamina externae cranii---broad, concave, triangular lamina bordered by cristae (i) nuchalis lateralis, (ii) otica dorsalis, et (iii) m. depressor mandibulae, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Fossa cranii rostralis, fossa tecti mesencephali, and canalis semicircularis anterior, forma  : triangular (0);  approximately linearly aligned, the axis of alignment almost perpendicular to planum of palate (1).

Fossa cranii rostralis (internal perspective), forma  : comparatively narrow lateromedially, essentially ovate, with rostrolateral paries not markedly convex (0);  comparatively broad lateromedially, distinctly kidney-shaped, with rostrolateral paries markedly convex (1).
Fossa cranii rostralis, caudal expansion lateral to canalis semicircularis (anterior) rostralis (new term), status  : absent, fossa rostral (0);  present, fossa caudal (1).

Fossa cranii rostralis, foramen nervorum olfactorii, status  : absent, n. olfactorii passing internally within the interorbital region of skull, medial to paries medialis orbitae and paries dorsalis orbitae, and ventral to os frontale (0);  present, n. olfactorii passing at least in part lateral to paries medialis orbitae (1).

Fossa cranii media, fossa tecti mesencephali (fossa ganglii trigemini or membrane-covered spatium directly ventral to it; dissection required), canalis nervus maxillomandibularis, length between crista marginalis tecti caudalis (new term) and foramen nervus maxillomandibularis relative to diameter of latter foramen  : long, exceeding (usually markedly) diameter (0);  short, approximating diameter (1).

Fossa cranii media, fossa tecti mesencephali (fossa ganglii trigemini or membrane-covered spatium directly ventral), canalis nervus maxillomandibularis, foramen nervus maxillomandibularis to foramen nervi ophthalmici, situs externus  : adjacent but narrowly partitioned by pila ossea, or confluent (0);  well separated by lamina ossea (1);  State 2 (2).
Foramen nervi maxillomandibularis, division by osseus partition into separate foramina for nervi maxillaris et mandibularis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Foramen nervi maxillomandibularis, situs rostrocaudalis relative to os parasphenoidale, lamina parasphenoidalis, ala parasphenoidalis, or homologous lamina (if present)  : rostral (0);  caudal, coincident with prominently developed ala parasphenoidalis and hiatus subtympanicus (1).

Fossa cranii media, fossa tecti mesencephali, situs relative to fossa cranii rostralis and associated orientation of separating crista tentorialis  : ventral or caudoventral, crista obliquely sloping relative to planum palatum (0);  essentially caudal, crista almost perpendicular to planum palatum (1).

Fossa cranii media, fossa tecti mesencephali, crista tentorialis, extreme medial prominence, associated with solum of fossa cranii rostralis as discoid, dorsally concave lamina, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Fossa cranii media, fossa tecti mesencephali, crista tentorialis, junctura with fossa cerebelli, crista marginalis cerebelli, position relative to canalis semicircularis anterior  : along rostro-dorsal margo of canalis (0);  dorsal to canalis, with distinct segment of crista marginalis between canalis and junctura cristae (1).
Fossa cranii caudalis, foramen magnum, prominent, bilateral, rostromedially oriented tuberculae on margines laterales foraminis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Fossa cranii media, fossa tecti mesencephali, caudal expansion lateral to canalis semicircularis anterior, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Fossa cerebelli, sulcus venus semicircularis, osseus medial lamina, status  : present, sulcus enclosed at least at junctura with crista tecti caudalis (0);  absent, but sulcus may be narrow or constricted at junctura with crista tecti caudalis (1).
Fossa cerebelli, sulcus venus semicircularis, inclusion of dorsolateral portion on solum of fossa cranii rostralis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Fossa cerebelli, vertex (junctura) cristae marginalis cerebelli (new term), marginis tecti caudalis et tentorialis, forma  : simple intersection of cristae without prominent tubercular development (0);  prominent, triangular-based, typically blunt tuberculum or eminentia immediately rostro-dorsal to canalis semicircularis anterior, and visible through foramen magnum of intact crania (1).
Tuberculum pineale, status  : absent (0);  present, extending ventrad to cristae internae (1).

Os basioccipitale, fovea ganglii vagoglossopharyngealis, foramina externa, numerus modalis  : one, gangliae nervorum cranii IX and X sharing common foramen (0);  two, gangliae nervorum cranii IX and X having separate foramina (1).

Os exoccipitale, fossa parabasalis, ostium canalis (afferens) carotici, foramen (foramina) for arteriae carotis communis, numerus modalis  : two foramina, arteriae enter separately (0);  single foramen, arteriae enter together (1).

Os exoccipitale (lamina externa cranii, occiput), foramen magnum, marked dorsal intrusion by condylus occipitalis (ossa basioccipitale et exoccipitales, processes condylares) into margo ventralis foraminis at midline, effecting inverted cordiform outline of foramen (caudal perspective), status  : absent (0);  present. Os Supraoccipitale (1).

Os supraoccipitale, facies nuchalis (facies articularis ossis nuchale, where present), relative to that of condylus occipitalis---composed of os basioccipitale medioventrally and exoccipitales dorsolaterally--- situs rostrocaudalis  : caudal (0);  rostral or equal (1).
Os supraoccipitale, fonticulus occipitalis (typically closed by membrana in vivo, may admit vena occipitalis externa peripherally), status definitivum  : absent (0);  present (1).

Os supraoccipitale, foramen efferens vena occipitalis externa, status et situs  : present, bilateral (0);  absent, venae occipitales interna et externa confluent and exiting cavum cranii as unified vena occipitalis communis through intervallum atlanticooccipitalis (1).

Os laterosphenoidale, facies orbitalis, processus postorbitalis, incorporation of os frontale in processus proprius, status  : present, processus primarily or entirely derived from os frontale (0);  absent or limited to minor dorsal flange at base of processus (1);  noncomparable by absence of processus postorbitalis (Apteryx, Phodilus, Strix, Steatornis, Nyctibius, Podargidae, Aegothelidae) or lack of juveniles (Phalacrocorax) (2).

Os laterosphenoidale, facies orbitalis, processus postorbitalis, orientation relative to margo dorsalis (lateral view) orbitae (ordered)  : diagonal to perpendicular, angulus 45Â°--90Â° (0);  obliquely rostral, angulus subdiagonal (< 45Â°) (1);  noncomparable, processus lacking (Apteryx, Anhingidae, Phalacrocoracidae) (2).

Os laterosphenoidale, facies orbitalis, processus postorbitalis (if present), lateromedially broad and rostrocaudally compressed, forming variably extensive, rostrally concave, paries caudalis orbitae, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable, processus lacking (Apteryx, Phalacrocoracidae) (2).

Os laterosphenoidale, facies orbitalis, processus postorbitalis (if present), tendines et/aut aponeuroses ossificantes from terminus processi toward arcus jugalis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable, processus lacking (Apteryx, Phalacrocoracidae) (2).

Os laterosphenoidale, facies orbitalis, processus postorbitalis (if present), synostosis with os exoccipitale, closely caudal to processus zygomaticus, by rostrocaudally oriented, densely ossified arcus parameaticus (new term) possessing ventrally directed tuberculum at approximate midpoint, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Os laterosphenoidale, facies tecti mesencephali, sulcus nervus ophthalmici, dorsal closure by osseus lamina, status principalis  : present, closure by variably extensive pons separated from foramen n. ophthalmici by sulcus or forming a cuniculus continuous from foramen n. ophthalmici for a significant distance caudomediad (0);  absent, sulcus completely exposed (open) from foramen inward or closure limited to short arcus on facies internum foraminis n. ophthalmici (1).

Ossa laterosphenoidale et proÃ¶tica, facies lateralis, fonticulus laterospheno-proÃ¶tica (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, a distinct fonticulus dorsocaudal to foramen nervi maxillomandibularis and at least approximating latter in diameter (1).

Os basisphenoidale, facies cerebralis, sella turcica, angulus with respect to solum cranii, approximated by axis majoris sellae aut dorsum sellae  : essentially perpendicular to the planum of rostrum parasphenoidalis, enclosing a vertically oriented fossa hypophysialis (0);  defining a shallow, acute angulus with the planum of rostrum parasphenoidalis, approaching horizontality, with solum fossae hypophysialis well caudoventral to the cranial margin of dorsum sellae. Os Parasphenoidale (1).

Os parasphenoidale, rostrum parasphenoidale--- extension caudad to include lamina basisphenoidalis, facies ventralis---medial carina parasphenoidalis (new term) defined by depressiones bilaterales, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Os parasphenoidale, rostrum parasphenoidale, terminus of semicylindrical portion, rostral extent relative to those of orbita et septum nasi osseum, forma  : former caudal to margo rostralis orbitae (0);  former well rostral to orbita and contributing to margo ventralis of septum nasi osseum (1).
Processus basipterygoideus, principal orientation with respect to rostrum parasphenoidale, forma  : rostroventral (0);  lateroventral (1);  ventrolateral (2).

Processus basipterygoideus, facies articularis pterygobasipterygoideus, primary dorsoventral component of orientation of planum faciei, forma  : ventrolateral (0);  dorsolateral. See (1);  A. Clarke (2004: appendix 1, character 22) (2).

Os parasphenoidale, lamina parasphenoidalis (basisphenoidalis), rostral portion extensive and completely free of overlying bone (presumed to be os basisphenoidale), and underlying a dorsal spatium, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Os parasphenoidale, lamina parasphenoidalis (basisphenoidalis), forma  : flat, laminar, and neither distinctly pneumatic nor broad (0);  rounded, ``inflated,'' and broad (1).

Os parasphenoidale, lamina parasphenoidalis, ala parasphenoidalis, continuity as broad, slightly concave, sloping planum with os exoccipitale, processus paroccipitalis, and demarcated medially by conspicuous carina from lamina basiparasphenoidalis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Os parasphenoidale, processus lateralis parasphenoidalis, anulus tympanicus, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Os parasphenoidale, lamina parasphenoidalis, tuberculum basilare, processus medialis parasphenoidalis, status  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, distinct (1).

Processus paroccipitalis, pronounced ventral enlargement and lateral broadening processi, with margo lateralis of processus rounded or truncate, forming continuous and curving with margo dorsalis of processus zygomaticus, and defining margo lateralis of meatus acusticus externus, status  : present (0);  absent (1).

Processus paroccipitalis et lamina parasphenoidalis, margo(ines) ventrolateralis, forma  : separated by incisura marginalis, facies ventralis of processus paroccipitalis comparatively proximate to fossa parabasalis (0);  comparatively extensive laterocaudad and without incisura marginalis, resulting in caudolateral expanse of lamina between processus paroccipitalis and fossa parabasalis and comparatively deep solum ventralis of ostium recessi pneumatici rostralis (1).

Processus paroccipitalis, terminalis processi, forma sensu orientation (ordered)  : laterally or dorsally inflected (0);  ventrolaterally deflected to variable, moderate degree (1);  strongly ventrolateral, terminus entirely ventral to foramen magnum (2);  essentially caudal (3).

Processus suprameaticus, status  : absent as distinct processus, in most or all cases the homologous bone evidently continuous as margo rostralis of meatus acusticus externus (0);  present as variably prominent processus, distinctly smaller than processus postorbitalis (1).

Margo ventralis squamosi---comprising lamina supra-zygomatica (new term) et processus zygomaticus--- elongation, dorsoventral depth, and concealment (lateral perspective) of processus oticus quadrati, status  : absent, margo ventralis of os squamosum truncate and narrow, not obscuring os quadratum (0);  present, margo ventralis of os squamosum elongate and broad, obscuring os quadratum (1).

Processus zygomaticus, crista ventralis (new term), pronounced dorsolateral orientation and tuberculate shape---``pinnaform'' aspect relative to cranium--- status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae). Cotylae quadratica squamosi et otici (2).

Cotylae within planum normal to that of lamina basiparasphenoidalis, positions as measured by lateral (lesser) angulus defined by axis passing through centers of two cotylae relative to planum laminae basiparasphenoidalis  : axis obliquely oriented---i.e., having significant dorsal component in rostrocaudal perspective--- angulus > 20Â° (0);  axis nearly parallel---i.e., transverse in rostrocaudal perspective---angulus < or = 20Â° (1).
Cotyla quadratica otici, foramen pneumaticum magnum, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Cotyla quadratica otici, jugamentum ossificans from margo caudolateralis cotylae quadratica squamosi along crista tympanica quadrati to ala parasphenoidalis, status  : absent (0);  present, ranging from incomplete jugamentum or series of ossa sesamoidea to a complete arcus osseus (1).
Canalis semicircularis anterior, dorsal segment exposed in ventral surface of fossa cranii rostralis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Canalis semicircularis anterior, caudodorsal extent relative to foramen magnum  : dorsolateral, canales well separated bilaterally (0);  essentially dorsal, canales closely approaching each other on midline and typically projecting comparatively prominently into calvaria (1).
Canalis semicircularis lateralis, exposure in solum ventralis fossae cranii rostralis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, moderately prominent. Os Parietale (1).

Os prefrontale, facies dorsalis, status et forma (ordered)  : present, preorbital (laterodorsal) exposure substantial to extent at least that of os lacrimale, with processus ventralis (0);  present, greatly reduced or vestigial in preorbital expanse and processus ventralis (1);  absent or indiscernable (2).

Os frontale, facies cerebralis, crista vallecularis, vertex with crista frontalis interna, situs relative to terminus rostralis fossae cranii rostralis  : essentially coincident (0);  well caudal (1);  noncomparable by absent vertex (ratites, Dromornithiformes) (2).
Os frontale, facies dorsalis, bilaterally compressed, marginally rounded carina ossea (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Os frontale, facies orbitalis, impressio glandula nasalis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Os frontale, facies orbitalis, margo supraorbitalis, variably prominent, rounded, highly pneumatic, hornlike processus supraocularis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Os frontale, facies orbitalis, margo supraorbitalis, prominent, lateroventrally oriented angulus postocularis (new term), delimiting a crescentiform lacuna rostral to processus postorbitalis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable by absence of processus (Apterygidae, Anhingidae, Phalacrocoracidae) (2).
Ossa frontale et lacrimale, impressio glandula nasalis rostral margo caudalis ossis lacrimale, processus supraorbitalis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Os mesethmoidale, lamina dorsalis, dorsomedial exposure between ossa premaxillares, processes frontales, ossa nasales, processes premaxillares, and ossa frontales, status definitivum  : absent (0);  present (1).

Os lacrimale, tumulus pneumaticus (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, conspicuous (1);  noncomparable by absence of os lacrimale or part(s) thereof (Podargus, Aegotheles, Hemiprocne, Glaucis, Momotus, most Coraciiformes, Pitta, some oscine Passeriformes) (2).

Os lacrimale, processus orbitalis--- curvatura, incisura, aut foramen ducti nasolacrimalis--- forma  : rudimentary or obsolete, as weakly defined curvatura medialis processi orbitalis ducti (0);  distinct, as incisura semicircularis ducti nasolacrimalis (typically with apices dorsal and ventral to hiatus subforaminis) aut foramen ducti nasolacrimalis (latter evidently derived from incisura by ossification of arcus lateralis ostiae ducti) (1);  noncomparable by absence of os lacrimale or part(s) thereof (Podargus, Aegotheles, Hemiprocne, Glaucis, Momotus, most Coraciiformes, Pitta, some oscine Passeriformes) (2).

Os lacrimale, processus orbitalis, lamina medialis (new term), perforatio laminae obliquus (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable by absence of os lacrimale or part(s) thereof (Podargus, Aegotheles, Hemiprocne, Glaucis, Momotus, most Coraciiformes, Pitta, some oscines) (2).

Os lacrimale, processus orbitalis, recessus et/aut foramina/pori pneumaticus, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable by absence of os lacrimale or part(s) thereof (Podargus, Aegotheles, Hemiprocne, Glaucis, Momotus, most Coraciiformes, Pitta, some oscine Passeriformes) (2).

Os lacrimale, processus orbitalis, extentio rostralis, status et forma (ordered)  : significantly less extensive ventrally than orbita, typically failing to extend to margo ventralis orbitae (0);  not extending ventrolaterally beyond junctura lacrimo-ectethmoidalis (if present) or homologous point, not approaching arcus jugalis (1);  extending ventrolaterally beyond junctura lacrimo- ectethmoidalis (if present) or homologous point, typically approaching arcus jugalis (2);  as deep as orbita, typically articulating with arcus jugalis at margo ventralis orbitae (3);  noncomparable by absence of os lacrimale or processus orbitalis (Megapodiidae, Podargus, Aegotheles, Hemiprocne, Glaucis, Momotus, most Coraciiformes, Pitta, some oscine Passeriformes) (4).

Os lacrimale, processus orbitalis, angulus medialis et terminus acuminatus (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, pronounced (1);  noncomparable (Megapodiidae, Podargus, Aegotheles, Hemiprocne, Glaucis, Momotus, most Coraciiformes, Pitta, some oscine Passeriformes) (2).

Os lacrimale, processus orbitalis, terminus ventralis, sulcus articularis jugalis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Megapodiidae, Podargus, Aegotheles, Hemiprocne, Glaucis, Momotus, most Coraciiformes, Pitta, some oscine Passeriformes) (2).

Os lacrimale, processus supraorbitalis et corpus lacrimalis (new term), facies dorsalis, elongation (dorsal perspective), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Podargus, Aegotheles, Hemiprocne, Glaucis, Momotus, most Coraciiformes, Pitta, some oscine Passeriformes) (2).

Os lacrimale, processus supraorbitalis, caudolateral elongation of at least one-half of margo dorsalis orbitae, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Podargus, Aegotheles, Hemiprocne, Glaucis, Momotus, most Coraciiformes, Pitta, some oscine Passeriformes) (2).
Sutura interparietalis, rostrocaudal foreshortening associated with pronounced narrowing of ossa parietales, status  : absent (0);  present, distinct (1).
Sutura frontoparietalis, status  : discernable in adults (0);  absent, rendered indiscernable by synostosis (1).

Suturae frontosquamosa et laterosphenosquamosa, margo laterocaudalis orbitae, elongate, pointed, extensio dorsolateralis squamosi, terminus dorsal to os parietale, status praedefinitivum  : absent (0);  present (1).
Canalis ophthalmicus externus, ramus accessorius (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, originating in ostium canalis carotici with arteria carotici (1).
Recessus pneumatici paratympanici, recessus tympanicus dorsalis, cotyla quadratica, pila subcotylaris (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Recessus pneumatici paratympanici, recessus tympanicus rostralis, status (unordered)  : absent (0);  present (1);  vestigial (2).

Recessus pneumatici paratympanici, recessus tympanicus rostralis, facies ventralis, ostium, forma  : occluded ventrally, forming entire circular rima ossea (0);  rima ossea imperfect rostroventrad, including a variably deep incisura (1).
Recessus pneumatici paratympanici, recessus tympanicus caudalis, aspectus superficialis  : variably concealed within recessus columellae (0);  superficial (1).
Recessus pneumatici paratympanici, ossa inclusiva  : ossa basisphenoidale et basioccipitale (0);  entirely os basisphenoidale (1).

Columella, stipes columellae (new term), extremitas lateralis stipitis, processus supracolumellaris (processus rostralis) et processus infracolumellaris (processus caudalis), prominence (relative to stipes) et orientation (relative to stipes), forma  : comparatively short, distal, and oriented laterodistad (0);  comparatively elongate, intermediate, and oriented perpendicularly, contributing to an ``anvillike'' aspect (1).

Paries caudalis orbitae, generalized deficiency of ossification of entire paries leaving only lateromedial trabecular representation of crista tentorialis and linea cerebralis optici (new term) separating dorsal and ventral, elongate fenestrae, status  : absent, including presence of more-restricted deficiencies in paries (0);  present (1).
Paries medialis orbitae, large cavum ethmomandibularis (new term) lateral to septum interorbitale and caudodorsal in orientation, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Fonticulus orbitocranialis (if present), confluence with foramen nervorum olfactorii et foramen opticum, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Orbita, septum interorbitalis, paries dorsalis, canalis (sulcus) n. olfactorius, ostium rostralis, forma  : variably occult fissura (0);  prominent, voluminous, involucral tuba (1).

Margines supraorbitales, regio interorbitalis dorsalis (dorsal perspective), forma  : concave, regio interorbitalis dorsalis distinctly narrow, producing an ``hourglass'' profile (0);  sublinear to slightly concave, regio interorbitalis dorsalis not differing markedly from, or conformal with general caudorostral taper between, adjacent regiones (1).
Margo infraorbitalis, arcus suborbitalis, evidently representing ligamentum suborbitale ossificans, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Hiatus craniofacialis septi osseum, status definitivum  : present, septum nasi variably manifested (0);  absent, forming a continuous medial lamina os- sea craniofacialis (new term), and rostrum parasphenoidale that passes rostrad to processes maxillaris nasale aut nasalis maxillare (1).
Rostrum maxillae, crista tomialis, lateroventral convexity continuous from gape to base of hamulus terminalis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
