Corpus scapulae, margo dorsalis scapulae, angulus subterminalis (new term), provisionally identified with spatium interinsertiones mm. rhomboideus superficialis et profundus, status  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present, distinct (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2).
Extremitas caudalis (spina) scapulae, pars caudalis, modal failure to ossify to similar degree as cranial segment, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas caudalis (spina) scapulae, pars caudalis, significant departure of terminal shapes from that of collum et scapus scapulae in general, status et forma (unordered)  : absent, terminus blunt or tapered (0);  moderately spatulate (1);  broadly spatulate (2);  conspicuously hamulate, forming a rounded, ventrally oriented hook (3).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, forma sensu (i) craniocaudal length (i.e., craniocaudal expanse between processes acrocoracoideus et procoracoideus) relative to that of corpus et extremitas sternalis coracoidei, et (ii) prominence of both processes acrocoracoideus et procoracoideus  : substantial, interprocessural distance at least one-third length of corpus, both processes well developed (0);  truncated, interprocessural distance less than one-quarter length of corpus, both processes abbreviate and respective bases mutually juxtaposed (1);  noncomparable (ratites) (2).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus, principal dorsoventral orientation relative to axis majoris craniocaudalis coracoidei  : essentially coplanar (0);  distinctly ventral (1);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (2).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus, facies articularis clavicularis (medial perspective), margo caudalis, concavitas caudomedialis marginis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Fregata, Pelecanus) (2).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus, facies articularis clavicularis (medial perspective), moderately deep lateromedially, broad dorsoventrally, and ovate, spatulate aspectus, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus, impressio ligamenti acrocoracohumeralis, foramina aut pori pneumatica, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (2).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus, tuberculum brachiale, status and length relative to diameter of cavitas glenoidalis (unordered)  : present, former less than twice latter (0);  present, former approximately twice latter (1);  absent (2);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (3).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus glenoidalis coracoidei, facies (sulcus) articularis humeralis (labrum glenoidale), primary position (dor soventral and lateromedial dimensions) relative to processus acrocoracoideus (unordered or step- matrix)  : dorsal (0);  laterodorsal (1);  dorsolateral (2);  ventrolateral (3);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (4).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus et processus procoracoideus, synostosis omalis, articulatio transversus scapulae dividing delimited foramen approximately equally, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus procoracoideus, extension caudad along margo medialis coracoidei by medially expansive crista procoracoidei (new term), status  : absent or obsolete (0);  distinctly present (1);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (2).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus procoracoideus, prominent extension significantly craniomediad to cotyla scapularis by variably flattened tuberculum apicalis procoracoidei (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Corpus coracoidei, facies ventralis, depressio including single foramen neurovascularia, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (2).
Corpus coracoidei, facies ventralis, margo lateralis, area of corpus lateral to linea intermuscularis, ossification of regio, typus  : os typica (0);  membrana ossificans (1).
Corpus coracoidei (lateral perspective), facies ventralis, margo lateralis, convexity, status  : absent, margo linear or slightly concave (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2).
Corpus coracoidei, sectio proximal to extremitas sternalis, margo medialis, incisura cristae medialis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Corpus coracoidei, margo medialis, sulcus marginis m. sternocoracoideus (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, angulus medialis, tuberculum ancorae ligamentosa, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2).

Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, processus lateralis, width relative to facies articularis sterni and translucence and uncommon fenestration (i.e., exceptionally thin regio) of processus, status et forma  : former not wider than latter, and regio not translucent (0);  former wider than latter, and regio translucent and at times fenestrated (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2).

Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, processus lateralis, minimal craniocaudal width relative to lateromedial width of facies articularis sternalis  : former distinctly less than latter (0);  former subequal to latter (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2).
Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, processus lateralis, terminus processi, facies ancorae ligamentosa, status  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2).

Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, processus lateralis, angulus lateralis, modest depressio including one or more foramina neurovascularia (oriented mediad) in or slightly cranial to facies articularis sterni, labrum internum, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2).
Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, processus lateralis, angulus lateralis, incisura labri lateralis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2).

Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, processus lateralis, angulus lateralis, aspectus produced in combination with angulus lateralis et margo supraangularis lateralis, in which laterocranially oblique margo is distinguished by rounded eminentia at midpoint, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2).

Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, crista articularis sternalis, dorsoventral differentiation and lateromedial division (and sectiones defined thereby) of labri externa et interna by hiatus articularis (new term), forma  : extent comparable for much of facies (0);  margo sternalis rounded and lacking jugum interfacialis (new term) and irregular, subtubercular eminentia replacing sectiones propriae (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, facies ventralis, crista articularis sternalis (sectio lateralis), labrum externa, loculus pilae costalis, status (new term)  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, crista articularis sternalis (sectiones medialis et lateralis), crista intermedia (dorsoventral perspective), concavitas cristae, status et forma  : absent to minor (0);  present, conspicuously curved (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (2).
Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, facies articularis sternalis, distinct fovea enclosing foramina neurovascularia aut pneumatica, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Junctura sternoclavicularis, situs proximodistalis carinae sternalis  : distal, approximately at apex carina (0);  proximal, distinctly proximal to apex carina (1);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (2).

Junctura interclavicularis (cranial or caudal perspective), marked diverticulum symphysialis (new term), which accommodates penetration of carina sterni by ansae tracheales, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (2).

Junctura (syndesmosis) coracoscapularis (scapulocoracoidei), typus  : essentially immobile (akinentic)---junctura a synostosis, syndesmosis, or sutura---some manifesting ontogenetic variation (0);  variably mobile (kinetic)---junctura an articulatio synovialis, comprising variously ligamentous combinations of articulatio acrocoraco-acromiale (between processus acrocoracoideum coracoidei and acromion scapularis) cranially and articulationes coracosca (1).

Articulatio coracoscapularis, typus (unordered)  : concave cotyla scapularis coracoidei in combination with tuberculum coracoideus scapulae, effecting a moderately formed gomphosis or ``ball-andsocket'' joint (0);  facies articulares essentially laminar or sublinear, effecting an articulatio ellipsoidea aut plana (1);  noncomparable, junctura not articulatio (ratites, Dromornithidae) (2).
Articulatio sternocoracoidea, ligamentum sternocoracoideum laterale, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Junctura procoraco-clavicularis, status  : absent (0);  present, typically syndesmosis (1);  noncomparable by absence or vestigial status of claviculae (ratites) (2).

Junctura acrocoraco-clavicularis, typus  : articulatio plana aut syndesmosis (0);  synostosis (1);  noncomparable by absence of claviculae or junctura (basal Avialae, basal Ornithurae, ratites, Dromornithidae) (2).

Synostosis acrocoraco-procoracoideus (new term), producing arcus acrocoraco-procoracoideus (new term), status modalis  : absent, hiatus of variable width (0);  present, forming (within coracoideum) an arcus supracoracoideus, involving to variable degree interposed ligamentum ossificans or fragmentum claviculae (1).

Juncturae claviculo-acrocoracoidea, acromio- clavicularis, acromio-acrocoracoidea, et scapulo-- procoracoidea, mutual conjoinment to form a compound junctura claviculo-procoraco-scapularis (new term) delimiting either a fenestra or (by tight suturae or articulationes) an occluded focus---status modalis  : absent, at least one of the juncturae delimiting margo lacking (0);  present, delimiting a central fenestra or focus, a triosseous junctura with suturae completely occluding fenestra immediately cranial to processus procoracoideus (1);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (2).
Cavitas glenoidalis completas, status modalis (ordered)  : present (0);  vestigial (1);  absent (2).

Cavitas glenoidalis, cavitas relative to axes anatomica, forma (unordered)  : caudoventral or caudolateral (0);  lateral (1);  subperpendicular, facies oriented almost ventrally, sometimes diminutive and poorly defined (2);  obliquely ventrolateral to approximately parallel (3);  noncomparable (ratites) (4).
Fibrocartilago (os) humeroscapularis, status  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornis, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Humerus (brachium), total length relative to that of ulna et/aut radius (antebrachium), forma (ordered)  : four-thirds or more (0);  between one-half and four-thirds (1);  between one-quarter and one-half (2);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Os humerus, status ossis  : present (0);  absent, or represented in minority of individuals in various taxa by vestigium manifested as eminentia angularis at situs homologous to cavitas glenoidalis of some ossa coracoscapulares, strictly homologous to caput humeri vestigialis (1).

Os humerus, especially extremitas proximalis humeri, exceptional reduction in size (length and/ or robustness of corpus), disproportionate proximo- ventral prominence, and apparent general torsion, in addition to several qualitative changes---(i) virtual loss of caput, fossa pneumotricipitalis, et (epi)condylae; (ii) disproportionate robustness of eminentia m. latissimi dorsi, incisura capitis, et tuberculum dorsale; and (iii) torsion-related positional changes of the fossa m. brachialis et incisura capitis---most or all related to profound, evidently secondary flightlessness, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, caput humeri, dorsoventral width relative to that of extremitas proximalis humeri, forma  : former distinctly less than latter (0);  former subequal to latter (1);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, caput humeri, facies (margo) caudalis, tuberculum capitis origo m. humerotricipitis (new term), forma  : indiscernable or low impressio (0);  prominent tuberculum (1);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, caput humeri, forma generalis (unordered)  : cranially concave and caudally convex (0);  subspheroidal, margo proximalis centrally concave (1);  globular or spheroidal (2);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, caput humeri, separation from crista deltopectoralis and tuberculum dorsale (``externus''), status  : diminished, caput low and poorly distinguished adjacent features (0);  pronounced, caput offset and well distinguished from tuberculum dorsale (1);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies (perspective) proximalis, incisura capitis humeri, forma sensu depth relative to caput humeri, facies cranialis  : cranial depth less than planum capitis cranialis (0);  cranial depth equal to or greater than planum capitis cranialis, typically coplanar with sulcus ligamentosa transversus (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies (perspective) proximalis, incisura capitis humeri, forma sensu comparative breadth of incisura and angulus of orientation of tuberculum ventrale relative to caput humeri  : approximating a sulcus with parallel laminae ventrales et dorsales (0);  laminae ventrales et dorsales distinctly diverging craniad, incisura comparatively broad and (often) shallow, vertex cranialis typically broadly rounded (1);  noncomparable by absence or unique apomorphy of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, caput humeri, crista incisurae capitis distalis (emended term), status  : absent (0);  present, variably slanted and robust (1);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis, caput humeri, incisura capitis---delimited cranially by crista incisurae capitis proximalis (emended term), caudally by crista incisurae capitis distalis, ventrally by tuberculum ventrale, and dorsally by caput humeri---pori pneumatici marginales, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable by absence of crista (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis, caput humeri, incisura capitis, crista incisurae capitis distalis, orientation dorsad from tuberculum ventrale, broad, elevated, and flat caudal aspect, and caudal closure of incisura capitis, status  : absent (0);  present, unique forma characteristic (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis, caput humeri, incisura capitis, crista incisurae capitis distalis, comparatively low and sloping forma, enclosing fenestrae or entire fossa pneumatica within incisura capitis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, tuberculum ventrale (``internus''), forma sensu caudal prominence relative to caput humeri, status et forma  : former less than or equal to latter (0);  former distinctly greater than latter (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri (caudal or ``anconal'' perspective), tuberculum ventrale (``internus''), proximodistal position relative to fossa pneumotricipitalis or homologous situs  : comparatively cranioproximal, exposing completely fossa pneumotricipitalis (0);  comparatively caudodistal, largely or completely concealing fossa pneumotricipitalis (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, tuberculum ventrale (``internus''), tuberculum proprius (facies muscularum treated separately), orientation (unordered)  : ventral (0);  proximal (1);  caudal (2);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (3).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, tuberculum ventrale (``internus''), crista tuberculae (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, caput humeri, facies cranialis, immediately proximal to sulcus ligamentosa transversus, depressio et foramen pneumatica aut neurovascularia, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes). Crista deltopectoralis (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies caudalis, margo dorsalis, distinct variably deep concavity immediately distal to tuberculum dorsale and proximale to angulus cristae (or homologous situs) to form concavitas marginalis cristae (new term), which together with distal convexity of margo cristae, presenting a sinuous aspectus, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, quadrangular margo (craniocaudal perspective), status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis (oblique caudal perspective), form in which margo dorsalis cristae parallel and aligned with margo dorsalis corporis throughout length of former, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, markedly shallow (dorsoventral) depth in combination with considerable proximocaudal extent of margo cristae, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, comparative proximodistal length relative to that of corpus humeri  : great, well developed and extending at least one-third of length of corpus humeri (0);  small, diminutive, triangular eminentia, extending less than one-third of length of corpus humeri (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies cranialis, margo dorsalis, cristula (sulcus) marginalis distale (new term), status  : absent, crista deltopectoralis uniformly smooth to margo (0);  present, crista deltopectoralis marked by distinct sulcus or jugum, especially distinct near terminus distalis cristae (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies caudalis, foramen pneumaticum, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies caudalis, margo dorsalis, cristula (sulcus) aponeurosis m. scapulo-humeralis caudalis (new term), status  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present, especially pronounced proximally (1);  noncomparable (ratites) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies caudalis, distinct concavitas under margo distalis capitis et tuberculae dorsale, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, notably tuberculum ventrale, distinct distal counterclockwise rotation (caudal perspective) effecting: (i) ventrodistal shift and associated virtual alignment of margo dorsalis corporis et crista deltopectoralis, margo dorsalis; and (ii) subperpendicularity between margo ventralis of crista bicipitalis and margo ventralis corporis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis et margo dorsalis, tuberculum ventrale, distal position of tuberculum such that it is directly dorsal to fossa pneumotricipitalis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis et margo dorsalis, proximodorsal separation of caput et tuberculum dorsale by deep, wide sulcus that is positioned distad such that it is directly dorsal to fossa pneumotricipitalis, status  : absent (0);  present, crista broad and triangular (Casuarius) or crista narrow (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies caudalis, ala subtubercularis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies caudalis, cavitas pneumaticum cristae (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies caudalis, pila transversa cristae (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, angulus cristae, prominence and orientation relative to corpus humeri such that: (i) crista is at least as prominently extended dorsad, (ii) angulus cristae sharply acuminate, and (iii) margo proximalis cristae concave, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies caudalis, immediately ventral to margo cristae et impressio insertii m. scapulohumeralis caudalis, foramen neurovascularium et/ aut pneumaticum, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri (facies cranialis), crista deltopectoralis, terminus distalis, tuberculum insertii m. pectoralis, pars subcutanea thoracica, status  : absent or mere impressio(nes) (0);  present, prominent lobus (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis, tuberculum ventrale, crista bicipitalis, crus ventrale fossae, enclosure within perforation by comparatively numerous pori pneumatici, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista bicipitalis, facies cranialis, forma facialis sensu planarity or slight concavity, status  : absent, facies cranialis variably convex (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (ratites) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies cranialis, crista bicipitalis, (ventro)cranial prominence, status  : absent, negligible to moderate (0);  present, extreme rounded intumescentia (1);  noncomparable (ratites) (2).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies cranialis, intumescentia, marked circumdelimitation by jugum, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies bicipitalis, margo ventralis immediately caudal to tuberculum ventrale, eminentia subcircularis marginale (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, tuberculum ventrale, crista bicipitalis, crus distale fossae (new term), situs insertii m. scapulohumeralis caudalis, status, forma et situs (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, impressio craniodistales cristae (1);  present, impressio ventrodistalis apicali cristae (2);  present, sulcus aut fossa caudodistalis cristae (3);  noncomparable by absence of element or crista (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (4).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, tuberculum ventrale, crista bicipitalis, crus distale fossae (new term), situs insertii m. scapulohumeralis caudalis, cristula terminalis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, fossa pneumotricipitalis (primus in taxa with duplex fossae), distinct, triangular, partitioned, caudally exposed subfossa subtubercularis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, fossa pneumotricipitalis, occluding caudal lamina, rendering fossa apneumatic, with three or more distinct, subovate depressiones, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis, fossa pneumotricipitalis (caudal perspective), distinct circularity of densely rimmed atrium situated at approximate normality with respect to axis majoris corporis humeri, status (unordered)  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable by absence of element or fossa (ratites exclusive of Casuariidae; Dromornithidae) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis, fossa pneumotricipitalis, planum distalis fossae, area  : limited, submarginal (0);  expansive, typically constituting majority of solum fossae (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, fossa pneumotricipitalis, apparent torsion of element about axis proximodistalis (majoris) such that entire fossa is ventral to corpus humeri, status  : absent, no torsion apparent nor position altered (0);  present, torsion apparent and position altered (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, fossa pneumotricipitalis proprius (sensu stricto) or pars ventralis fossae, lamina crura dorsale fossae (new term), also serving as margo ventralis of incisura capitis, fenestra laminae, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis, fossa pneumotricipitalis, crus (proximalis) dor sale fossae (new term), pars ventralis aut proprius, distinctly angular cristula at junctura of incisura capitis et sulcus m. humerotriceps, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, fossa pneumotricipitalis, crus (distalis) ventrale fossae (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies (palmaris) cranialis, planum intertuberculare, sulcus (canalis) nervi coracobrachialis, status  : absent or indistinguishable (0);  present, represented by sulcus et/aut canalis (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies (palmaris) cranialis, planum intertuberculare, intumescentia humeri, margo distalis, cranially elevated and forming distinct, subcristulate plica aut jugum--- cristula intumescentiae (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies (palmaris) cranialis, sulcus ligamentosus transversus, sectio ventralis, marked triangular raised subplanar regio delimited by pronounced cristae marginales and enclosing deep ventral fovea, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Corpus humeri (lateral perspective), forma generalis  : sigmoidal (0);  linear (1).

Corpus humeri, extremitates proximalis et distalis, mutual dorsoventral (mediolateral) expansion relative to diameter at midpoint of corpus humeri, status  : small, maximal breadth of both extremitates less than 150% of diameter of corpus at midpoint (0);  large, maximal breadth of both extremitates exceeding 150% of diameter of corpus at midpoint (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Corpus humeri, margo dorsalis, sulcus nervi radialis, status  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, pronounced and generalized craniocaudal compression, producing sublaminar form, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, margo distalis humeri, principal orientation relative to axis majoris corporis, forma  : approximately perpendicular (0);  angulus strongly ventrad, significantly distad to pars dorsodistalis (new term), sometimes synonymous with prominence of processus flexorius (1).
Extremitas distalis humeri, condylus ventralis (including ``ulnar condyle'' or ``ulnar facet''), status  : absent or small (0);  present, often expanded (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, asymmetric ``carinate'' condylus dorsalis et condylus ventralis (including a strongly projecting condylus ventralis and well-defined epicondylus ventralis), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies cranialis, condyli dorsalis et ventralis humeri, forma generalis (unordered)  : suborbiculate, bulbous (0);  lorate (``straplike'') (1);  lamellate or scapulate (``bladelike'') (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies cranialis, condylus ventralis, length of axis majoris condyli relative to that of condylus dorsalis  : former less than latter (0);  former subequal to or greater than latter (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas distalis humeri, facies cranialis, incisura intercondylaris, forma  : shallow and wide (0);  deep and narrow (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies cranialis, fossa m. brachialis, proximodistal elongation, status  : absent, fossa of typical formation, variably sub- elliptical or subtriangular (0);  present, fossa elongate, approximating isosceles triangle with basis distalis much shorter than margines dorsalis et ventralis (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies cranialis, fossa m. brachialis, aspectus of elongate rhombus, obliquely oriented proximodistad from margo dorsalis to margo ventralis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas distalis humeri et corpus humeri, facies cranialis, tuberculum (fossa) origii m. pronator superficialis (new term), status  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis humeri et corpus humeri, epicondylus ventralis (entepicondylus), ancora origii m. pronator profundus (new term), forma et situs  : fovea on epicondylus ventralis (0);  facet on ancora m. pronator profundus (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, tuberculum (processus) supracondylaris dorsalis et epicondylus dorsalis, forma combining exceptional dorsal extension and robust conjoining of two structural components, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, tuberculum (processus) supracondylaris dorsalis relative to (epi)condylus dorsalis, situs proximodistalis  : variably conjoined (0);  distinctly proximal (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, tuberculum (processus) supracondylaris dorsalis, ancora origii m. pronator superficialis (or nonavian homologue), comparative situs et forma  : distal, on epicondylus dorsalis (0);  proximal, on tuberculum or facet on margo ventralis corporis (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas distalis humeri, epicondylus ventralis (entepicondylus), forma  : sessile boss or torus (0);  variably elevated cristula or jugum (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies ventralis et/aut epicondylus dorsalis (entepicondylus), impressio m. extensor digitorum communis (or nonavian homologue), status et situs proximodistalis (ordered)  : absent or not discernable (0);  distal, on epicondylus proprius (1);  proximal, encompassing relatively elongate area on margo ventralis between tuberculum m. extensor carpi radialis et epicondylus (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies caudalis, epicondylus ventralis (entepicondylus), situs proximodistalis relative to those of epicondylus dorsalis (ectepicondylus) et condylus ventralis, forma  : former proximal to latter (0);  former approximately equal or distal to latter (1);  noncomparable (ratites) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, processus flexorius, forma combining exceptional distal extension, ventrocaudal torsion, and caudal lamination, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies caudalis, fossa olecrani, proximal extent and prominence of sulcus inter-epicondylaris caudalis (new term), status  : absent or obsolete, sulcus essentially minimal transition from fossa olecrani to margo caudalis humeri (0);  present and prominent, sulcus distinctly emarginated, extending significantly proximad to fossa olecrani et termina proximales epicondylarum (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas distalis humeri, facies caudalis, fossa olecrani, fossa aut pori pneumatica[ici], status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies caudalis, fossa olecrani, forma in which fossa is broad, deep, and cranially unobstructed by condylus ventralis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies caudalis, sulcus tendinis m. humerotricipitalis (sensu stricto), status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  rudimentary or vestigial (1);  present (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (3).
Os ulna, corpus ulnaris, virtually linear form coincident with extreme relative elongation, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, pronounced ventral orientation such that apex processi is approximately coplanar with facies dorsalis corporis, status  : absent, apex processi variably elevated dorsad to corpus (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes, Aptornis) (2).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, cristula apicalis (new term), status  : absent or indistinct (0);  present, prominently developed, distally oriented, hamulate ala (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (2).
Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, cotyla dorsalis, forma superficialis  : concave or planar (0);  convex (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processes cotylares dorsalis et ventralis, conspicuous craniocaudal compression and distodorsal angulation such that cotylae form an angular dorsocaudal prominentia, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (2).
Extremitas proximalis ulnae, crista intercotylaris, tuberculum cristae (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, crista intercotylaris, forma  : variably conformed, inconspicuous eminentia or cristula (0);  prominent processus approaching olecranon in proximal extent (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis ulnae, impressio insertii m. brachialis, foramina pneumatica, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, incisura radialis, status  : absent or indistinct, sulcus narrow, cotylae closely juxtaposed, and process rounded-triangular and with distinct apex (0);  present and variably pronounced, sulcus wide and cotylae distales well separated, margo dorsalis invaginated by incisura, rendering subrectangular, less-expansive processus (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae, Sphenisciformes, Aptornis) (2).
Extremitas proximalis ulnae, incisura radialis, facies articularis radii, fossa pneumaticum, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, olecranon, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, distal to cotylae dorsalis et ventralis (1);  present, proximal to cotylae dorsalis et ventralis (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, sulcus tendinosus, status  : absent or obsolete, space between cotyla ventralis et olecranon flat to convex (0);  present, sulcus between cotyla ventralis et olecranon distinctly concave (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (2).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, cotyla ventralis, situs insertii m. biceps brachii (tuberculum bicipitale ulnae), status et forma (unordered)  : absent or vaguely indicated (0);  present, as distinct but modest impressio, jugum, or tumulus, typically manifested as enlargement at basis proximalis of impressio insertii m. brachialis (1);  present, as moderately prominent tuberculum or processus, in some passerines tending toward foveate form (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae, Sphenisciformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, impressio ligamenti collateralis ventralis, forma  : variably shaped (often suborbiculate to ovate), comparatively proximal impressio (0);  proximodistally elongated, elevated, subplanar jugum, extending distally for a considerable section of margo caudalis of impressio insertii m. brachialis (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Corpus ulnae, facies (caudo)dorsalis, forma generalis (dorsoventral perspective)  : subcylindrical, small diameter, slight craniocaudal curvature (0);  dorsoventrally compressed and laminar, rounded margines, margo cranialis essentially linear, and margo caudalis strongly angular with maximal craniocaudal width immediately distal to extremitas proximalis (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Corpus ulnae, facies (caudo)dorsalis, forma (unordered)  : linear or essentially straight (0);  variably convex, comparatively uniformly rounded or abruptly subangular (1);  subrectangular, subplanar (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).
Corpus ulnae (craniocaudal perspective), margo dorsalis, forma superficialis  : dorsally sublinear to concave (0);  dorsally convex (1);  noncomparable by absence (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Corpus ulnae, papillae remigales ventrales, status et forma  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present, modest impressiones or tumula (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis ulnae, facies craniodorsalis, incisura (impressio, sulcus) tendinosa---sulcus tendineus fide Butendieck (1980: 90); Butendieck and Wissdorf (1981); Butendieck et al. (1981)--- status  : absent, indiscernible, or obsolete (0);  present, variably distinguished by lineae, tuberositates (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).
Extremitas distalis ulnae, depressio carpoulnaris (new term), status  : present, variably distinct (0);  absent (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis ulnae, trochlea carpalis, condylus dorsalis ulnae, labrum condyli dorsalis (dorsal perspective), low but distinct convexity or lobus immediately proximal to rima, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis ulnae, trochlea carpalis, condylus dorsalis ulnae, labrum condyli dorsalis (``semilunate ridge''), terminal extension (including facies articularis with os carpi ulnaris), status et forma apicalis (ordered)  : absent, no extension of condylus dorsalis onto corpus (0);  present, intersecting with corpus from condylus dorsalis at obtuse, subdiagonal, to subperpendicular angulae, typically lacking extension on corpus as jugum (1);  present, apex (terminus) of condylus dorsalis extended, acuminate, variably elevated from margo dorsalis corporis (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas distalis ulnae, trochlea carpalis, condylae dorsalis et ventralis ulnae, forma intercondylaris  : subrectangular or ``flat,'' pars distalis dorsoventrally compressed and pars proximalis craniocaudally extended in planum of flexion-extension of ulna relative to humerus (0);  subtriangular or ``convex, semilunate,'' pars distalis subtriangular ``with a dorsomedial condyle,'' with 54Â° torsion of terminus distalis relative to terminus proximalis (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Extremitas distalis ulnae, trochlea carpalis, condylus dorsalis et ventralis ulnae, proximodistal extent  : approximately equal (0);  condylus dorsalis distinctly proximal to condylus ventralis (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis ulnae, trochlea carpalis, condylus ventralis ulnae, craniocaudal depth, and associated relative width of adjacent sulcus intercondylaris (distal perspective), forma  : condylus reduced, comparatively shallow, and abbreviated ventrally, with condylus typically remaining discernable (rarely obsolete), with sulcus intercondylaris accordingly broad and shallow (0);  condylus comparatively deep and not abbreviated ventrally, delimiting one side of narrow and deep sulcus intercondylaris (1);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis ulnae, trochlea carpalis et tuberculum carpale, sulcus intercondylaris, condylus ventralis, margo distalis of tuberculum carpale, and (especially) condylus dorsalis ulnae (distal perspective), broad, flattened facies articulares, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis ulnae, tuberculum car- pale, jugum tuberculae cranialis (new term), status  : absent or incompletely developed or indistinct (0);  present, distinctly curving (margo proximalis concave) and extending across facies dorsalis from tuberculum carpale caudad to margo caudalis ulnae (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis ulnae, tuberculum car- pale, facies craniodorsalis, fossa pneumatica et/aut pori pneumatici, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas proximalis radii, comparative differentiation of caput radii from adjacent corpus radii in diameter, and qualitative features, e.g., pronounced collum radii (new term), status  : present, distinct (0);  absent, weak, or obsolete (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis radii, caput radii, cotyla humeralis, forma  : subplanar to concave (0);  angular or convex (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas proximalis radii, facies dorsalis, sulcus obliquus m. brachialis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Corpus radii, margo cranialis, facies ventralis, jugum aut ala cranialis et sulcus muscularis (new term), latter primarily supporting insertio m. deltoideus, pars propatagialis, caput craniale (pars longus), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Corpus radii, distinct, moderate flattening, attaining maximum distal to midpoint of corpus, resulting in segment being flattened on facies interosseus whereas corpus ``hemi-cylindrical'' (planum transversus), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).
Corpus radii, pronounced dorsoventral compression throughout such that element assumes sublaminate shape, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Corpus radii, facies (ventro)caudalis, lineae intermusculares (mm. pronator superficialis et profundus, extensor longus digiti majoris pars proximalis, et extensor longus alulae, caput radiale), status et proximodistal extent (unordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, moderate impressio(nes) extending majority of corpus (1);  present, deep sulcus(ci) extending majority of corpus (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Corpus radii, facies (ventro)caudalis, lineae intermusculares, linea m. extensor longus alulae, caput radiale, status  : absent or indistinct (0);  present and conspicuously delimited (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Corpus radii, margo cranialis, pronounced dorsoventral compression and cranial extension into blunt angularity, status  : absent (0);  present, producing calcar radialis (new term), facies dorsalis of which manifests proximodistal sulcus tendinis m. extensor (meta)carpi radialis (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).
Corpus radii, margo interosseus (caudalis), foramen neurovascularia, status  : present (0);  absent (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Corpus radii, margo interosseus (caudalis), arcus origii m. extensor longus digiti majoris, pars proximalis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).
Extremitas distalis radii, exostosis continuous with that of extremitas proximalis carpometacarpalia, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis radii, facies articularis radiocarpalis, forma superficialis  : linear or slightly convex, subcylindrical (0);  concave, sub-bicondylar (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis radii, facies ventralis, tuberculum aponeurosis ventralis et facies dorsalis, tumulus rotundus (new term), unique bitubercular facies articulares with deep, dividing, obliquely oriented sulcus ligamentosus, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis radii, facies ventralis, depressio ligamentosa, fossa pneumatica aut foramina pneumatica sine fossa, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis radii, facies ventralis, sulcus (depressio) ligamentosus, disproportionately broad and deep effecting spatulate aspect, accentuated by pair of marginal sulci longitudinales, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis radii, margo dorsalis cristulate expansion and associated change in sulcus tendineus, status  : absent, margo dorsalis rounded or only slightly emarginate, sulcus typically angled with respect to axis majoris radii (0);  present, margo dorsalis enhanced by cristulate extension of margo cranialis of extremitas distalis radii, sulcus tendineus typically subparallel with axis majoris radii or broadened into indiscernability, ef fecting deflection of carpal passage of tendo m (1);  noncomparable (ratites, Sphenisciformes, Pezophaps) (2).

Os carpi radiale, os proprius et facies articularis metacarpalis, status et forma (unordered)  : present, including functional facies articulares metacarpalis, radialis, et ulnaris (0);  vestigial, meniscoid, typically substantially smaller and of reduced functionality than os carpi ulnare (1);  absent, collective loss of ossa alae distales (2).
Os carpi radiale, foramina pneumatica, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes). Os carpi ulnare (2).

Os carpi ulnare, ramus ventralis (new term), incisura metacarpalis, et processus muscularis, foramina pneumatica, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (2).
Os carpi ulnare, ramus ventralis (new term), terminus cruralis, semiglobular tuberculum, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).
Os carpi ulnare, incisura metacarpalis, status  : present (0);  absent (1);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (2).

Os carpi ulnare, incisura metacarpalis, angulus  : acute (angulus less than 90Â°), predominantly subdiagonal (angulus approximating 45Â°) (0);  perpendicular (angulus approximating 90Â° (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (2).
Ossa carpi distalia, status  : present (0);  absent in toto (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornis) (2).

Ossa carpi distalia, os scapholunare (``semilunate carpal''), status et forma sensu size, articulationes carpo-carpometacarpalia (ordered)  : present and distinct, large, articulatio(nes) including entirety of extremitates proximales of ossa metacarpalia I (primus, alularis) et II (secundus, ma- jus) (0);  present and distinct, small, but articulatio(nes) including entirety of extremitates proximales of ossa metacarpalia I (primus, alularis) et II (secundus, ma- jus) (1);  present and distinct, small, and articulatio(nes) including only extremitates proximales of ossa metacarpalia I (primus, alularis) et II (secundus, majus) (2);  absent as distinct element, incorporated by synostosis with extremitates proximales of both ossa metacarpalia majus et minus (3);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (4).
Os metacarpale alulare (I, primus), foramen intermetacarpale, status  : absent (0);  present, at least typical of Genyornis (1).

Os metacarpale alulare (I, primus), size relative to that of os metacarpale II (ordered)  : less than one-third of latter (0);  between one-third and one-half of latter (1);  greater than one-half but less than totality of latter (2);  subequal to latter (3);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (4).

Os metacarpale alulare (I, primus), forma superficialis (unordered)  : unremarkable, essentially a semi-elongate, rectangular, dorsoventrad laminate corpus (0);  massive, depressed, and quadrangular (1);  short, vestigial, oriented craniad or (rarely) dis (2).

Os metacarpale alulare (I, primus), facies articularis phalanx alularis (et articulatio metacarpophalangealis alulae), status  : present (0);  absent (1);  noncomparable, ossa alae absent (Dinornithiformes), modally synostotic (Aptornis) (2).

Os metacarpale minus (III, tertius), diameter of corpus relative to that of os metacarpale ma- jus (II, secundus), forma  : equal to moderately less (0);  conspicuously slimmer, apparently fragile, in sectiones translucent (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Os metacarpale majus (II, secundus), pars proximalis, facies dorsalis, processus (lamina) intermetacarpalis (impressio aut tuberculum insertii m. extensor carpi ulnaris), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  impressio, situs on os metacarpale majus, tumulus aut tuberculum (1);  impressio, but situs shifted to os metacarpale minus, similar to that where processus (below) extends to latter element, impressio (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (3).

Os metacarpale minus (III, tertius), pars proximalis et intermedius, facies ventralis, distinct laminar broadening creating (i) oblique, caudodorsal orientation of element with terminus proximalis; (ii) uniquely broad and synchondrosis intermetacarpalis proximalis (emended term) extending from processus pisiformis to margo dorsalis of fovea carpalis caudalis; (iii) variably elongate, prominent jugum pisiformis (new term) extending from processus pisiformis and extending distoventrad to spatium intermetacarpale; and (iv) apparently truncated collum metacarpalis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, causing an apparent truncation of collum carpometacarpalis (new term) (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (2).

Os metacarpale majus (II), pars proximalis, facies cranialis, protuberantia metacarpalis, status  : absent (0);  present, variably conformed tumulus or tuberositas (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae, Sphenisciformes, Aptornis) (2).
Ossa metacarpalia majus (II) et minus (III), facies dorsalis, papillae remigiales caudales, status  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present (1).

Os metacarpale minus (III), pars intermedius, margo caudalis, angulus m. ulnometacarpalis dorsalis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (2).

Os metacarpale minus (III), pars distalis, caudal divergence by caudal curvature or subangularity from os metacarpale majus (II) and craniocau dal broadening of symphysis intermetacarpalis distalis, creating distal broadening (typically maximal) of spatium intermetacarpalis, status  : absent (0);  present, conspicuous (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes, Aptornis) (2).

Os metacarpale minus (III, tertius), forma sensu lateromedial curvature (not slant) of corpus relative to that of os metacarpale II  : straight, i.e., ossa metacarpalia II et III essentially linear in parallel (0);  dorsally (laterally) bowed, resulting in convexity of margo lateralis corporis (1).

Ossa metacarpalia majus (II, secundus) et minus (III, tertius), pronounced dorsal (lateral) curvature of corpora metacarpalia in parallel, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes, Aptornis) (2).
Carpometacarpus, complexus ossium manus prodigitalis, status in toto  : present (0);  absent (1);  noncomparable (Aepyornis) (2).

Os metatarsale IV (quartum), lateromedial width relative to dorsoplantar depth or forma in planum transversus  : dorsoplantar dimension greater than lateromedial, element ``thick'' or round (0);  lateromedial dimension greater than dorsoplantar, element ``flat'' or distinctly rectangular (1).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, cotyla medialis, rima (facies) lateralis cotyli, medial prominence relative to facies lateralis corporis, status  : absent (0);  present, approaching lateromedial width of corpus (1).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, cotylae lateralis et medialis, facies articulares, relative area  : cotyla lateralis approximately equally expansive as cotyla medialis (0);  cotyla lateralis distinctly less expansive than cotyla medialis (1).
Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, cotylae lateralis et medialis, forma superficialis  : both cotylae concave (0);  cotyla lateralis distinctly convex, whereas cotyla medialis concave (1).
Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, cotyla medialis, eminentia intercondylaris, status  : absent or rudimentary (0);  present (1).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, areae parahypotarsales medialis et lateralis, forma  : depressiones, but depth variable (0);  facies lateralis et medialis hypotarsales planar, a condition related to extreme lateromedial compressio of corpus (1).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, fossa parahypotarsalis lateralis, status  : absent or indistinct, area without detectable departure from general curvature of element (0);  present, variably deep, margo lateralis typically distinct (1).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, fossa infracotylaris dorsalis, status  : absent or indiscernable from facies dorsalis corporis et/aut sulcus extensorius (0);  present, typically a depressio ovalis distinct from facies dorsalis corporis et/aut sulcus extensorius (1).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, fossa infracotylaris dorsalis, foramina vascularia proximalia, diameters relative to that of fovea ligamentum collateralium trochlea digiti IV  : ``small''---diameters distinctly less than that of fovea (0);  ``large''---diameters equal or distinctly greater than that of fovea (1).
Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, fossa infracotylaris dorsalis, foramina pneumatica suprasulciorum (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, fossa infracotylaris dorsalis, tuberculum m. fibularis (peronei) brevis, status et forma  : absent or indistinct impressio or tumulus (0);  present, prominent processus (1).
Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, fossa infracotylaris plantaris (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, hypotarsus (``calcaneum'') proprius, status (ordered)  : absent, neither hypotarsus proprius nor pseudohypotarsus (new term) indicated (0);  rudimentary or vestigial, including pseudohypotarsus (new term) produced by way of the caudally displaced, compressed extremitas proximalis of os metatarsale III typical of the ``arctometatarsalian'' configuration of the synostotic ossa metatarsalia II-- I (1);  present, a variably prominent hypotarsus proprius, comprising an eminentia plantaris and typically enclosing one or more sulci et/aut canales tendinorum (2).
Hypotarsus, crista lateralis hypotarsi, spina lateralis hypotarsi (new term)  : absent or miniscule (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Hypotarsus, crista intermedia(e) hypotarsi, plantar prominence relative to adjacent crista(e) of hypotarsus, status  : absent (0);  present, distinct (1);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Hypotarsus, crista intermedia hypotarsi, spina intermedia hypotarsi (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, in association with isolated, exceptionally prominent crista (1);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Hypotarsus, crista medialis hypotarsi, spina medialis hypotarsi (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, in some cases continuous distad forming distally extensive, prominent jugum with crista medianus plantaris, or uniting with facies plantaris corporis via ligamentum ossificans (1);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Hypotarsus, canales et/aut sulci hypotarsi--- ``tendinal passage 3'' of Strauch (1978) or ``anterolateral canal'' of Stallcup (1954  : 6)---canalis tendinis insertii m. flexor hallucis longus (Vanden Berge and Storer 1995 (0);  8), status modalis (1);  absent, indiscernable or shallow sulcus (2);  present, deep, majority-delimited sulcus or canalis (3);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (4).

Hypotarsus, canales et/aut sulci hypotarsi--- ``tendinal passage 4'' of Strauch (1978)---canalis tendinis insertii m. fibularis (peroneus) longus (Vanden Berge and Storer 1995  : 8), status modalis (0);  absent, indiscernable or shallow sulcus (1);  present, deep, majority-delimited sulcus or canalis, including minority conjoined with tendinal passage 2 of Strauch (1978), i.e., with canalis tendinorum (i) m. flexor perforatus digiti IV et (ii) m. flexor perforans et perforatus digiti II (2);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (3).

Hypotarsus, canales et/aut sulci hypotarsi--- ``tendinal passage 5'' of Strauch (1978) or ``posterolateral canal'' of Stallcup (1954  : 6)---canalis tendinorum insertii (i) m. flexor perforatus digiti III, (ii) m. flexor perforatus et perforans digiti III, et/aut (iii) m. flexor perforatus digiti IV (Vanden Berge and Storer 1995 (0);  8)---status modalis (1);  absent, indiscernable or shallow sulcus (2);  present, deep, majority-delimited sulcus or canalis (3);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (4).

Hypotarsus, canales et/aut sulci hypotarsi, status generalis  : present, variable with respect to both sulci et canales (0);  absent, aspectus hypotarsi rectanguloid (1);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (2).

Hypotarsus, canalis complexus hypotarsi lateralis (new term)---i.e., laterally displaced, enlarged passage evidently enclosing two or more ten- dines, presumptively comprising tendinal passages 3 (m. flexor hallucis longus) and 5 (m. flexor perforatus digiti IV) of Strauch (1978), status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Corpus tarsometatarsi, marked lateromedial compression of corpus such that dorsoplantar depth exceeds lateromedial width, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Corpus tarsometatarsi, margo medialis, pars proximalis, forma  : rounded, similarly conformed as rest of corpus (0);  dorsoplantad compressed, margo medialis comparatively thin (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, margo (crista) lateralis (especially pars distalis), forma (dorsal perspective)  : concave, distally curving smoothly to facies lateralis of trochlea digiti IV, typically effecting approximate symmetry with margo medialis (0);  (sub)linear, oriented (virtually) directly distad to margo lateralis trochlearis digiti IV, typically effecting distinct asymmetry with margo medialis (1).
Corpus tarsometatarsi, margo (crista) medialis (interna), dorsoplantar compression rendering sublaminate forma, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies subcutanea medialis, concavitas marginalis (evidently enlarged impressio m. extensor hallucis longus), extending obliquely distoplantad from fossa infracotylaris dorsalis toward os metatarsale I pedis, status  : absent or obsolete (0);  present and prominent (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, forma (unordered)  : essentially flat or marked subtly by cristae et sulci longitudinales (0);  distinctly angular-convex, variably but typically well marked by cristae et sulci, often declining in prominence distad longitudinales (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus m. fibularis (peronei) longi, forma  : weakly or moderately defined, typically truncated impressio (0);  strongly defined by peripheral cristulae intermusculares, typically deeply recessed, distally extensive fossa (1).
Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus flexorius, crista plantaris medialis, eminentia  : distinct, often prominent (0);  absent or indistinct (1).
Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus flexorius, crista plantaris lateralis, eminentia  : absent or indistinct (0);  prominent (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus flexorius, crista medioplantaris, status  : absent (0);  present, variably prominent (1);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (2).
Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus flexorius, crista medioplantaris, extension proximal to cotylae medialis et lateralis, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus flexorius, crista medioplantaris, situs lateromedialis  : approximately mediad on facies plantaris (0);  shifted distinctly laterad throughout, underlying (in part) the virtually complete concavity of facies plantaris tarsometatarsi (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus flexorius, crista plantaris medianus, synostosis with aponeurosis (tendo origii) ossificans m. gastrocnemiali, status  : absent (0);  present, typically with lacuna(e) infracristalis (new term) (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sectio proximalis medial to axis proximodistalis, jugum origii m. adductor digiti II pedis, forma  : moderate or absent, typically smooth, generally continuing parallel to crista medioplantaris distal to approximate midpoint of element (0);  prominent, typically rugose, converging with crista medioplantaris at approximate midpoint of element (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus parahypotarsalis lateralis (new term), a distinct extension of fossa parahypotarsalis lateralis distad to facies lateralis trochlearis metatarsale IV, status  : absent, indistinct, or proximally truncated (0);  present (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, sulcus extensorius, impressiones retinaculi extensorii, ruga medialis sulci (new term) distinct in absence of ruga lateralis sulci (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, accentuated by comparatively wide, deep sulcus adjacent to ruga, and minimally raised tuberositas m. tibialis cranialis (1).
Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, sulcus extensorius, impressiones retinaculi extensorii, dorsal prominence of rugae (especially medialis) et solum sulci, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, sulcus extensorius, arcus extensorius, status  : absent, intrinsic mm. extensorii restrained by an ansa ligamentosa (0);  present, ansa restraining intrinsic mm. extensorii ossified as arcus shortly distal to cotylae tarsometarsalia (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, medial angulation and associated marginal asymmetry of distal four- fifths of corpus, status  : absent (0);  present, angulation in accord with distal obsolescence of os metatarsale II (1).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris aut medialis, pars distalis (typically or principally associated with os metatarsale II), fossa metatarsi I (primus, hallucis), status et forma (ordered)  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present, vague impressio (1);  present, fovea or distinct fossa (2);  noncomparable in taxa lacking os metatarsale I (see character treating status) aut synostosis intermetatarsalis (Phaethontidae, Haematopodidae) (3).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, fossa metatarsi I (primus, hallucis), situs dorsoplantaris relative to trochlea metatarsale II  : medial, situated on margo medialis metatarsale II (0);  plantar, some with minor medial component (1);  noncomparable in taxa lacking os metatarsale I. Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, foramen vasculare distale, forma sensu diameter (mean of ostia dorsalis et plantaris) relative to lateromedial width of incisura intertrochlearis metatarsalia III et IV (ordered)  : distinctly smaller (0);  subequal (1);  distinctly larger (2);  noncomparable (Casuariiformes, Sphenisciformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, foramen vasculare distale, forma sensu dorsoplantar orientation relative to axis majoris of corpus tarsometatarsi (ordered)  : subperpendicular, essentially directly dorsoplantad, unobstructed perpendicular line of sight (0);  oblique, distinctly ventrodistal, obstructed perpendicular line of sight (1);  subparallel, ostium distalis oriented virtually proximodistad (2);  noncomparable (Casuariidae, Sphenisciformes, Bucerotidae) (3).
Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, foramen vasculare distale, septum vasculo-tendineus foraminis (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Casuariidae, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, foramen vasculare distale, situs in which foramen perforates tarsometatarsus relative to approximate axis majoris tarsometatarsi  : lateral (0);  central (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae, Casuariidae, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, foramen vasculare distale, ostium foraminis dorsale (dorsal perspective), situs proximodistalis  : distal---approximately parallel to margines proximales trochleares (especially that of os metatarsale IV), typically within terminus of sulcus intertrochlearis metatarsalia III et IV (0);  proximal---distinctly proximal to trochlea, extreme conditions proximal to margo proximalis of sulcus intertrochlearis metatarsalia III et IV (1);  noncomparable (Casuariidae, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, foramen vasculare distale, positioned at terminus distalis of sulcus extensorius such that ostium foraminis dorsalis is concealed (dorsal perspective), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Casuariidae, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, foramen vasculare distale (dorsal perspective), ostium foraminis dorsalis (new term), forma  : continued proximad by essentially smooth bone or shallow sulcus (0);  continued proximad by deep, distinctly emarginated sulcus (1);  noncomparable (Casuariidae, Sphenisciformes) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, canalis aut sulcus interosseus (intertrochlearis) tendineus (foramen tendinis m. extensor brevis digiti IV), forma plantaris sensu distal extent relative to that of margo incisurae intertrochlearis lateralis  : ostium foraminis tendinis et margo incisurae intertrochlearis lateralis approximately equally distal (0);  foramen tendinis emergent distinctly proximad to margo incisurae intertrochlearis lateralis, former continued to latter by irregularly delimited sulcus (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, canalis aut sulcus interosseus (intertrochlearis) tendineus (foramen tendinis m. extensor brevis digiti IV), forma plantaris sensu trochlea accessoria forms solum plantaris of passage, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, sulcus musculi extensorius brevis digiti IV (Ballmann 1969a: 161)---sharply defined, comparatively deep sulcus proximal to foramen vascularis distale---status  : absent or indistinct (0);  present and distinct (1).
Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi (plantar perspective), fossa supratrochlearis plantaris, status  : absent or indistinct (0);  present, distinctly concave (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi (plantar perspective), trochleae metatarsalia II--IV, termini proximales, sharp, subparallel emargination bordered proximad by distinctly depressed regiones (i.e., a ``steplike'' aspect), status  : absent, trochleae grading variably smoothly with facies plantares tarsometatarsi (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Struthio) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, facies dorsomedialis, sulcus m. extensor digitorum longus (ramus medialis), passing distad through incisura intertrochlearis medialis, status  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochleae accessoriae group II (i.e., primarily or solely involving plantar torsion of trochlea metatarsi II), trochlea accessoria (Sehnenhalter) metatarsi II (secundus), status  : absent, associated with anisodactyly (0);  present without trochleae accessoriae metatarsalia I et/aut IV, associated with heterodactyly (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochleae accessoriae group III, trochleae accessoriae (Sehnenhalteren) metatarsalia II (secundus) et IV (quartus), sulcus intertrochlearis between trochleae accessoria et metatarsale IV, status  : absent, associated with anisodactyly, except other taxa with Sehnenhalteren (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochleae metatarsalia II, III, et/aut IV, synostosis dorsalis intertrochlearis rendering obsolete or absent corresponding incisurae intertrochleares, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi II, reduction to unirimulate condition related to lateromedial compression of extremitas tarsometatarsi, status  : absent (0);  present (1).
Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, sectio corporis supratrochlearis, facies medioplantaris, facies articularis hallucis  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi II, facies plantaris, pronounced plantar displacement and partial clockwise angulation, such that sulcus trochlearis (new term) approaching subdiagonality with axis majoris corporis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi II, distinct plantomedial angulation initially evident comparatively proximal on corpus tarsometatarsi (i.e., immediately distal to fossa articularis metatarsale I), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi II (secundi), facies et rima medialis trochlearis, processus medioplantaris (new term), status  : absent or subtle (0);  present, prominent and subrectangular (1);  noncomparable (Struthio) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochleae metatarsalia II--IV, foveae ligamentorum collateralium, exceptional depth and subcircular forma, typically enclosing pori pneumatici, and extending distolaterad to produce incisura (fovea) trochlearis metatarsale II (new term), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  State 2 (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi III (tertii), facies lateralis trochlearis, foveae ligamentorum collateralium, status  : essentially absent (0);  present, shallow to moderate depressio (1);  present, very deep, typically with margo distalis concave and in some enclosing pori neurovascularia (2);  noncomparable (Psittaciformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi IV (quarti), lateroplantar torsion producing dorsoplantar, oblique splaying of sulcus trochlearis and obsolescence of fovea ligamentorum collateralium, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi IV (quarti), reduction to unirimulate condition related to lateromedial compression of extremitas tarsometatarsi, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, os metatarsale IV (quarti), trochlea metatarsi quarti (IV), foveae ligamentorum collateralium, status et forma sensu depth and width relative to that of associated trochlea (ordered)  : present, deep fovea (0);  present, shallow to moderate depressio (1);  essentially absent (2);  noncomparable (Psittaciformes, Cuculiformes, Coraciiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, os metatarsale secundi (II), rima medialis trochlearis, incisura laterodistalis, status  : absent (0);  present, effecting medial interruption of trochlea in distal perspective, typically accompanied by opposing lateral incisura trochlearis IV (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, ossa metatarsalia II--IV, trochleae metatarsalia, forma sensu relative lateromedial breadths of individual trochlea (unordered)  : trochlea metatarsi II < or = trochlea metatarsi III > or = trochlea metatarsi IV (0);  trochlea metatarsi II > trochlea metatarsi III > or = trochlea metatarsi IV (1);  trochlea metatarsi II < trochlea metatarsi III < or = trochlea metatarsi IV (2);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (3).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, os metatarsale secundus (II), facies plantaris, basis trochlearis, proximally narrowing triangulo-cuneate eminentia to point opposite to foramen vasculare dis- tale, ostium plantaris, status  : absent or only vague, irregular (0);  present, distinctly formed (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae). Lateromedial characteristics relating trochleae tarsometatarsalia (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochleae metatarsalia II et IV, plantaromedial torsion (II laterad and IV mediad) relative to trochlea metatarsale III, status  : absent or indistinct (0);  present and pronounced (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, os metatarsale II, corpus proximal to trochlea metatarsale II, status  : present, comparable to ossa metatarsalia III-- IV (0);  absent or obsolete (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae). Dorsoplantar characteristics relating trochleae tarsometatarsalia (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochleae metatarsalia II--IV (distal perspective), forma in which trochleae (i) virtually coplanar dorsoventrally and (ii) equal in distal extent, status  : absent (0);  present, trochleae typically also closely juxtaposed (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsale III, dorsal elevation relative to trochleae metatarsalia II et IV such that (lateral perspective) fovea ligamentorum collaterium et rima exposed dorsal to other trochleae, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi IV (quarti), conspicuous counterclockwise torsion (distal perspective) relative to counterparts of other trochleae (including metatarsale II), status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi IV (quarti), rima medialis trochlearis, prominent dorsoproximal elevation relative to counterparts of other trochleae, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, os metatarsale IV (quartus), trochlea metatarsi, ventral torsion (rotation) of facies lateralis trochlearis about axis proximodistalis of corpus tarsometatarsi (including distal extension through trochlea metatarsi III), status  : absent or indistinct, trochlea at most subdiagonal with respect to corpus (0);  present, pronounced, trochlea subperpendicular with respect to corpus (1).

Digiti II--IV pedis, phalanges proximales et intermediae, narrowing of middle portion of corpora relative to extremitates proximales et distales phalangiorum (``waisting'' or ``dumbell-shaping''), status  : present, variably distinct (0);  absent (exclusive of minimal basal inequality of some phalanges proximales), resulting in simple, cylindrical or ``peglike'' phalanges lacking diametric heterogeneity of extremitates proximales aut distales relative to corpus (1).

Digiti II--IV pedis, phalanges non-unguales, facies laterales et mediales, pronounced (subtubercular) lateromedial expansion immediately proximal to foveate ligamentorum collaterales, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Digitus I pedis (hallux), phalanx proximalis, basis phalangis et cotyla articularis phalangis, lateromedial width relative to proximodistal length  : comparatively narrow (0);  comparately broad, semiovate, medial extremity expanded for insertio m. flexor hallucis brevis (1).

Digitus I pedis (hallux), phalanx proximalis, length relative to that of phalanges (unguales) dis- tales digitorum II--IV  : former proximalis at least as long as latter (0);  former distinctly shorter than latter (1);  noncomparable in taxa lacking hallux (see status) (2).

Digitus I pedis (hallux), phalanx proximalis, length relative to phalanx (ungualis) distalis digiti I  : proximalis at least as long as distalis (0);  proximalis distinctly shorter than distalis (1);  noncomparable in taxa lacking hallux (see status) (2).
Digitus I pedis (hallux), phalanx proximalis, basis phalangis disproportionate breadth, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable in taxa lacking hallux (see status) (2).

Digitus I pedis (hallux), forma sensu length of phalanges proximalis et ungualis relative to digitus III pedis, phalanx proximalis  : greater, halluces elongate (0);  subequal (1);  noncomparable in taxa lacking hallux (see status) (2).

Digitus I pedis (hallux), phalanx proximalis, corpus phalangis, facies plantaris, curvature distinctly marked relative to that of phalanges proximales digitorum II--IV, status  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, distinct (1);  noncomparable in taxa lacking hallux (see status) (2).

Digitus I pedis (hallux), phalanx distalis (ungualis), elongate and falchionate forma relative to other phalanges distales (unguales), status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable in taxa lacking hallux (see status) (2).
Digitus II (secundus) pedis, distinctly truncated total length (optimally compared in articulation) relative to lengths of digiti III et IV pedis (if present), status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Digitus II (secundus) pedis, ordination of lengths of phalanges within homologous digitus, in which phalanges within digitus (lettered proximodistally ``a,'' ``b,''..., ``u'') are sequenced in order of descending length, and virtual equalities were resolved by assignment of greater rank to more- proximal of pair  : a > b (0);  b>a (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (2).

Digitus II (secundus) pedis, phalanx proximalis, basis phalangis, facies dorsolateralis, tuberculum extensorium (tuberculum insertii m. abductor digiti II), status  : absent or minute (0);  present, prominent (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (2).

Digitus II (secundus) pedis, phalanx proximalis, basis phalangis, cotyla articularis lateralis, lateromedially compressed, bipartite facies articulationes cotylae to accommodate trochleae metatarsalia II et III, status  : absent (0);  present (1).

Digitus II (secundus) pedis, phalanx proximalis, basis phalangis, facies medialis, tuberculum insertii m. flexor perforatus digiti II, status  : absent or minute (0);  present, prominent (1);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (2).

Digitus II (secundus) pedis, phalanx distalis (ungualis), forma sensu corpus (size) et apex phalangis (shape)  : proportionate to other phalanges distales (0);  disproportionately elongate and acuminate relative to other phalanges distales, falchionate (1).

Digitus III (secundus) pedis, phalanx proximalis, basis phalangis, facies dorsomedialis, tuberculum insertii m. extensor brevis digiti III, status  : absent or indistinct (0);  present, prominent (1).
Digiti III et IV, partial, principally basal synostosis between adjacent surfaces of bases of respective phalanges proximales (indicated osteologically), status  : absent (0);  present (1).
