Os maxillare, crista tomialis, angulus tomialis (new term)---extension of caudal terminus as distinct tuberculum or short processus caudal to sutura jugomaxillaris and lateral to, and variably free from, arcus jugalis, status (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, composed entirely of os maxillare (1);  present, composed of os premaxillare or ossa maxillare et premaxillare (2).

Os maxillare, processus jugalis, lamina palatina (new term), status and forma sensu terminus caudalis (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, rostrocaudally abbreviate, extends moderately caudad processus palatus (1);  present, rostrocaudally elongate, extends markedly caudad to processus palatus (2).

Os maxillare, processus palatus (new term), synostosis medialis, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, excluding septum interorbitalis (1);  present, including septum interorbitalis (2).

Os palatinum, pars maxillaris, abrupt medial curvature caudally producing a rostral segment in which the paired elements are parallel and widely separated, and laminae choanales ventrales are parallel and narrowly separated, status (unordered)  : absent (0);  coplanar (1);  present (2).

Os palatinum, pars choanalis, lamella dorsalis, margo medialis, synostosis interpalatina medialis, possibly including pars palatina pterygoidea et os vomeris, if present and interposed, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, elements distinguishable, including at least as distinct sutura interpalatina (0);  present, but not forming prominent carina medialis (1);  present and producing ventrally prominent carina medialis (2).
Os palatinum, pars choanalis, lamella ventralis, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  rudimentary or vestigial (1);  prominent (2).

Os palatinum, pars choanalis, lamella ventralis, position of angulus caudomedialis relative to that of pars lateralis, margo caudalis, situs rostrocaudalis (ordered)  : rostral (0);  coincident (1);  caudal (2);  noncomparable where pars lateralis absent, rudimentary, or extensively synostotic (3).
Os palatinum, pars choanalis, lamella ventralis, medial separation of bilateral lamellae, forma (ordered)  : moderate (0);  great (1);  extreme (2).

Os palatinum, pars choanalis, lamella ventralis, processus rostromedialis (if present), rostromedial convergence, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, separate throughout length (1);  present, synostotic rostrally (2).
Os palatinum, pars lateralis, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  rudimentary or vestigial (1);  well developed (2).
Os palatinum, pars pterygoideus, processus pterygoideus, status (ordered)  : absent or rudimentary (0);  present, moderately developed (1);  present, extensively developed (2).

Vomer (synostotic ossa vomeris), corpus vomeris (ossa vomeris exclusive of extremitates rostralis et caudalis) in planum transversus, forma (unordered)  : strutlike, variable (0);  bladelike, primary feature is bilateral compression with dorsoventral deepening, in Gruiformes and Charadriiformes the dorsal margin tending to ``Y-shaped'' caudally (1);  cruciate, ventral portion a dorsoventrally oriented blade, with dorsal portion perpendicular and bilaterally expanded (2);  laminate, primary feature is bilaterally broadening (3);  cylindrical (4).
Vomer (synostotic ossa vomeris), processus pterygoideus, status (ordered)  : present (0);  vestigial (1);  absent (2).

Os pterygoideum, corpus pterygoidei (new term), pes pterygoidei, facies articularis palatina--- lateromedial separation of bilaterally paired extremitates caudales (ventral view), and corresponding junctura (articulatio) interpterygoidea---forma (ordered)  : widely separated, juncturae well lateral from rostrum parasphenoidale (0);  moderately or slightly separated, juncturae only slightly lateral to rostrum or barely reaching planum of rostrum parasphenoidale (1);  not separated, articulatio aut sutura interpterygoidea present (2).

Os pterygoideum, facies articularis palatina, situs dorsoventralis (ventral perspective) of junctura pterygopalatina relative to rostrum parasphenoidale, situs dorsoventralis (ordered)  : markedly ventral, articulatio pterygo-rostroparasphenoidalis absent (0);  slightly ventral, articulatio pterygo-rostroparasphenoidalis absent (1);  on rostrum, articulatio pterygo-rostroparasphenoidalis present (2).

Os quadratojugale, facies articularis quadratica et adjacent arcus jugalis, forma (unordered)  : planar aut depressio, effecting articulatio planum aut sellaris (0);  (sub)condylus, centrally positioned within facies lateralis processi mandibularis quadrati (1);  subcondylus, arcus quadratojugalis angled mediad at terminus to effect articulatio at terminus of facies lateralis processi mandibularis quadrati (2);  subplanaris cum solum perpendicularoventralis, typically with arcus quadratojugalis angled mediad to rest obliquely at terminus (3).

Os quadratum, corpus ossis quadrati, facies lateralis, tuberculum articularis zygomaticus, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, subsessile, indistinct facies articularis quadrato-zygomaticus (new term) on facies lateralis of processus oticus, capitulum squamosa quadrati or margo dorsalis immediately cranial to processus (1);  present, pedicillate, separate processus zygomaticus (new term) on facies lateralis quadratica (2).

Os quadratum, facies articularis pterygoidei relative to processus mandibularis et corpus ossis quadrati, situs (ordered)  : processus orbitalis, facies medialis et margo ventralis proximal (dorsal) to processus mandibularis, condylus pterygoideus (0);  margo mediocaudalis corporis ossis quadrati, typically extending over most or all of margo mediocaudalis corporis ossis quadrati, terminating dorsal to processus mandibularis quadrati, and terminus processi quadratici pterygoidei variably bilobate (1);  processus mandibularis, condylus pterygoideus (2).

Os quadratum, processus mandibularis quadrati, condylus medialis, facies articularis, forma superficialis (ordered)  : convex (0);  concave, ventral aspect bilobate (1);  concave, enclosing obliquely oriented sulcus, ventral aspect trochlear (2);  noncomparable because of indistinguishable condylae (Aptornis) or inclusion of nonhomologous features within condylus medialis (Podargus) (3).

Os quadratum, processus mandibularis quadrati, facies articularis pterygoidea (facies ventralis in those taxa having two), typus (unordered)  : facies articularis, with slight anteromedial eminentia on basis (0);  cotylar, largely concave (1);  condylar, tubercular, or jugo-sublinear (2).

Os quadratum, processus mandibularis quadrati, facies articularis pterygoidea, forma (unordered)  : elongate with broad articulatio quadratopterygoidea, facies articularis single or bipartite, facies ventralis typically predominant (0);  restricted, a single, distinct, subcircular facies (1);  single, well defined, continuous, facies uniquely parabolic (2).

Os quadratum, processus orbitalis quadrati, status et forma relative to (i) processus oticus quadrati aut (ii) orbita (ordered)  : present, longer than orbita (0);  present, shorter than orbita (1);  present, of comparable length to processus oticus (2);  present, distinctly shorter than processus oticus (3);  absent (4).

Os quadratum, processus orbitalis, inordinate elongation of processus, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, processus also markedly robust (1);  present, processus also markedly slender, subacuminate (2).

Os quadratum, processus orbitalis quadrati, elongation (exceeding processus oticus in length) and rostral expansion into spatulate terminus (latter at least as broad as any other part of the processus orbitalis) in which rostral margin is rounded, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, terminus spatulate with margo rostralis rounded (1);  present, terminus subrectangular with margo rostralis flat (2).

Os quadratum, processus oticus quadrati, margo dorsalis, tuberculum insertii m. adductor mandibulae externus (pars articularis, caput inter- nus), status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, subtle (1);  present, marked (2).
Junctura palatinopremaxillaris, status et typus  : absent, contact limited to palatinomaxillaris (0);  present, sutura aut synostosis (1);  present, syndesmosis (2).
Junctura---articulatio aut sutura---vomeropterygoidea, status et forma (ordered)  : present, moderately extensive (0);  present, short (1);  absent (2);  noncomparable (Struthio) (3).

Articulatio vomero-rostroparasphenoidalis (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : present and extensive, composing majority of dorsomedial contact between palatum osseum et rostrum parasphenoidalis (0);  present, limited to rostral segment and supplemented by ligamentum mesethmovomerale (1);  present, limited to rostral segment or absent (2).

Articulatio quadrato-cranii (new term), typus (unordered)  : articulatio quadrato-squamosa, wherein os squamosum typically if not uniformly involved in junctura postorbito-squamosa, but articulatio quadrato-proÃ¶tica (sensu lato) absent in any form (0);  articulatio quadrato-squamoso-proÃ¶tica present and structurally united (1);  articulationes quadrato-squamosa et quadratoproÃ¶tica present and distinct (2);  articulatio quadrato-squamoso-proÃ¶ticaexoccipitalis (new term) present (3);  articulatio quadrato-squamoso-proÃ¶ticaexoccipito (4).

Zona flexoria craniofacialis, conformation as variably distinct transverse linea(e), often buttressed by margines rostrales et/aut caudales by eminentia of ossa frontales, status et forma  : absent, an indistinct jugum, angulus, or depressio (0);  present, a distinct lamina or sulcus (1);  present, a deep fissura with bordering eminentiae (2).

Zona flexoria palatina, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, zona simplex, restricted by ligamentum palatomaxillare (1);  present, including syndesmosis of processus premaxillaris palatini (2).

Os prearticulare, processus prearticularis (new term)---tuberculum (dorsale) insertii m. pseudotemporalis superficialis---status et forma (unordered)  : absent or rudimentary (tuberositas), typically on dorsal surface of basis prearticularis, or proximate to tomium caudal to or within fossa aditus canalis mandibulae (0);  present and prominent (tuberculum verae), on margo dorsalis of processus rostralis prearticulare and at approximate midpoint of margines ventralis et dorsalis mandibulae, typically medial to fenestra caudale mandibulae within fossa aditus canalis mandibul (1);  present and prominent (tuberculum verae), on apex of processus dorsalis prearticulare, subparallel with tomium and with planar facies dorsalis (2).

Os prearticulare, pars rostralis (new term), slender processus dorsalis (new term) and comparatively truncate extension of corpus ossis combining to produce (medial perspective) a shallow bifurcatio ossis prearticulare (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, processus dorsalis extending rostrad to corpus (1);  present, processus dorsalis subtriangular, failing to extend rostrad to corpus (2);  noncomparable where synostotic. Os Spleniale (3).
Ramus mandibulae, facies dorsalis, sulcus aut planum paratomialis (new terms), status  : absent (0);  present, caudal to symphysis (1);  present, extends onto symphysis. Partes mandibulae (2).
Rostrum (symphysis) mandibulae, facies dorsalis, forma superficialis (unordered)  : concave (0);  planar (1);  convex, along symphysis medialis (2).

Rostrum (symphysis) mandibulae, margo caudalis, foramina neurovascularia (if paired), forma et numerus modalis (unordered)  : bilaterally paired (0);  dorsoventrally paired (1);  singular, central (2);  noncomparable (Falconidae) (3).

Rostrum (symphysis) mandibulae (dorsal perspective), rostrocaudal elongation, bilateral compression, and marked convergence of rami (in some taxa become parallel) well caudal to rostrum, pro ducing distinctly ``Y-shaped'' mandibula, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, rami remain distinguishable (1);  present, rami indistinguishable and distally form a unified, apical carina (2).

Ramus mandibulae, pars intermedia and segment of pars caudalis rostral to fossa articularis quadratica, margo ventralis, curvature (lateral perspective), status et forma (unordered)  : present, variably but distinctly decurved (0);  obsolete, i.e., virtually straight (1);  present, strongly recurved (2);  noncomparable (Rynchopidae) (3).
Os (corpus) nuchale, status et typus (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, aponeurotic, derived from junctura caudalis mm. adductores mandibulae (1);  present, osseus (2).

Anulus ossicularis sclerae, sensu Lemmrich (1931), typus sensu numerus ossicularae unilateralium modalis per anulus (ordered)  : typus ``B,'' including only one lateral and one medial ossicula per anulus, and defining a single, variably extensive, intervening series of imbricated ossiculae (0);  typus ``A,'' including two lateral and two medial ossiculae per anulus, and defining variably extensive, intervening series of imbricated ossiculae (1);  typus ``C,'' including three lateral and three medial ossiculae per anulus, and defining variably extensive, intervening series of imbricated ossiculae (2).

Anulus ossicularis sclerae, comparative lateromedial depth in planum transversus (unordered)  : essentially laminar, inner rima lateral to outer rima (0);  distinctly conical, often with margo (internus) lateralis of anulus markedly angled craniad (1);  subcircular and narrow (2).

Os nervi optici, status et forma modalis (unordered)  : absent, homologous structure remaining a cartilago (0);  present, typically crescentiform (rarely anulate), without enclosed fenestra (1);  present, typically crescentiform (rarely semicircular), with enclosed fenestra laterale accessoria (new term) (2).

Ossa supraorbitalia, status et numerus per latus (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, typically single ossiculus attached by weak sutura or ligamentum to margo caudalis processi supraorbitalis ossis lacrimale (1);  present, typically several ossa per latus attached by weak suturae to form rima supraorbitalia (2).
Os lacrimopalatinum, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, sublinear (1);  present, angular (2).

Syrinx, cartilagines syringeales, cartilagines tracheosyringeales et/aut broncheosyringeales, typus definitivum (unordered)  : typus bronchialis---syrinx includes only cartilagines bronchiales, in which syringeal refinements occur bilaterally within the paired bronchi (0);  typus tracheobronchialis---syrinx includes both cartilagines tracheosyringeales et bronchosyringeales (1);  typus trachealis---syrinx includes only cartilagines tracheales (2).

Os paraglossum (entoglossum), corpus, enclosed (i.e., circumlimited) perforatum---fovea aut foramen medialis entoglossae (new term)---status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, fovea (1);  present, foramen (2);  noncomparable where ossa entoglossae absent (see character status) (3).

Os basihyale (basibranchiale) rostrale, processus et arcus parahyalis, status (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, as bilateral, variably elongate, rostrally oriented processes (1);  present, as bilateral lamina in which dorsal elevation of pair meet mediad to compose an arcus parahyalis (2).
Atlas, corpus atlantis, depressiones aut recessus pneumaticus, status et typus (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, as jugum or shallow recessus in homologous situs (1);  present, as depressio (2).

Atlas, corpus atlantis, processus ventralis corporis, status et forma modalis (unordered)  : present, variably prominent, represented as shallow shelf, bifurcate or tripartite flange, or single medial processus (0);  present, represented by prominent, caudally extensive (craniocaudal depth significantly exceeding that of arcus atlantis), dorsoventrally compressed, bilaterally convex, typically carinate lamina (1);  absent (2).

Axis, corpus axis, facies articularis atlantica, foramen pneumaticum, status (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, but indicated only by depressio et foramina et/aut pori (1);  present, conspicuous (2).
Vertebrae cervicales cunctes (speciales et communis), numerus modalis (ordered)  : nine or fewer (0);  ten to 12 (1);  13 or 14 (2);  15 or 16 (3);  17 or more (4).
Vertebrae cervicales communis, sectio I, corpus vertebrae, facies lateralis corporis, processus costalis, forma (ordered)  : well developed (0);  vestigial (1);  absent (2).

Vertebrae cervicales communis (sectio II), corpus vertebrae, facies lateralis corporis, processus costalis, status (ordered)  : present throughout sectio II (0);  present in cranial elements but absent in caudal elements of sectio II (1);  absent throughout sectio II (2).

Vertebrae cervicales communis, sectio II, arcus vertebrae, lamina arcocostalis et foramina laterales arcus (new term), status (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, incomplete, enclosing one or (uncommonly) two foramina---foramen(ina) laterale(s) arcus (new term)---and represented by a broad or narrow arcus (1);  present, complete or with one or more minute or irregular foramina, forming a continuous osseus lamina (lacking enclosed foramina) between ansa costotransversaria and arcus vertebrae (2).
Vertebrae thoracicae (dorsales), numerus modalis (ordered)  : 11 or more (0);  six to ten (1);  five or fewer (2).

Vertebrae thoracicae (dorsales), corpus vertebrae, facies lateralis corporis, bilateral compression, often accompanied by reduced or virtual absence of pneumaticity of elements, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, corpus (sub)cylindrical (0);  present, manifested by concavitas lateralis, depressio ovalis, new term (1);  present, manifested by virtually laminar structure of corpus between facies articulares cranialis et caudalis (2).

Vertebrae thoracicae (dorsales), arcus vertebrae, lamina dorsalis arcus, processus spinosus, distinct craniocaudal increase in height in seriatum relative to arcus vertebrae, status et forma (ordered)  : present, marked, typically equal to twice that of corpus vertebrae (0);  present, limited (1);  absent (2).

Vertebrae thoracica (dorsales), arcus vertebrae et costa vertebralis, foramen (costo) transversarium (cranial perspective), forma (unordered)  : elliptical (axis majoris dorsoventral) or sub- circular (0);  elliptical (axis majoris lateromedial) or fissuriform (1);  occluded by membrana ossificans (2).

Vertebrae thoracicae (dorsales), arcus vertebrae, lamina lateralis arcus, incisura caudalis arcus, dorsoventral osseus occlusion enclosing foramina neurovascularia, status et numerus (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, single (1);  present, two, vertically aligned, including notarium, if present (2).

Notarium (if present), arcus notarii, foramina (intervertebralia) interarcuales, status et forma (unordered)  : present, large, diameter distinctly greater than that of fovea costalis (0);  present, small, diameter approximately equal to that of fovea costalis (1);  present, obsolete, reduced to minute perforations or evidently absent (2);  noncomparable, lacking notarium (other Neornithes) (3).

Vertebrae synsacrales, corpus vertebrae, vertebra synsacralis primus (new term), facies articularis cranialis, forma in planum transversus (ordered)  : bilaterally compressed, dorsoventral dimension substantially (at least 1.5 times) greater than lateromedial dimension (0);  subcircular, subrectangular, or weakly bilobate, dorsoventral and lateromedial dimensions being approximately equal (1);  dorsoventrally compressed, lateromedial dimension being substantially (at least twice, often three times) greater than dorsoventral dimension (2).

Vertebrae synsacrales preacetabularis, processes transverses relative to adjacent foramina (fenestrae) intertransversaria, forma transversa (ordered)  : former less than or equal to latter (0);  former greater than latter, but latter retaining diameters meriting reference to latter as fenestrae (1);  former much greater than latter, reducing diameter of foramina intertransversaria to prominent pori (2);  noncomparable, by occlusion of foramina (Aepyornis) (3).

Extremitas cranialis synsacri (cranialmost incorporated element, typically one of caudalmost vertebrae thoracicae), corpus vertebrae, facies articularis cranialis, forma (cranial perspective) sensu outline of facies(iae) articularis(es) verae (unordered)  : subrectangular and semi-bilobate, wider than deep, margo ventralis more deeply incised (sulcus caroticus) than margo dorsalis, entire surface so delimited involved in articulatio intervertebralis (0);  subcircular, squarish, or cordiform by dorsal incisura (1);  noncircular-elliptical or nonsquare-rectangular, significantly wider than deep (2).

Vertebrae acetabulares synsacri (resurrected term, cf. du Toit 1912--1913; Radu 1975; KomÃ¡rek 1979)---the osteological estimate of vertebrae ``eusacrales'' diagnosable fundamentally by neuroanatomical means, and those elements corresponding most closely to those of sectio III of Boas (1934)---numerus modalis (ordered)  : four or five (0);  two or three (1);  one (2);  noncomparable (Cuculidae, Brachypteracidae, Rhamphastidae, Jyngidae, Picidae) (3).

Extremitas caudalis synsacri, vertebra synsacri ultima (new term), modal craniocaudal position relative to ala postacetabularis ilii, margo caudalis ilii at medial extreme (i.e., relative to margo medialis of incisura caudalis pelvis)  : cranial (0);  coincident, typically interposed between medial termina of pilae postrenales (1);  largely or completely caudal (2);  noncomparable (Rheidae) (3).

Extremitas caudalis synsacri (sectio IV of Boas 1934), caudal (posterior, distal) elements, differentiation (primarily ventral prominence of corpus and craniocaudal broadening and change in orientation of processes transverses) relative to more- cranial elements, and structurally associated with ala (pars) postacetabularis ilii, facies ventralis, recessus caudalis fossae, lamina ventralis, margo cranialis (if recessus present) or pila postrenalis, status et numerus vertebrae (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, affecting one vertebra (1);  present, affecting two vertebrae (2);  noncomparable, ala postacetabularis ilii not articulating with vertebrae (ratites) (3).

Facies dorsalis synsacri, fenestrae intertransversariae, status et forma modalis (ordered, basal state ``b'')  : absent (0);  present (at least vertebrae caudales stabiles), comparatively small (1);  present (at least vertebrae caudales stabiles), comparatively large (2);  noncomparable (Struthionidae, Rheidae, Apterygidae, Gaviidae, Podicipedidae) (3).

Facies lateralis synsacri (sectio IV of Boas 1934), exposure of corpus vertebrae of included elements ventral to ala postacetabularis ilii, margo ventralis, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, limited, exposure pertains only to ventral portions of vertebrae (1);  present, extreme, facies laterales of caudalmost vertebrae almost completely ventral to margo ventralis of ala postacetabularis ilii (2).

Facies lateralis synsacri, vertebrae acetabulares (i.e., those having disproportionately elongated processes costales oriented toward acetabulae--- sectio III of Boas (1934)---foramina intervertebralia, forma sensu numerus modalis per parum (ordered)  : zero foramina, facies lateralis synsacri acetabularis et postacetabularis forming an imperforate lamina (0);  one foramen, presumably common foramen passing between each pair of vertebrae, the ventral member evidently subject to loss (especially caudally), admitting ramus ventralis of respective couplet in plexus sacralis nervosum (1);  one distinct foramen dorsally with conspicuously reduced vestigium indicative of ventral member (2);  two distinct foramina passing between each pair of vertebrae (3).

Facies visceralis synsacri, vertebrae acetabulares (i.e., those having disproportionately elongate processes costales oriented toward acetabulae--- sectio III of Boas (1934)---lateral extent relative to rima acetabularis (ordered)  : essentially extend(s) laterad to rima acetabularis (0);  approaches closer than one-half distance between columna vertebralis and rima acetabularis but distinctly proximad to rima acetabularis (1);  approaches less than one-half distance between columna vertebralis and rima acetabularis (2);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (3).

Facies visceralis synsacri, vertebrae acetabulares (i.e., those having disproportionately elongated processes costales---sectio III of Boas (1934)--- cranial and caudal components of orientation toward acetabulae (ordered)  : cranial or craniodorsal to acetabulum, variably coalesced at synostosis with ilium, pars acetabularis (0);  caudodorsal to acetabulum, synostotic as single composite with ilium (1);  caudal to acetabulum, synostotic as single composite with ilium et ischium, pars acetabularis (2).

Facies visceralis synsacri, vertebrae acetabulares et caudales stabiles synsacri, processes costales et foramina transversariae, prominence and continuity from acetabulum to margo caudalis of extremitas caudalis synsacri, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, limited to segment immediately caudal to acetabulum (0);  present, small (1);  present, large (2).

Synsacrum, vertebrae caudales stabiles, columna extending at least partly ventrad to margo ventralis alae ilii postacetabularis, status (ordered)  : absent, synsacrum enclosed (lateral perspective) bilaterally by ossa ilii (0);  present, only exposed in part (1);  present, completely exposed caudad, columna curving ventrad at extremitas caudalis alae ilii postacetabularis (2).
Vertebrae caudales liberae, arcus vertebrae, foramina transversaria, numerus modalis parum (ordered)  : zero (0);  one or two (1);  three or four (2).

Vertebrae caudales liberae, arcus vertebrae, processus transversus vertebrae, angulus dorsoventralis (craniocaudal perspective) relative to facies lateralis corporis (ordered)  : dorsally obtuse, processes angling distinctly ventrad (0);  approximately coplanar with planum transversus (1);  dorsally acute, processes angling markedly dorsad (2);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Podicipedidae) (3).

Vertebrae caudales liberae, arcus vertebrae, foramina intervertebralia, persistence in adult, status (ordered)  : absent throughout vertebrae caudales stabiles et liberae (0);  present in vertebrae caudales stabiles only (1);  present in both vertebrae caudales stabiles et liberae (2).

Vertebra caudalis liberus propygostylus, processes ventrales chevroniformes, forma et situs modalis (ordered)  : extensive or complete, columna vertebralis distal to sacrum (i.e., cauda), elongate (at least as long as processes spinoses vertebrae), robust (exclusive of cranialmost), well-defined facies articulares cranialis et caudalis, enclosing supracentral triang (0);  widespread distribution among vertebrae caudales in comparatively elongate caudae, but diminution in size evident (1);  present on all vertebrae caudales propygostyli (2);  limited to and diminutive on one to three vertebrae pygostylae (3);  absent throughout series (4).

Vertebrae caudales liberae (exclusive of pygostylus, if present), processes ventrales chevroniformes of distal elements, termini cranialis et/aut caudalis, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, both termini ``simple'' (0);  present, terminus cranialis bifurcate (1);  present, both termini cranialis et/aut caudalis of processes ventrales ``bifurcate'' (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (3).

Pygostylus (synostosis pygostyli), status et typus (ordered)  : absent---juncturae caudae (specifically vertebrae caudales liberae) are articulationes (0);  present, partial---synostoses pygostyli present, but juncturae intervertebrales (especially cranially) are discernable and weak synostoses (hypothesized herein to embody partial apomorphic reversal), with synostotic elements lacking extensive lamina pygos (1);  present, complete---synostoses intervertebrales firmly uniting all included vertebrae, terminal unit having extensive lamina pygostyli (2).

Pygostylus (if present), basis pygostyli, processus ventralis (ventral perspective), partitions, status et forma ventralis (unordered)  : absent, cylindrical (0);  present, unipartite, presenting a lamina (1);  present, bipartite, presenting a concavitas (2);  noncomparable (Rheidae, Dromaiidae, Apterygidae, Tinamidae, Dromornithdae) (3).

Pygostylus (if present), corpus pygostyli, crista ventralis (lateral perspective), forma marginalis (unordered)  : convex (0);  essentially linear or slightly concave (1);  sigmoid or at least partly concave (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Rheidae, Dromaiidae, Apterygidae, Tinamidae, Dromornithdae) (3).

Juncturae synsacri, cranialmost vertebra caudalis liberae (primus), articulatio (sutura aut synostosis) iliosynsacralis, status et typus (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, represented by articulatio, specifically between processes transversariae et ala postacetabularis ilii (1);  present, represented by synostosis, specifically between processes transversariae et ala postacetabularis ilii (2);  noncomparable (Rheidae, Casuariidae, Apterygidae, Tinamidae, Podicipedidae) (3).

Costa vertebralis, extremitas dorsalis costae, tuberculum costae, length relative to that of capitulum costae (ordered)  : obsolete, facies articularis vertebralis essentially sessile on corpus costae, resulting in shallow, fissuriform incisura capitulotubercularis and largely occluding the canalis vertebrarterialis (0);  present but comparatively truncate, length distinctly less than one-half that of capitulum, resulting in variable, moderately deep incisura capitulotubercularis and a moderately large canalis vertebrarterialis (1);  present and elongate, length approximately one-half or more that of capitulum, resulting in deep incisura capitulotubercularis and maintaining a variably spacious canalis vertebrarterialis (2).

Costa vertebralis, corpus costae, facies lateralis, craniocaudal width relative to that of adjacent spatium intercostalis (ordered)  : distinctly less, wherein the respective sulci pulmonales are comparatively wide, accommodating expanded tori intercostales of the lung, suggesting enhanced respiratory capacity (0);  approximately equal (1);  greater, typically with some adjacent costae in direct contact, forming articulationes intercostales vertebrales (2).

Costae vertebrales, corpus costae, processus uncinatus, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  rudimentary or vestigial (1);  present, joined with corpus costae, margo costalis, by synostosis or sutura (latter sometimes tenuous) (2).
Costae completae (caudales) spuriae, numerus modalis per latus (ordered)  : zero (0);  one (1);  two or (uncommonly) three (2);  four or more (3).

Synchondrosis intercostalis, angulus articularis caudalis costarum, as defined by associated pairs of costae vertebrales et sternales (ordered; basal polarity ``b'')  : approximately 180Â°, approaching straight angulus (0);  approximately 90Â°, perpendicularity or slightly acute angulus (1);  45Â° or less, distinctly (sharply) acute angulus (2).

Corpus sterni definitivum, primordia metasternales osseae (new term), status et typus (ordered)  : comprising no derivatives of any sternal anlagen, element completely absent as osseus definitive element, or some effectively by symphyses medialis interscapulocoracoides (new term) (0);  comprising bilaterally paired, typically calcified plates (``metasternales''), variably synchondrotic leading to definitive synostosis medialis without carina (1);  bilaterally paired, medially synostotic, and variably prominent cartilagines carinae (Microraptor), also including margo costalis, planum postcarinale (analogous to ``xiphial region''), et processus (caudo) lateralis (2);  bilaterally paired cartilagines metasternae, carinae, et comprising rudimentary to intermediate grades of carina, corpus, and trabeculae, and a continuum of medial synostosis of bilateral components (perhaps limited to Enantiornithes) (3);  bilaterally paired cartilagines metasternales cum synostosis medialis, as well as interposed, medial, and synostotic carina sterni definitivum (``midline keel'') (4);  bilaterally paired cartilagines metasternales cum synostosis medialis, as well as interposed, medial, and synostotic carina sterni definitivum (``midline keel''), but secondarily dispossessed of carina in its entirety and (variably) planum postcarinale, ra (5);  State 6 (6).

Corpus sterni, craniocaudal length relative to lateromedial width (ventral perspective), forma generalis (unordered)  : ``trans-rectangular,'' wider than long (0);  essentially square or subcircular (1);  ``longi-rectangular,'' longer than wide (2);  triangular, longer than wide, isoceles with narrow basis corresponding to margo cranialis sterni (3).

Corpus sterni, margo costalis sterni, craniocaudal length relative to that of entire corpus sterni on axis mediana (ordered)  : less than one-fourth (0);  between one-fourth and three-fourths (1);  more than three-fourths (2).

Corpus sterni, margo costalis sterni, pila costalis, lateromedial profile (ordered)  : concave, i.e., invagination within corpus sterni (0);  straight (1);  convex, i.e., invagination extends corpus sterni laterally (2).

Corpus sterni, margo costalis sterni, pila costalis, terminus caudalis pilae (new term), craniocaudal position relative to that of apex incisurae caudolateralis (ordered)  : distinctly cranial, i.e., distance between terminus et apex is at least one to two times the length of the pila (0);  roughly coincident (1);  distinctly caudal (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae, Aptornis, Psophiidae, Aramidae, Gruidae) (3).

Corpus sterni, margo costalis sterni, processus articularis sternocostalis, facies articularis costalis, forma (ordered)  : unifaceted (0);  bifaceted, two facies connected by narrow septum (1);  bifaceted, two facies of each processus separated by spatium (2).

Corpus sterni, margo cranialis sterni, depressio (sulcus aut fossa) articularis coracoideus, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, articulatio sternocoracoidea simplex or lacking (0);  present, articulatio rudimentary (1);  present, moderately or well developed (2);  present, extremely truncated sulci or confined fovea or fossa (3);  present, vestigial, sulcus plana, facies articularis, sulcus subplana with craniocaudal broadening laterally, abbreviate sulcus cum fovea lateralis, aut fovea cum articulatio ellipsoidea (4).

Corpus sterni, margo cranialis sterni, depressio (sulcus) articularis coracoideus, lateromedial position relative to those of processes craniolaterales (ordered)  : extremitas lateralis sulci (new term) extending laterad to at least the midpoint of processus craniolateralis (0);  extremitas lateralis sulci (new term) terminating immediately mediad or laterad to margo medialis of processus craniolateralis (1);  extremitas lateralis sulci (new term) terminating significantly mediad to margo medialis of processus craniolateralis (2);  noncomparable by absence of processus craniolateralis (Opisthocomus) (3).

Corpus sterni, margo cranialis sterni, pila coracoidea sterni, angulus with respect to margo cranialis sterni, forma (ordered)  : ``weakly angled,'' approximately parallel, angulus approximately 0Â° (0);  ``moderately angled,'' subdiagonal, angulus between 0Â° and 45Â° (1);  ``strongly angled,'' supra-diagonal, angulus greater than 45Â° (2).

Corpus sterni, margo cranialis sterni, depressio (sulcus) articularis coracoideus, labrum externum, tuberculum labri ventralis, foramen (a)pneumaticum immediately dorsal to tuberculum, status et typus (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, depressio apneumaticum (1);  present, foramen pneumaticum (2).

Corpus sterni, margo cranialis sterni, depressiones (sulcus) articulares coracoidei, labrum internum, facies articularis coracoideum, basis pilae medianus (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, moderately distinct (1);  present, conspicuously prominent (2).

Corpus sterni, margo cranialis sterni, processus craniolateralis sterni with respect to axis majoris carinae, angulus (ordered)  : perpendicular, angulus âˆ¼ 90Â° (0);  diagonal, angulus âˆ¼ 45Â° (1);  parallel, angulus âˆ¼ 0Â° (2).

Corpus sterni, facies visceralis sterni, basis processi craniolateralis et/aut processus craniolateralis proprius, impressio origii m. sternocoracoidei, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present, shallow (1);  present, moderately distinct or conspicuous, often pneumatic (2);  noncomparable (Mesitornithidae) (3).

Corpus sterni, margo cranialis sterni, sulcus articularis coracoideus (ventral perspective), continuity (caudo)laterad, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, laterad to unite with processus craniolateralis, impressio craniolateralis sterni aut basis processi (1);  present, caudolaterad to unite with margo costalis (2);  noncomparable (Mesitornithidae) (3).

Corpus sterni, facies muscularis, impressio aut eminentia m. coracobrachialis caudalis, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, as impressio ovalis (1);  present, as impressio ovalis within less-deep, more-expansive impressio m. supracoracoideus, together uniquely craniolateral in position (2);  present, as eminentia (3);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (4).

Corpus sterni, rostrum sterni aut basis rostrodorsalis carinae sterni, recessus pneumaticus, status et typus (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, small, no wider than basis carina and shallower dorsoventrad than sulcus articularis coracoidei (1);  present, medium, at least as wide as basis carina and at least as deep dorsoventrad as sulcus articularis coracoidei (2).

Corpus sterni, rostrum sterni, spina communis, status et forma (unordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, a short tuberculum, cuneus, eminentia, or lamina (1);  present, a moderately long processus (2);  noncomparable by absence of carina (most Palaeognathae, Aptornis) (3).

Corpus sterni, rostrum sterni, spina communis et enclosed foramen rostri (if present), status (ordered)  : both spina communis et foramen rostri absent (0);  spina communis present, foramen rostri absent (1);  both spina communis et foramen rostri present (2);  noncomparable by absence of spina communis (Dromornithidae) (3).

Corpus sterni, margo costalis sterni, vertex (ala) postcostalis (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, subangulus of limited expanse (1);  present, ala of comparatively great, ovate expanse (2).

Corpus sterni, facies muscularis, facies ventralis, prominent jugum subcostalis (new term) and distinct sulcus medioventralis costorum (new term), typically extending craniocaudad for majority of corpus sterni, margo lateralis (unordered)  : absent, or sufficiently limited in depth and craniocaudal exent (0);  present, moderate (1);  present, extreme (2).

Corpus sterni, margo costalis sterni, processus (trabecula) lateralis, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, comprising trabeculae et spina caudalis, with spina cranialis obsolete (1);  present, comprising trabeculae et spinae cranialis et caudalis (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornis) (3).
Corpus sterni, margo caudalis sterni, fenestra aut incisura caudolateralis, status et forma modalis (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, as incisura (1);  present, as fenestra (2).

Corpus sterni, margo costalis sterni, processus caudolateralis (if present), orientation relative to corpus sterni as reflected (in part) by angulus defined by incisura caudolateralis (new term), vertex cranialis angulae (ordered)  : angulus approximately 45Â°, or vertex approximately diagonal to margo lateralis of trabecula mediana of corpus sterni (0);  angulus between 15Â° and 45Â°, vertex is parabolic (1);  angulus essentially undefined, as processus is subparallel to margo costalis and ``vertex'' is ellipsoidal (2);  noncomparable by absence of processus or incisura, or indeterminate orientation (see character regarding status) (3).

Corpus sterni, margo caudalis sterni, trabecula caudolateralis (if present), margo terminus caudalis, forma (unordered)  : rounded or (sub)rectangular, often obliquely aligned (0);  cruciate, with terminal, transverse pila (1);  (sub)acuminate, variably oriented (2);  noncomparable where presence of trabecula uncertain or known to be absent (e.g., Confuciusornis, Ichthyornis, and Lithornis; see status) or union in case of homologous fenestra (Aegotheles) (3).

Corpus sterni, margo caudalis sterni, trabecula intermedia (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, delimited medially by shallow incisura (1);  present, delimited medially by deep incisura or fenestra (2).

Corpus sterni, margo caudalis sterni, incisura aut fenestra intermedia (new term), relative cranial extent (ordered)  : rudimentary, incisura appears as minor (perhaps irregular) invaginatio or concavitas (0);  abbreviate, length of incisura aut fenstra less than one-third craniocaudal length of corpus sterni (1);  moderate, length of incisura aut fenstra between one-third and two-thirds of craniocaudal length of corpus sterni (2);  noncomparable by absence of delimiting trabecula intermedia (see character regarding status) (3).

Corpus sterni, facies muscularis, trabeculae caudolateralis, intermedia, et mediana, respective pilae extending into intersectio in corpus cranial to separation of trabeculae, conspicuous craniocaudal jugum defining a right angulus laterad immediately cranial, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  noncomparable (Aptornis) (2);  State 23 (3).

Carina sterni, margo ventralis carinae (lateral perspective), forma (unordered)  : distinctly convex, including strongly arched profiles (0);  approximately straight (1);  distinctly concave throughout (2);  noncomparable by absence of carina (flightless Palaeognathae) (3).

Carina sterni, margo ventralis carinae (lateral perspective), inflection point or shallow concavity approximately one-third of length of carina caudad from apex, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, indistinct (1);  present, marked (2).

Carina sterni, apex carina, facies articularis clavicularis, status et forma (unordered)  : absent, facies undifferentiated from margo cranialis et apex carina (0);  present, as incisura or concavitas (1);  present, angulus or curva apicalis (2);  noncomparable by acarinate condition (ratites, Dromornithidae) or synostosis sternoclavicularis (Fregata, Pelecanus, Balaeniceps, Grus, Opisthocomus) (3).

Carina sterni, facies articularis furculae (lateral perspective), forma (unordered)  : rounded or subtly bilobate (0);  distinctly acuminate (1);  angular and craniodorsally oriented, distinctly flattened and distinguishable from rest of margo ventralis aut apex carinae (2);  noncomparable carina sterni or furcula absent (ratites, Dromornithidae) or where synostosis sternoclavicularis present (3).

Corpus sterni, facies muscularis sterni, linea intermuscularis dorsolateralis of origii m. supracoracoideus (new term), angulus dorsalis relative to axis craniocaudalis or chord of basis carinae (ordered)  : shallow, 30Â° > angulus, often approximately parallel (0);  moderate, 30Â° < angulus < 60Â° (1);  wide, 60Â° < angulus < 90Â° (2);  noncomparable by absence of carina et/aut lineae (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (3).

Carina sterni, margo cranialis carinae, crista mediana carinae, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, margo cranialis carinae rounded (0);  present, a modest cristula (1);  present, a prominent crista, extending significantly craniad to pila carinae (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Carina sterni, margo cranialis carinae, crista medialis carinae, tuberculum cristae medianae (new term), status (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, small, subrectangular (1);  present, large, subtriangular (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Carina sterni, margo cranialis carinae, sulcus carinae, foramen pneumaticum, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, orbiculate, variably restricted (1);  present, elongate-oblong, occupying much of sulcus carinae, admitting ansae tracheales intrasternales, and largely occluded cranially by torus-shaped membrana ossificans enclosing ansae (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Claviculae definitivae, status et forma generalis (unordered)  : absent in any form (0);  present, as ossified rudimenta, not sufficiently elongated ventrally to effect synostosis with margo lateralis of extremitas sternalis coracoidei (1);  present, ossified and complete, sensu having length permitting juncturae omalis et sternalis (2);  present, as ossified rudimentum aut vestigium as separate claviculae, either (i) typically attached to scapula et/aut coracoideum by sutura(e), and meeting but asynostotic, or (ii) represented by ligamentum aut cartilago corporis claviculae, with variably (3);  present, profoundly vestigial and (i) synostotic early in ontogeny with margo craniomedialis of os scapulocoracoideum, comprising pars omalis et (sometimes) pars sternalis, further obscured by membrana sternocoracoclavicularis ossificans, and positioned c (4).

Extremitas omalis claviculae, processus articularis claviculae (new term), comprising processes acrocoracoideus et acromialis claviculae, orientation relative to arcus corporis claviculae, forma (ordered)  : virtually identical, essentially a dorsal continuation of scapus (0);  distinct but limited, subangular, ventrocaudal departure (1);  conspicuously angled caudoventrad, typically involving marked angulus acrocoracoideus claviculae (new term) at point of maximal deviation (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae, Fregata) (3).

Extremitas omalis claviculae, processus acrocoracoideus claviculae, facies articularis acrocoracoidea, incisura aut fenestra subacrocoracoidea claviculae, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, incisura (1);  present, fenestra (2).

Extremitas omalis claviculae, facies caudolateralis, foramina et/aut recessus pneumaticus omalis caudolateralis (new term), status (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, foramina without distinct recessus (1);  present, moderately developed recessus, distinctly emarginate and well defined, enclosing foramina pneumatica (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas omalis claviculae, processus articularis claviculae (new term), comprising processes acrocoracoideus et acromialis claviculae, forma (unordered)  : unipartite---processus articularis subcylindrical and variably elongate, with terminus rounded, irregularly tubercular, angular, acuminate, or carinate (0);  bipartite and triangular---processus articularis confluent with scapus claviculae but scapus claviculae with terminus subtriangular with broad basis terminal and approximately equally expansive facies articulares at opposite vertices (1);  bipartite and bifurcate---processus articularis confluent with scapus claviculae, but scapus claviculae with terminus bifurcate with subtermina (i.e., facies articularis acrocoracoideus et acromialis) subcarinate (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Scapus (corpus) claviculae, craniocaudal curvature (lateral perspective) exclusive of extremitas omalis, forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, distinct, but weak to moderate (1);  present, pronounced, often approaching subcircular (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas sternalis claviculae, facies dorsalis, processus interclavicularis dorsalis (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, eminentia subspheroidalis (1);  present, tuberculum aut spina (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas sternalis claviculae, symphysis claviculae, facies ventralis, incisura symphysialis (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, as bilobate terminus (1);  present, largely concealed by incorporation within synostosis sternoclavicularis (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas cranialis (caput) scapulae, crista ligamentum acrocoraco-acromiali, status et forma (unordered)  : present, a laterally ``everted'' cristula (0);  absent or indiscernable from terminus acromialis per se (1);  present, a distinct, subacuminate or variably spatulate processus, laterally emarginate crista, or quasi-bilobate eminentia (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas cranialis (caput) scapulae, facies lateralis, sulcus supracoracoideus, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present, distinct but of only moderate depth (1);  present, exceptionally deep, often accentuated by curved acromion (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Corpus (scapus) scapulae, monotonic ventral curvature general to scapus (i.e., that described by [curvi]linear axis majoris scapulae), status et forma (unordered)  : absent, corpus scapulae essentially straight (0);  present, moderate, corpus et margo dorsalis scapulae slightly to moderately convex (1);  present, pronounced, corpus et margo dorsalis scapulae conspicuously convex (2).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus, status (unordered)  : absent (0);  rudimentary or vestigial within ossa coracoscapulares (1);  present (2);  present but distinctly (apparently secondarily) truncate, processus essentially limited to width accommodating facies articularis clavicularis (3).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus (tuberculum brachiale), dorsomedial curvature with respect to axis majoris coracoidei, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, angling or curvature obsolete, processus cranially aligned (0);  present, moderate medioventral inflection or angling (may be exaggerated by deep sulcus m. supracoracoideus) (1);  present, pronounced ventral angling, distinctly hamulate (2);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (3).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus, facies articularis clavicularis (medial perspective), comparatively expanded, planar, ellip tical lamina elliptica articularis (new term), status et orientation (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, principally dorsal (1);  present, principally lateral (2);  noncomparable (Fregata, Pelecanus) (3).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus, facies medialis, sulcus m. supracoracoideus, comparative lateromedial compression in planum transversus (ordered)  : weakly or not compressed, essentially circular, facies medialis inflated, cylindrical (0);  moderately compressed, subelliptical, with limited medial flattening (1);  strongly compressed, flattened-elliptical or sub- laminate, with deeply recessed facies medialis sulci (2);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus acrocoracoideus, facies medialis, margo caudalis, recessus infra-acrocoracoideus (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, single, either typus dorsalis or typus ventralis (1);  present, double by jugum or oriented lamina craniocaudally within sulcus m. supracoracoideus (2);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus procoracoideus (dorsal perspective), status and comparative prominence (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, rudimentary, an angulus, shallow cotyla, or cristula (1);  present, moderately prominent, a (typically curved) tuberculum, terminus proprius (exclusive of ancillary tuberculae) approximating margo medialis corporis (2);  present, an elongate processus verae, terminus proprius distinctly extending mediad et/aut dorsad to corpus, some manifesting former condition curving mediodorsad around margo medialis corporis (3);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (4).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus procoracoideus, caudoventral extension and con cavitas by elongate sulcus m. supracoracoideus, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, moderate (1);  present, deep (2);  noncomparable by absence of comparable processus (Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (3).

Extremitas omalis aut corpus coracoidei, processus procoracoideus, facies ventralis, foramen (incisura) nervi supracoracoidei et/aut pneumaticum, status et forma (unordered)  : absent, nervus centrally positioned and not intersecting element (0);  foramen (incisura) nervi supracoracoidei present, resulting from lateral displacement of nervus toward margo medialis coracoidei, but foramen pneumaticum absent and not providing access to internum ossis, some taxa possess foramen delimited medially only (1);  foramen nervi supracoracoidei et pneumaticum procoracoidei present, positioned comparatively craniad in base of processus procoracoideus, admitting access of diverticulum pneumaticum to internum ossis (2).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus procoracoideus, dorsoventral orientation with respect to plana transversa corporis (ordered)  : dorsal to corpus coracoidei (0);  subequal to that of corpus coracoidei (1);  ventral to corpus coracoidei (2);  noncomparable (ratites) (3).

Extremitas omalis coracoidei, processus procoracoideus, craniocaudal orientation relative to axis majoris et margo medialis of corpus (ordered)  : craniomedial, oblique to margo medialis, angulus cranialis acute (0);  medial, approximately perpendicular to margo medialis (1);  caudomedial, oblique to margo medialis, angulus cranialis obtuse (2);  noncomparable (ratites) (3).
Corpus coracoidei, facies dorsalis (exclusive of fossae pneumaticae), concavitas superficialis (ordered)  : planar or only weakly concave (0);  moderately concave (1);  deeply concave (2).

Corpus coracoidei, facies dorsalis, pori pneumatici aut foramen pneumaticum, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, pori pneumatici (1);  present, pori pneumatici within recessus or large foramen (2);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, crista articularis sternalis (sectiones medialis et lateralis), labrum interna, forma (unordered)  : smoothly curving (0);  interrupted by central fossa rugosa (1);  characterized by prominent circular fossa medialis (2).

Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, facies articularis sternalis, labrum externa, cranial extent of margo cranialis labri (and correlated cranial expanse) relative to those of labrum interna (ordered)  : former significantly cranial to latter, producing externally (ventrally) angled facies articularis (0);  former approximately equal to latter, producing facies articularis of dorsoventrally equal expanse (1);  former distinctly caudal to latter, producing internally (dorsally) angled facies articularis (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Opisthocomus) (3).

Extremitas sternalis coracoidei, crista articularis sternalis (sectiones medialis et lateralis), crista intermedia (caudal perspective), concavitas dorsalis cristae, status et comparative depth (ordered)  : present, deep (0);  present, shallow (1);  absent or obsolete, crista sublinear (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Junctura (symphysis) interclavicularis, i.e., medial conjoining of claviculae to form definitive furcula, status et typus (unordered)  : absent, claviculae (degree of ossification notwithstanding) are present but fail to join medially (0);  present, but claviculae and junctura (if present) remain cartilaginous or ligamentous (1);  present, claviculae are osseous, but junctura remains cartilaginous or ligamentous (2);  present, claviculae are osseous and medially synostotic (3);  noncomparable (most ratites, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (4).

Membrana sternocoracoclavicularis ossificans, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, moderately extensive, partially ossified (residua including spinae procoracoideae et spiculae mediocaudales coracoideae), spanning variably extensive regio medial to ossa coracoideum et scapula and investing to variable degree the claviculae, if (1);  present, very extensive, largely ossified, assuming some of structural and functional properties of diminutive processus procoracoideus (2);  noncomparable (Dromornithidae) (3).

Angulus juncturae (articularis) coracoscapularis, typus et modus (ordered)  : sublinear, approximating 180Â° (0);  obtuse, 90Â°--180Â°, typically approximating 135Â° with respect to planum facies articularis sternocoracoideus (1);  right, approximating 90Â° (2);  acute, less than 90Â° (3).

Ossa scapula et coracoideum---if synostostic, producing os scapulocoracoideum)---margo medialis, enclosure of small foramina or large fenestra within membrana sternocoracoclavicularis ossificans, status (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, including one or more comparatively small foramina (1);  present, including a single comparatively large fenestra, in part delimited by included clavicula vestigialis (2);  noncomparable in absence of synostosis coracoscapularis et/aut membrana ossificans (3).

Junctura (articulatio) sternocoracoidea, status et typus (unordered)  : articulatio plana aut squamata (0);  articulatio synovialis sellaris (1);  synostosis sternocoracoideus, in which margo cranialis, sulcus articularis coracoideus, is braced mediodorsally by narrow osseus, laminate pons, typically with open canalis ventralis (2);  synostosis sternocoracoideus, effected directly by lateromedial series of spiculae osseae between facies articulares (3).

Junctura omalis, os coracoideum lateral to impressio ligamenti acrocoracohumeralis and immediately ventrocaudal to cavitas glenoidalis (vestigium), i.e., eminentia articularis humeralis (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : present, prominent, and embedded within the membrana sternocoracoclavicularis ossificans in some taxa possessing os scapulocoracoideum (0);  present, mediolaterally compressed jugum (1);  absent or indistinguishable (2);  noncomparable where junctura acrocoracoclavicularis an articulatio (3);  State 23 (4).

Junctura procoraco-scapularis (new term), status et typus (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, gomphosis involving condylus scapularis et cotyla coracoidea (1);  present, articulatio (synovialis) cotylaris (2);  present, articulatio (synovialis) plana aut syndesmosis (3);  present, synostosis (4).
Junctura acrocoraco-acromialis, status et typus (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, articulatio plana aut syndesmosis (1);  present, broad synostosis (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornis) (3).
Junctura acromio-clavicularis, status et typus (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, articulatio synovialis aut syndesmosis (1);  present, synostosis (2).

Os humerus, proportion of total proximo- distal length relative to the transverse width of extremitas proximalis humeri, forma (ordered)  : former at least three times latter (0);  former two to three times latter (1);  former less than two times latter (2);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Os humerus, virtual linearity independent of relative elongation, status et forma (unordered)  : absent, curved (0);  present, linear, elongate (1);  present, linear, truncate (2);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, caput humeri, focus capitis humeri (new term) relative to axis proximodistalis humeri, forma dorsoventralis (ordered)  : slightly to moderately dorsal (0);  slightly or moderately ventral (1);  conspicuously ventral, beyond margo ventralis humeri (2);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis, caput humeri, incisura capitis, crista incisurae capitis distalis, depressio (tuberculum) insertii m. coracobrachialis caudalis (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present, depressio aut fovea, within crista incisurae (1);  present, tuberculum, in absence of crista (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, tuberculum ventrale (``internus''), forma generalis (unordered)  : triangular, often rounded (0);  rectangular, craniocaudally compressed and proximodistally elongate (1);  tubercular, great medial, subangular prominence, parallel or proximal to caput (2);  obsolete, associated with uniquely conformed and ventrally directed caput humeri (3);  noncomparable, ossa alae absent (Dinornithiformes) (4).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, tuberculum ventrale (``internus''), facies ancorae insertii muscularum (new term), principal orientation (unordered)  : caudal (0);  dorsal (1);  distal (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, caput humeri, tuberculum dorsale (``externus''), position relative to that of caput humeri (unordered)  : vertex of margines proximalis et dorsalis humeri, closely proximate with caput et crista deltopectoralis (0);  terminus proximalis of crista deltopectoralis, but well distal to caput and directly dorsal to approximate midpoint of fossa pneumotricipitalis (1);  margo caudalis corporis, immediately dorsal to fossa pneumotricipitalis and directly distal to caput humeri (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis (oblique caudal perspective), distal displacement and variably conspicuous dorsocranial elongation and hamulation, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or indistinct (0);  present, crista essentially acuminate (1);  present, crista extremely elongated, deeply hamulate processus (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis (oblique caudal perspective), forma facialis (unordered)  : concave, margo dorsalis oriented obliquely dorsocaudad (0);  planar (1);  convex, margo dorsalis oriented craniad (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis (oblique caudal perspective), maximal dorsal width relative to co-aligned diameter of adjacent corpus humeri, forma (ordered)  : crista narrower than corpus (0);  crista of equal breadth with corpus (1);  crista broader than corpus (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, angulus cristae aut tuberculum angulae (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent, margo cristae essentially rounded (0);  present, represented by simple but distinct angulus (1);  present, represented by tuberculum angulae (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies caudalis, crista deltopectoralis, impressio (cristula) m. supracoracoidei exclusive of situs ancorae tuberculae dorsale, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or indiscernable (0);  present, impressio, terminating proximad to basis cristae (1);  present, cristula, extending distad to basis cristae (2);  noncomparable (ratites) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista deltopectoralis, facies caudalis et/aut margo dorsalis, impressio (eminentia) insertii m. latissimi dorsi, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or indistinguishable (0);  present, indistinct impressio aut eminentia linearis (1);  present, prominent, sublinear, variably elongate ruga (2);  present, conspicuous, broad sulcus (3);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (4).
Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista bicipitalis, status (ordered)  : absent or rudimentary (0);  present, distinct (1);  present, but generally reduced (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies cranialis, crista bicipitalis, margines distalis et dorsalis (medianus), demarcation by shallow, narrow sulcus marginalis intumescentiae (new term) or distinct linea, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, limited to margo distalis intumescentiae (1);  present, includes margines distalis et dorsalis (medianus) intumescentiae (2);  noncomparable by absence (Dinornithiformes) or profound distortion of element (Aepyornis, Aptornis) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista bicipitalis, terminus distalis, lobus m. biceps (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, small or homologue indicated by angular eminentia (1);  present, large lobus or tuberculum (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, crista bicipitalis, terminus on corpus humeri, margo ventralis, forma (unordered)  : gradually continued by shallow, low but distinct jugum along corpus humeri, margo ventralis (0);  abruptly discontinued proximally on corpus humeri, margo ventralis (1);  abruptly discontinued, adorned by bulbus bicipitalis (new term) at terminus corporis (2);  noncomparable (ratites). Fossa pneumotricipitalis (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, fossa pneumotricipitalis relative to tuberculum ventrale, forma et situs (unordered)  : expansive over comparatively broad regio distodorsal to tuberculum (0);  limited to small ventral area on facies distalis of tuberculum ventrale (1);  restricted to recessus deep within incisura proximocraniad to basis tuberculum ventrale (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, fossa pneumotricipitalis (primus in taxa with duplex fossae) relative to corpus humeri (distal perspective), situs (unordered)  : ventrocaudal (0);  caudoventral, and approaching coplanarity with crista deltopectoralis (1);  strictly ventral, directly opposite basis cristae deltopectoralis (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Turnicidae) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, fossa pneumotricipitalis, partially occluding caudal (superficial) lamina marginis distalis fossae, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, occluding minority of atrium fossae (1);  present, occluding majority of atrium fossae (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies (palmaris) cranialis, planum intertuberculare, intumescentia humeri (proximal perspective), facies cranial- is, forma superficialis (ordered)  : convex (0);  (sub)planar (1);  concave, defining fossa on midline and making facies articularis proximalis appear valliform, i.e., chevroniform-concave or ``V-shaped'' (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies (palmaris) cranialis, sulcus ligamentosus transversus, status et forma sensu dorsoventral extent (ordered)  : absent or obsolete, at most suggested by shallow, abbreviate depressio or dorsally restricted fovea (0);  present, shallow and abbreviate, typically limited to (virtually entire) margo proximalis of facies bicipitalis and reaching midpoint of extremitas proximalis humeri, facies cranialis (1);  present, deep and long, extending dorsoventrally across extremitas proximalis humeri to intersect bases tuberculorum dorsale et ventrale humeri (2);  noncomparable (ratites) (3).

Extremitas proximalis humeri, facies (palmaris) cranialis, impressio m. coracobrachialis cranialis (emended term), deeply ovate and enclosed ostia pneumatici marginales, status impressiorum et poricium (unordered)  : absent, both forma et pori (0);  present, pori absent (1);  present, pori present (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Corpus humeri, bilateral compression or departure from essentially elliptical form (planum transversus), status (unordered)  : absent, elliptical, lacking notable flattening or bifacial compression throughout (0);  present, subelliptical with significant flattening or bifacial compression evident (typically craniocaudal) in a majority of the entirety of corpus (1);  present, strongly craniocaudally compressed, virtually laminate throughout (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Corpus humeri, margo ventralis, linea insertio m. latissimi dorsi (especially or solely pars caudalis), forma (ordered)  : linea aut impressio linearis, abbreviate (0);  eminentia aut sulcus, extensive (1);  cristula, extensive, elevated (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) or structural peculiarities (Aepyornis, Sphenisciformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies cranialis, condylus dorsalis humeri, apex termini condylae dorsalis, forma (unordered)  : rounded, sessile upon facies cranialis humeri, and gradually merging with facies cranialis humeri (0);  flattened or subrectangular (1);  cornuate, cranially elevated with apex undercut, and/or distinctly pointed (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies cranialis, condylus dorsalis humeri, proximal extent relative to margo distalis fossae m. brachialis, (ordered)  : condylus distal to fossa, and typically separated from margo distalis fossae m. brachialis by smooth area of bone from latter (0);  condylus (margo proximalis) typically extending at least proximad to margo distalis fossae m. brachialis (1);  condylus markedly proximal to fossa, including extremitates proximalis condylorum dorsalis et ventralis (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Aptornis, Sphenisciformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies cranialis, fossa m. brachialis, pori, foramina, aut fenestrae pneumaticae, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, but limited to pori aut foramina in margo distalis fossae (1);  present, involving comparatively numerous and large fenestrae (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, fossa m. brachialis (cranial perspective), dorsoventral position relative to axis medianus of corpus humeri (ordered)  : dorsal (0);  medial (1);  ventral (2);  noncomparable by absence of fossa (Struthio, Rhea, Apteryx) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, epicondylus dorsalis (ectepicondylus), status et forma sensu promimentia dorsalis (ordered)  : absent or virtually coplanar with facies dorsalis of extremitas dorsalis humeri, vertically intersecting curva terminalis condyli at vertex dorsodistalis of element (0);  present, moderately prominent, latter approximating one-half the transverse width of condylus ventralis (1);  present, prominent, latter distinctly exceeding one-half the transverse width of condylus ventralis, in some approaching equality (2);  noncomparable, ossa alae absent (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri et corpus humeri, epicondylus dorsalis (ectepicondylus), ancora origii m. deltoideus pars propatagialis (new term), pars cranialis, situs et forma (ordered)  : distal, a facet on epicondylus dorsalis (0);  subdistal, on cristula on margo dorsalis corporis shared with ancorae origii m. extensor digitorum communis (1);  distinctly proximal, on eminentia on margo dorsalis corporis distinct from more-distal ancorae origii m. extensor digitorum communis (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri et corpus humeri, epicondylus dorsalis (ectepicondylus), ancora origii m. extensor digitorum communis (new term), situs et forma (ordered)  : distal, a fovea on epicondylus dorsalis (0);  subdistal, a tuberculum proximal to epicondylus dorsalis (1);  subproximal, an elongate impressio or jugum on margo dorsalis corporis (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, processus flexorius, conspicuously elongate-triangular, caudal inflation, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, great (1);  present, exceptional (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies caudalis, fossa olecrani (and cranially delimiting condylus ventralis), situs dorsoventralis relative to midpoint of concavitas distalis of sulcus inter-epicondylaris caudalis (ordered)  : (ventro)medial---opposite (or only slightly ventral to) midpoint of concavitas, typically centered between sulci mm. humerotricipitis ventrad et scapulotricipitis dorsad (0);  medioventral---opposite ventral half of concavitas, pars ventralis of concavitas opposite terminus of sulcus m. humerotricipitis (1);  ventral---opposite margo ventralis of concavitas, pars medianus of concavitas opposite terminus of sulcus m. humerotricipitis, concavitas approximately opposite processus flexorius (2);  noncomparable by uniquely derived or absent elements (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) or absence of fossa (other ratites) (3).

Extremitas distalis humeri, facies caudalis, sulcus tendinis m. scapulotricipitalis, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, weakly defined, typically comparatively broad, shallow, and truncate (1);  present, conspicuously defined, typically comparatively narrow, deep, and elongate (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, cotyla dorsalis, forma (ordered)  : typical proportion or elongate (0);  distinctly diminutive, regressed toward olecranon (1);  regressed toward olecranon and with margo cranialis concave, narrowing cotyla dorsalis still further (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, cotyla dorsalis, facies articularis relative to cotyla ventralis, forma (ordered)  : less expansive (0);  subequal in expanse (1);  more expansive (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae, Sphenisciformes, Aptornis) (3).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, crista intercotylaris, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, proximal extent distinctly less than that of olecranon, a single cotylus evident (0);  rudimentary, crista indicated, but aspect exaggerated (extremitas proximalis apparently dominated by medial angularity) by sloping, depressed cotylae (1);  present, crista rudimentary but evident despite more typically conformed cotylae (2);  present, variably prominent, cotylae dorsalis et ventralis distinct (3);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (4).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, processus cotylaris dorsalis, crista intercotylaris, caudalmost orientation with respect to olecranon, forma (unordered)  : dorsal to olecranon, truncate, intersecting jugum linearis aut angularis transversus cranial to olecranon, thereby demarcating a facies comprising two cotylae cranially and one variably shaped area subolecrani (new term) caudodorsally, typically isolating (0);  dorsal to olecranon, elongate and continuous to terminus of extremitas proximalis ulnae (1);  toward olecranon (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Sphenisciformes, Aptornis) (3).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, margo interosseus (cranialis), impressio insertii m. brachialis, forma (ordered)  : impressio planum aut facies ancorae, margo proximocaudalis only (rarely) slightly elevated (0);  concavum modestus---moderately deep, with margo proximocaudalis or crista brachialis (new term) elevated only proximally, and typically not undercutting cotylae proximales (1);  concavum profundus---very deep, margo proximocaudalis or crista brachialis (new term) elevated for at least half of impressio, and typically undercutting cotylae proximales significantly (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae, Sphensciformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis ulnae, incisura radialis, accessory refinements for accommodation of radius, status et forma (unordered)  : absent or obsolete, incisura simple and comparatively shallow and/or restricted (0);  present, fovea or fossa of variable diameter and depth (1);  present, but limited to dorsoventrally bracing tuberositates, cristula, and/or facies articularis (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Sphenisciformes, Aptornis) (3).

Corpus ulnae, diameter (at midpoint) relative to that of corpus radii, expressed as multiplicative factor (ordered)  : similar, factor less than 1.25 (0);  moderately greater, factor 1.25--1.50 (1);  substantially greater, factor at least 1.50 (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Corpus ulnae, pronounced craniocaudal compression such that element assumes sublaminate shape, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, moderate (1);  present, pronounced (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Corpus ulnae, facies cranialis (dorsoventral perspective), margo interosseus (cranialis), forma superficialis (unordered)  : essentially linear or vaguely sigmoidal (0);  slightly concave, magnitude uniform or greater distally than proximally (1);  moderately concave, with concavity distinctly greater through proximal one-third of element (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Corpus radii, margines cranialis et caudalis, curvature or bowing, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, negligible or slight, approximately uniform (1);  present, moderate, more pronounced distally (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).
Extremitas distalis radii (distal perspective), forma transversa (unordered)  : subcylindrical (0);  subrectangular (1);  sublaminar (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis radii, facies ventralis, depressio ligamentosa, cristula(e) sulci longitudinales (new term), status, numerus et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, two (cranialis et caudalis), moderately conspicuous to very prominent (1);  present, three (cranialis, mediana, et caudalis), moderately prominent (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Os carpi ulnare, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, distinctly arcuate, effecting amplexus trochlearis (new term) comprising articulationes ulnocarpo- metacarpales ventrale et dorsale (1);  vestigial, cuneate, effecting articulationes planae (2);  obsolete, secondarily (3).

Os carpi ulnare, ramus ventralis (new term), facies proximoventralis, sulcus tendineus radioulnaris (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent or indistinct (0);  present, open sulcus throughout (1);  present, sulcus covered proximally by arcus, converting to partial canaliculis tendineus (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Os carpi ulnare, ramus ventralis (new term), forma (unordered)  : sublinear (0);  curved dorsally, acuminate (1);  curved dorsally, blunt (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Os carpi ulnare, relative lengths of ramus ventralis (new term) and ramus dorsalis (new term), forma (ordered)  : ventralis shorter than dorsalis (0);  ventralis (sub)equal to dorsalis (1);  ventralis distinctly longer than dorsalis (2);  noncomparable (ratites) (3).

Os carpi ulnare, facies cranialis aut margo proximalis incisurae, processus muscularis, status et forma (unordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, positioned away from margo incisurae, subtly developed (1);  present, positioned at margo incisurae, variably prominent (2);  noncomparable by absence or fundamental apomorphy of element (ratites) (3).

Os prominens, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, as comparatively small, variably ossified, simply shaped os sesamoideum (1);  present, as comparatively substantial, typically well-ossified, hamulate os sesamoideum (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Os metacarpale secundus (II, majus), typus (unordered)  : structurally distinguishable from ossa metacarpalia I et III, spatium intermetacarpale wide (0);  closely synchondrotic with ossa metacarpalia I et III, spatium intermetacarpale fissuriform (1);  closely synchondrotic with ossa metacarpalia I et III, spatium intermetacarpale obsolete or absent (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Os metacarpale tertius (III, minus), status (ordered)  : present during ontogeny and functional in adult (0);  present during ontogeny, but rendered indistinguishable in adult through synchondrosis, resulting in status definitivum as eminentia on basis metacarpale II or vestigium (1);  absent (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).
