Ossa metacarpalia minus (III, tertius) et ma- jus (II, secundus), corpus metacarpale, forma sensu relative lengths, primarily as reflected by relative distal extents of extremitates distales metacarpalia, facies articulares digitales (ordered)  : os metacarpale II equal to or longer than os metacarpale III (0);  os metacarpale II moderately shorter than os metacarpale III, extremitas distalis of latter typically curving craniad to terminate between ossa metacarpalia et phalanges (1);  os metacarpale II conspicuously shorter than os metacarpale III, extremitas distalis of latter typically extending steplike distad to former (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornis, Dinornithiformes, Apteryx, Aptornis) (3).

Os metacarpale majus (II, secundus), facies dorsalis, sulci tendinosi, pars proximalis (sulci tendinorum mm. extensor longus digiti majoris et extensor digitorum communis), forma superficialis sensu comparative proximodistal extent (ordered)  : obsolete, facies dorsalis essentially unmarked (0);  present, extent limited to distal one-half of corpus (1);  present, extending for almost or actually the entire corpus, in some taxa distally prominent and forming pons aut arcus osseum (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis carpometacarpi, os metacarpale alulare, proximodistal length relative to that of digitus alularis (ordered)  : longer (0);  approximately equal (1);  smaller (2);  noncomparable by absence of ossa alae (Dinornithiformes), absence of digitus alulae (Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas proximalis carpometacarpi, processus alularis, processus extensorius, status et cranial extent (ordered)  : absent or rudimentary (0);  present, evidently functional, but extending marginally beyond margo cranialis of processus alularis (1);  present, evidently functional, comparatively prominent, processus exceeds facies articularis by at least one-half width of latter (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae) (3).

Extremitas proximalis carpometacarpi (new term), trochlea carpalis, comparative dorsoventral profile (craniocaudal perspective) of rima dorsalis (externum) et rima ventralis (internum), forma (ordered)  : distinctly flattened, virtually planar (0);  intermediate, with shallow sulcus trochlearis between rimae (1);  distinctly sulcoid, with prominent sulcus trochlearis between rimae (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Apteryx) (3).

Extremitas proximalis carpometacarpi, trochlea carpalis, facies articularis ulnocarpalis, rima dorsalis trochlearis (new term) relative to that of rima ventralis trochlearis (caudal perspective), terminus distalis, situs proximodistalis (ordered)  : slightly proximad or subequal, former only slightly proximal to latter, or termina of rimae approximately equal in distal extent (0);  moderately proximad, but extending at least (or approximately) half the distance distad as rima ventralis trochlearis (1);  well proximad, extending less than half as distad as rima ventralis trochlearis (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromaiidae, Casuariidae, Apteryx, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (3).

Extremitas proximalis carpometacarpi, os metacarpale minus (III), proximal to synchondrosis intermetacarpalis proximalis (emended term), fossa pneumatica, status et situs (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, on facies cranialis et/aut vertex of synchondrosis (1);  present, on facies caudalis of os metacarpale III distad to synchondrosis (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).
Extremitas proximalis carpometacarpi, facies ventralis, processus pisiformis, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  rudimentary (1);  present (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis et collum carpometacarpalia, facies ventralis, synchondrosis intermetacarpalis proximalis and associated manifestation of jugum metacarpo-pisiformis (new term), situs relative to processus pisiformis (ordered)  : well distal to processus pisiformis, jugum absent (0);  immediately distal or extending to processus pisiformis, jugum rudimentary or vestigial (1);  coincident, synchondrosis of os metacarpale minus continuous with processus pisiformis, jugum metacarpo-pisiformis (new term) present (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (3).

Extremitas proximalis carpometacarpi, facies dorsalis, fossa (sulcus) supra-extensorius (new term), status  : absent (0);  present, apneumatic (1);  present, enclosing fossa et/aut foramen pneumatica (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis carpometacarpi, fovea carpalis caudalis, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or negligibly defined (0);  present, shallow to moderately deep (1);  present, markedly deep, ovate (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Corpus carpometacarpi, os metacarpale minus (III), facies ventralis, pars proximalis, eminentia retinaculum flexorium of aponeurosis ventralis (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, impressio or indistinct eminentia (1);  present, distinct tuberculum or cristula (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromaiidae, Casuariidae, Apteryx, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (3).

Corpus carpometacarpi, os metacarpale minus, angulus distalis with symphysialis intermetacarpalis distalis, forma (ordered)  : shallowly acute, with os metacarpale minus comparatively proximate and parallel and joining os metacarpale majus in narrow osseus corpus symphysialis (0);  moderately acute, with os metacarpale minus moderately proximate and subparallel (1);  subperpendicular, curving sharply to unite with symphysis intermetacarpalis distalis (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Corpus carpometacarpi, os metacarpale minus, margo caudalis, angulus caudodistalis, apical adornment including rectangular margo, causing ``squaring'' of angulus caudally and proximal to facies articularis digiti minoris, regardless of magnitude of angulus per se, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  rudimentary (1);  present (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis carpometacarpi, pars symphysialis intermetacarpalis distalis (new term), facies ventralis, sulcus interosseus ventralis, forma (unordered)  : comparatively long proximodistally, lacking ventral curvature (0);  comparatively short proximodistally, lacking notable ventral curvature (1);  comparatively short proximodistally, manifesting prominent ventral curvature (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Extremitas distalis carpometacarpi (os metacarpale majus), facies ventralis, margo cranialis (facies articularis digitalis major, vertex ventrocranialis), eminentia tendineus (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, moderately prominent (1);  present, very prominent (2);  noncomparable by general form (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) or confounding with calcar (Anhimidae) (3).

Phalanges proximalis et intermedia digiti II (majus, secundus) manus, forma corporis (planum transversus), especially regarding dorsoventral compression, forma (unordered)  : subcylindrical to subtriangular (0);  distinctly dorsoventrally compressed, but retaining pila cranialis or related differential robustness (1);  strongly dorsoventrally flattened and craniocaudally expanded, lacking pila cranialis (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Phalanx proximalis digiti II (majus, secundus) manus, extremitas proximalis phalangealis, margo cranialis, facies articularis metacarpalis, tuberculum articularis metacarpalis (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent, facies articularis planar (0);  present, variably prominent tumulus or tuberculum (1);  present, uniquely elongated, medially concave processus, continuous proximally with facies articularis metacarpalis (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Phalanx proximalis digiti II (majus, secundus) manus, extremitas distalis phalangis, margo caudalis, tuberculum insertii tendinis m. interosseus ventralis (new term), forma apicalis (unordered)  : acuminate---includes tubercular or obsolete conditions (0);  carinate---cum jugum aut lobus caudalis (new term) (1);  hamulate---cum hamulus caudalis (new term) (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Phalanx ungualis digiti (majoris, secundus) II, unguis, status et forma (ordered)  : present, robust and (if present) larger than phalanx ungualis alularis (0);  present, but vestigial and (if present) distinctly smaller than phalanx ungualis alularis (1);  absent (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Articulatio metacarpophalangealis alulae, approximate position with respect to facies cranialis ossis metacarpale II (in repose), angulus (ordered)  : parallel (approximating 0Â°), alula essentially parallel to ossa metacarpalia, associated with facies articularis phalangealis perpendicular to axis majoris phalangis alularis (0);  diagonal (approximating 45Â°), alula approaching diagonality with respect to ossa metacarpalia, associated with facies articularis phalangealis spheroidal and subdiagonal to axis majoris phalangis alularis (1);  perpendicular (approximating 90Â°), alula approaching perpendicularity with respect to ossa metacarpalia, associated with facies articularis phalangealis approximately diagonal to axis majoris phalangis alularis (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Dromaiidae, Casuariidae, Apteryx) (3).

Junctura metacarpophalangealis digiti majoris, status et typus (unordered)  : articulatio condylaris (0);  synostosis, phalanx proximalis distinct but significantly truncated (1);  synostosis, phalanx proximalis vestigial or indiscernable (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Junctura metacarpophalangealis digiti minoris, status et typus (ordered)  : articulatio condylaris (0);  synostosis, phalanx proximalis distinct but significantly truncated (1);  synostosis, phalanx proximalis vestigial or indiscernable (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Articulatio interphalangealis lateralis ma- nus, status (unordered)  : present, elements attached by ligamentum interosseum (0);  absent, phalanges digiti minoris united by synostosis to phalanges digiti majoris (1);  absent, phalanges digiti minoris evidently lost (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Synostosis metacarpophalangealis alulae, in combination with other synostoses metacarpopha langeales and phalangis alularis, status vestigialis (unordered)  : absent, despite retention of both phalanges alulae in many taxa (0);  present (1);  present, shared by synostosis metacarpophalangealis alularis involving both ossa metacarpalia alulare et majus (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (3).

Junctura interphalangealis (proximalis) digiti majoris manus, typus (unordered)  : articulatio trochlearis (0);  articulatio (synovialis) subspheroidal aut tubercular (1);  articulatio (synovialis) plana (2);  synchondrosis (3);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes, Aptornis) (4).

Ala (pars) postacetabularis ilii, facies dorsalis, synsacrum, elements immediately caudal to acetabula and adjacent to vertebrae thoracicae, depressio iliosynsacralis dorsalis (new term), status (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, forming lateromedially narrow depressio along midline of synsacrum, and including comparatively ventral, planar state of crista spinosa synsacri (1);  present, partitioned medially by elevated crista spinosa synsacri, forming bilateral pair of sulcuslike depressiones in regio (2).

Acetabulum, foramen acetabuli, orientation (angulus) of vector through acetabulae (ordered)  : perpendicular to axis majoris synsacri (0);  moderately caudally angled such that vector transacetabularis intersects facies lateralis synsacri immediately caudal to rima caudalis of foramen acetabuli (1);  conspicuously caudally angled such that vector transacetabularis intersects facies lateralis synsacri at least one acetabular diameter caudal to rima caudalis of foramen acetabuli, and that processes transverses et costales of vertebrae acetabulares inste (2).

Sulcus antitrochantericus (corpus ilii), status et forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, distinct, but comparatively shallow and caudally abbreviated (1);  present, conspicuous, and deep (typically cum concavitas ventral to angulus craniolateralis ilii or encompassing entire area between processus trochantericus et crista spinosa synsacri) and often caudally extensive (2).

Concavitas (sulcus) infracristalis (facies lateralis), comparative depth (ordered), forma  : obsolete (0);  moderate (1);  substantial, typically including significantly overhanging, often lateroventrally slanting crista dorsolateralis ilii (2);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes) (3).

Foramen ilioischiadicum (if caudally delimited), craniocaudal extent within concavitas infracristalis, status definitivum (ordered)  : encompasses at least cranial one-half of concavitas caudal to acetabulum limited to cranial one-half but exceeding one- third of concavitas caudal to acetabulum (0);  limited to cranial one-third or less of concavitas caudal to acetabulum (1);  noncomparable by hiatus caudalis fenestrae (nonavialian Therapoda; palaeognathous Neornithes) (2).
Fossa renalis (par[te]s unspecified), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, variably shallow (1);  present, deep (2).

Fossa renalis, pars ischiadica fossae, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, rudimentary or vestigial, processes costales of caudalmost vertebrae thoracicae synsacri not markedly ventral to corpora of vertebrae eusacrales, and/or cristae iliaca obliqua (laterally) et iliaca inter- media (caudally) only indistinctly demarc (1);  present, expansive, processes costales of caudal- most vertebrae thoracicae synsacri markedly ventral to corpora of vertebrae eusacrales, and/or cristae iliaca obliqua (laterally) et iliaca intermedia (caudally) distinctly demarcate the limits of subfossa (2).

Fossa renalis, pars ischiadica fossae, vertex caudolateralis (craniolateral to corpus ilii, crista iliaca intermedia, if present), depressio, recessus, aut fovea (typically enclosing pori pneumatici), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, as depressio aut recessus (1);  present, as fovea (2);  noncomparable by absence of crista intermedia (ratites, Dromornithidae, Aptornis) (3).

Fossa renalis, pars pudenda fossae, craniolateral vertex (i.e., cranial terminus of recessus iliacus caudolateral to corpus ilii, crista iliaca intermedia, if present), ovoid depressio (enclosing pori pneumatici) aut fovea, status (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, as depressio aut recessus (1);  present, as fovea (2);  noncomparable (most ratites) (3).

Fossa renalis, recessus caudalis fossae, enclosed pori aut foramina pneumatica, status aut numerus modalis (unordered)  : absent, devoid of pori aut foramina (0);  present, comparatively few, minute pori pneumatici (1);  present, comparatively many pori and/or large formina pneumatica (2);  noncomparable where recessus absent or obsolescent (see status) (3).

Incisura caudalis pelvis, lateromedial width (defined as that between processes margines caudales) relative to that of extremitas caudalis synsacri, forma (ordered)  : obsolete, delimiting processes almost articulate medially, incisura essentially comprising width of extremitas caudalis synsacri and bilateral processes margines caudales, in which incisura at terminus caudalis of sutura iliosynsacralis obsolete (0);  limited to moderate, width of incisura between once and twice that of extremitas caudalis synsacri (1);  expansive, width of incisura at least twice that of extremitas caudalis synsacri (2);  noncomparable because of form of margo caudalis pelvici (Aepyornis, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Incisura marginis caudalis, (dorsoventral) height relative to diameter foraminis acetabulae (ordered)  : absent or obsolete, lamina infracristalis et margo dorsalis ilii lacking defined incisura (0);  present, narrow, maximal dorsoventral height no greater than diameter of foramen acetabuli (1);  present, wide, maximal dorsoventral height greater than diameter of foramen acetabuli (2).

Processus marginis caudalis, status et forma (unordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, but of limited prominence, often manifested as rounded eminentia (1);  present, prominent, but imbedded as pila within membrana ossificans (2);  noncomparable palaeognathous Neornithes) (3).

Tuberculum preacetabulare (processus pectinealis), status et forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  small tuberculum, torus, or area rugositas (1);  elongate processus, terminus ventral to margo dorsalis acetabulae (2).

Ala (pars) preacetabularis ilii, facies dorsalis, margo dorsomedialis, cristae iliacae dorsales, synostosis dorsomedialis forming carina iliacae dorsales (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : present, carina distinct and synostotic (0);  present, rudimentary or vestigial, cristae dorsally prominent and approach medially, but clearly separated from crista spinosa synsacri by variably narrow but distinct sulci iliosynsacrales (1);  absent, cristae limited to ventral lamina not approaching medially, typically exposing fenestrae intertransverariae (2).

Ala (pars) preacetabularis ilii, facies dorsalis, margo medialis et crista iliaca dorsalis, bilateral compression, medial proximity, elevation, and synostosis between cranial vertebrae sacrales, cristae spinosae (unordered)  : margines et cristae synostotic (0);  cristae articulate without synostosis, excluding limited interpolation of trabeculae osseae (1);  cristae do not articulate, but remain straight, elevated, and medially appressed (2);  cristae do not articulate, remain straight, but are not elevated and do not approach medially (3).

Ala (pars) preacetabularis ilii, with respect to planum transversum synsacri, angulus (unordered)  : subvertical, wherein alae approach perpendicularity with respect to planum transversum synsacri, i.e., margines dorsales approximately strictly dorsal to margines laterales (0);  oblique, wherein alae approximate subdiagonality with respect to planum transversum synsacri, i.e., slope obliquely with margines dorsales mediodorsal to margines laterales (1);  subhorizontal, where alae approximate coplanarity with planum transversum synsacri, i.e., margines dorsales approximately strictly medial to margines laterales (2).

Ala (pars) preacetabularis ilii, facies dorsalis, margo cranialis (dorsal perspective), dorsal coverage of synsacrum, forma (ordered)  : subobsolete, synsacrum apparently exposed throughout (0);  incomplete or reduced, margo cranialis caudal to first (cranialmost) vertebra thoracica synsacralis (first element in sectio I of Boas 1934), exposing corpus vertebrae and dorsal fenestra intertransversaria (1);  extensive to complete, with synsacrum concealed by ala (pars) preacetabularis ilii (2).

Ala (pars) preacetabularis ilii, facies dorsalis, margines cranialis et lateralis, conspicuous lateroangular expansions, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, simple unilaminate expansion without cranially oriented tuberculum on margo cranialis of margines dorsales iliorum (1);  present, comparatively elaborate bilaminate expansion including cranially oriented tuberculum on margo cranialis of margines dorsales iliorum (2).

Ala (pars) preacetabularis ilii, facies dorsalis, margines medialis et lateralis (dorsal perspective), throughout expanse from extremitas cranialis caudad to processus antitrochantericus, forma alae (ordered)  : distinctly convex, craniocaudally aligned margo lateralis (0);  essentially linear, craniocaudally aligned margo lateralis (1);  deeply concave, craniocaudally curved margo lateralis (2).

Pars acetabularis ilii, facies lateralis, recessus preacetabularis pneumaticus ilii (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, perforated by pori pneumatici (1);  present, perforated by pori pneumatici et single, irregular margined, moderately large foramen pneumaticum (2).

Pars acetabularis ilii, facies ventralis, crista iliaca intermedia, status et forma (unordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  distinct, sublaminar (1);  prominent, laminar (2);  noncomparable (most palaeognathous Neornithes) (3).

Ala (pars) postacetabularis ilii, crista dorsolateralis ilii, pronounced ventral curvature to approach or contact processus terminalis ischii, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, approaching only (1);  present, contacting (2).

Ala (pars) postacetabularis ilii, facies dorsalis, crista iliaca dorsolateralis, vertex craniolateralis (new term) craniocaudalis relative to processus antitrochantericus, situs (ordered)  : caudodorsal (0);  dorsal (1);  craniodorsal (2);  noncomparable (Apteryx, Fregata, Phaethon) (3).

Ala (pars) postacetabularis ilii, facies lateralis, lamina infracristalis ilii, concavitas infracristalis, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or barely discernable (0);  distinct, shallow to moderately deep (1);  conspicuous, extremely deep, typically extending from dorsum of foramen ilioischiadicum caudad to margo caudalis pelvici (2);  noncomparable (ratites) (3).

Alae preacetabulares et postacetabulares ilii, facies dorsalis, relative craniocaudal lengths, indexed by ratio of length of former divided by length of latter (ordered)  : ala preacetabularis distinctly greater in craniocaudal length than ala postacetabularis, ratio significantly greater than unity (0);  ala preacetabularis approximately equal in craniocaudal length to ala postacetabularis, ratio approximately unity (1);  ala preacetabularis less in craniocaudal length than ala postacetabularis, ratio significantly less than unity (2).

Extremitates postacetabulares ischii et pubici, dorsoventral expansion of angulus (exclusive of membrana ilioischiadica ossificans) relative to axis majoris synsacri and associated expansion of incisura ilioischiadica (unordered)  : present, pronounced, angulus subdiagonal (0);  present, magnitude intermediate (1);  absent, extremitates postacetabulares ischii et pubici subparallel with extremitas postacetabularis ilii (2).

Corpus ischii, pars acetabularis ischii, facies synchondrosis ischiopubica caudalis (new term), forma (unordered)  : width essentially uniform with that of corpus ischii, facies equivalent to terminus of corpus ischii (0);  facies elongate and comprising margo ventralis of caudally arcuate corpus ischii, resulting in considerably elongate (wide) synchondrosis (1);  markedly expanded (rostro)caudally, significantly widening synchondrosis (2).

Corpus ischii, pars acetabularis ischii, facies ventralis, extreme bilateral compression with elements separated medially by one or two, disproportionately broad processes transverses of corresponding number of associated, caudalmost vertebrae thoracicae synsacrales, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, separation involves single modified vertebra (1);  present, separation involves two modified vertebrae (2).

Scapus ischii, facies (perspective) lateralis, forma dorsoventralis (unordered)  : present, margo ventralis ischii concave, corpus decurved (0);  obsolete, corpus ischii essentially linear (1);  present, margo ventralis ischii convex, corpus recurved (2).

Corpus ischii, facies lateralis, margo dorsalis (pubica), distinct ventral curvature or angulation toward synlateral os pubis, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, ala approximately linear or only slightly curved (0);  present, ala distinctly but comparatively gradually, monotonically curved, and typically extended ventrocaudad to unite by synchondrosis ischiopubica along margo ventralis of processus terminalis ischii (1);  present, ala sharply angled ventrad at approximate midpoint, and typically extended ventrocaudad to unite by synchondrosis ischiopubica along margo ventralis or caudalis of processus terminalis ischii (2).

Ala ischii, processus terminalis ischii, caudal extent relative to that of ala postacetabularis ilii (ordered)  : substantially or only moderately greater in caudal extent than ala postacetabularis ilii, margo lateralis, crista iliaca dorsolateralis, processus (spina) dorsolateralis ilii, creating typical oblique margo pelvici (0);  approximately equal in caudal extent, resulting in approximately rectangular margo in lateral perspective (1);  conspicuously less in caudal extent than ala postacetabularis ilii, margo lateralis, crista iliaca dorsolateralis, processus (spina) dorsolateralis ilii (2).
Ala ischii, caudal extent relative to that of scapus (corpus) pubis (ordered)  : less (0);  approximately equal (1);  distinctly greater (2).

Scapus (corpus) pubis (lateral perspective), margo dorsalis, processus (tuberculum) obturatorius or completion of caudal closure of foramen obturatum ischiopubicum (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  distinct tuberculum (1);  tuberculum included within margo caudalis foraminis (2).

Apex pubis, axis majoris (lateral perspective), angulus dorsoventralis relative to axis majoris of subtending scapus pubis, forma (unordered)  : craniodorsal (0);  straight, i.e., essentially a simple caudal extension (1);  cranioventral (2).

Apex pubis, facies lateralis (dorsal perspective), lateromedial curvature relative to scapus pubis, forma lateromedialis (ordered)  : negligible lateromedial departure from scapus (0);  slightly or moderately medial (1);  strongly medial, subtransverse (2).

Junctura (sutura) iliosynsacralis between margines cranialis et caudalis iliorum (dorsal perspective), forma definitiva (unordered)  : ``leptolinear,'' suturae parallel and separated by extremely to moderately narrow spatium (0);  ``vasiform,'' narrow cranially---typically concealing fenestrae intertransversariae (dorsal perspective), widening to angular maximum between acetabulae, and gradually narrowing to various degrees caudad from maximum (1);  ``platylinear,'' suturae (sub)parallel and well separated throughout (2).

Extremitas proximalis femoris (especially trochanter et collum femoris), pronounced craniocaudal compression, status et magnitudo (ordered)  : absent or negligible, craniocaudal depth of trochanter approximately twice as great as that of caput femoris (0);  present, moderately pronounced, craniocaudal depth of trochanter less than 50% greater that of caput femoris (1);  present, prominent, craniocaudal depth of trochanter approximately equal to that of caput femoris (2).

Extremitas proximalis femoris, caput femoris, facies articularis acetabularis, incisura rimae acetabularis (new term) evidently serving as situs semistasis articulationis femoro-acetabularis, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, single and craniodorsal, evidently accommodating the laterally splayed resting position of the femora (1);  present, double (dorsal et craniodorsal), evidently accommodating the laterally splayed resting and foraging positions of the femora (2).
Extremitas proximalis femoris, collum femoris, facies ventralis, pori et striae pneumaticae, numerus per area (ordered)  : absent (0);  sparse (1);  numerous (2).

Extremitas proximalis femoris, trochanter (cranialis) femoris, crista trochantericus, forma (unordered)  : indistinct, crista obsolete, facies lateralis rounded, and craniocaudal depth subequal to that of caput (0);  distinct but comparatively modest, facies lateralis subrectangular in aspect but lacking notable crista and craniocaudal depth minimally greater than caput (1);  moderately developed, crista trochantericus moderately well developed craniad and/or proximad, moderately deeper craniocaudad than caput (2);  very prominent, crista trochantericus conspicuously elevated dorsad (proximad) and craniad, typically subtended by concavitates subcristulares (new term) or extensively concave facies articularis antitrochantericus (especially fossa trochanteris), and ele (3).

Extremitas proximalis femoris, trochanter (cranialis) femoris (cf. ``greater trochanter''), facies caudalis, margo lateralis, situs (tumulus aut impressio) insertii m. obturatorius lateralis (externus aut caudalis), forma generalis (ordered)  : prominent tumulus (0);  moderately large boss (1);  variably discernable impressio (2);  noncomparable (Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis femoris, trochanter femoris (cf. ``greater trochanter''), fossa trochanteris et crista trochantericus, pars dorsalis (proximalis) cristae (new term), facies medialis, forma (ordered)  : distinctly concave, forming typical fossa trochanteris (0);  slightly concave or essentially planar, merging indistinctly with facies articularis antitrochanterica (1);  convex, virtually continuous with facies articularis antitrochanterica or margo lateralis cristae rounded (2).

Extremitas proximalis femoris, trochanter femoris, situs insertii m. iliotrochantericus caudalis, forma (unordered)  : deep, irregularly shaped fossa (0);  variably elevated, broadly crescentiform impressio (1);  broad, slightly elevated, irregular area (2).
Corpus femoris, forma areae transversa (unordered)  : subcircular (0);  oval, mediolaterally compressed (1);  distinctly oval, craniocaudally compressed (2).

Corpus femoris, facies caudalis, lineae intermusculares, status, prominence, conformation, and inclusion of central eminentia (ordered)  : lineae musculares prominent, bifurcatio lineae proximally positioned, eminentia (impressio muscularis linearis) positioned medially et proximally (0);  lineae musculares prominent, eminentia (impressio muscularis linearis) et bifurcatio lineae positioned centrally et proximally (1);  lineae musculares, bifurcatio lineae et eminentia (impressio muscularis linearis) indistinct (2).

Extremitas distalis femoris, condylus lateralis, crista tibiofibularis, distal extent relative to condylus medialis (ordered)  : subequal to condylus medialis (0);  moderately but consistently distal to condylus medialis (1);  distinctly and (typically) significantly distal to condylus medialis (2).

Extremitas distalis femoris, condylus lateralis, impressio (fovea) tendinis origii m. tibialis cranialis (new term), status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, variably distinct fovea (1);  present, deep fovea (2);  present, moderate or deep sulcus (3).

Extremitas distalis femoris, condylus lateralis, trochlea fibularis, terminus proximocaudalis trochlearis, fovea trochlearis (new term), forma (ordered)  : trochlea terminates as sulcus that is comparatively uniform or monotonically divergent throughout (0);  trochlea terminates as sulcus distinguished by marked widening or divergence of delimiting cristae (1);  trochlea terminates in fovea trochlearis (new term), amplified by enclosed, terminal depressio in expanded area (2);  noncomparable (Aepyornithiformes, Dinornithiformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis femoris, facies caudalis (caudal perspective), condylus lateralis, width (lateromedial) relative to that of condylus medialis femoris, forma (ordered) a. lateralis significantly wider  : condyli subequal (0);  lateralis significantly narrower, typically by lateral extension of latter (1);  State 2 (2).

Extremitas distalis femoris, facies caudalis, condylus lateralis, crista tibiofibularis, caudal extent relative to that of condylus medialis femoris (ordered)  : distinctly greater (0);  subequal (1);  distinctly less (2).

Extremitas distalis femoris, fossa poplitea, forma (ordered)  : very shallow, weakly delimited (0);  distinct, enclosing moderate number of foveae et/aut pori (1);  distinct, enclosing numerous foveae et/aut pori (2).

Extremitas distalis femoris, fossa poplitea, enclosure of pori et/aut foveae pneumatici, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, lacking foveae et/aut pori, imperforate exclusive of proximomedial cluster of foramina and single distal foramen profundus, apparently neurovascular and universally distributed among Aves (0);  present, enclosing moderate number of foveae et/aut pori (1);  present, enclosing numerous foveae et/aut pori (2).

Patella (sesamoidea patellares), numerus modalis et forma (unordered)  : one, variably substantial sesamoideum (0);  two or three, irregular cuneate calculae (1);  several, irregularly shaped ossiculae, flattened in planum tendinis (2);  two, distinct ossiculae (3);  noncomparable by absence of patella (Tinamidae, Puffinus, Pelecanoides, Heliornithidae, Rostratula) (4).

Patella, association with ligamentum patellae or tendo patellae ossificans, status et forma (unordered)  : absent, essentially independent or only weakly constrained (0);  present, associated with robust ligamentum patellae (1);  present, co-ossified with robust tendo patellae ossificans (2);  present, associated with abbreviate ligamentum patellae (3);  noncomparable by absence of patella (Tinamidae, Puffinus, Pelecanoides, Heliornithidae, Rostratula) (4).
Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, area intercondylaris, forma (ordered)  : obsolete (0);  weakly defined (1);  comparatively distinct (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, facies articularis lateralis, forma generalis (unordered)  : enlarged, often irregularly shaped, subtuberculum, substantially more prominent proximally than facies articularis medialis, especially adjacent to area intercondylaris (0);  globular or subspheroidal, moderately more prominent proximally than facies articularis medialis (1);  dorsally reduced, subequal in proximal prominence to facies articularis medialis (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, cristae cnemiales, crista cnemialis cranialis (``internal'' cnemial crest), proximal extent, forma (ordered)  : obsolete, barely extending proximad to facies articulares tibiotarsales (0);  moderately prominent, distinct from surrounding facies articulares and extending a distinct but limited distance proximad, cranial extent typically greater than proximal (1);  exceptionally prominent, crista extending proximad to facies articularis at least one-third of length of corpus tibiotarsi (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, cristae cnemiales cranialis et lateralis, margines proximodorsales, vertex cristae (new term), distinct lateral hamulation of (primarily) crista cnemialis cranialis, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, intermediate prominence, largely limited to cranial (subterminal) portion of crista (1);  present, exceptional prominence, involving crista from extremitas cranialis to terminus proximodorsalis (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, cristae cnemiales cranialis et lateralis, intersection of margines on facies cranialis tibiotarsi forming sulcus intercristalis, pars profundus, forma (unordered)  : crista lateralis uniting with corpus distinctly lateral to (perpendicular) line of union for crista medialis, delimiting a comparatively broad sulcus intercristalis (0);  crista lateralis uniting with corpus virtually coincidentally with (perpendicular) line of union for crista medialis, forming a subperpendicular intersection of plana cristae, and delimiting a comparatively narrow sulcus intercristalis (1);  crista lateralis joining crista cranialis well cranial to basis cristae for latter, thereby sharing common basis cristae cnemiales (new term), and crista lateralis appearing as large tuberculum (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, crista cnemialis cranialis, craniodistal continuation of margo cranialis ligamenti by fascia aut tendo ossificans as lamina, linea extensoria, aut arcus distalis cristae (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, limited to variably extensive osseous remnants (1);  present, consolidated to form lamina aut arcus (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, crista cnemialis cranialis, jugum cristae (new term) on facies cranialis of corpus tibiotarsi relative to crista fibularis, forma (ordered)  : present, terminus entirely proximal to crista fibularis (0);  present, terminus between terminus proximalis and midpoint of crista (1);  present, terminus distal to midpoint of crista fibularis (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, crista cnemialis lateralis including jugum cristae (new term), situs corporis tibiotarsi (ordered)  : distinctly aligned along axis oblique and intermediate to axis majoris corporis and margo lateralis corporis, jugum cristae slanting mediad to margo medialis of crista fibularis (0);  slightly oblique with respect to axis majoris, subparallel (1);  principally aligned with margo lateralis of corpus tibiotarsi et crista fibularis and comparatively linear in orientation (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, cristae cnemiales cranialis et lateralis, comparative distal extents on corpus tibiotarsi, forma (ordered)  : crista cranialis terminating distinctly distad to crista lateralis (0);  cristae subequal in distal extent (typically truncate), both lacking jugae (1);  crista lateralis terminating distinctly distad to crista cranialis (2);  noncomparable (Phaethon, Pterocles, Caprimulgiformes, Apodiformes) (3).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, cristae cnemiales cranialis et lateralis, apparent ``torsion'' of cristae relative to facies cranialis of corpus tibiotarsi as reflected by relative positions of cristae et sulcus intercristalis (unordered)  : crista lateralis lateral in position, cranialis craniomedial, sulcus obliquely slanting distolaterad (0);  crista lateralis craniolateral in position, cranialis (cranio)medial, sulcus approaching cranial exposure (1);  crista lateralis laterocranial in position, cranialis medial (medial cristula frequent distally), sulcus cranial in exposure, medially positioned, and subtriangular in form delimited by intersection of cristae cnemiales (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, crista cnemialis lateralis, crista patellaris, proximal extent relative to caput tibiotarsi, facies articulares, forma (ordered)  : former exceptionally proximad to latter (0);  former well proximad to latter, defining distinct fossa(e) retropatellaris(es) caudally (1);  former subequal to latter (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, fossa flexoria (craniocaudal perspective), altitudo lateromedialis (ordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  comparatively shallow (1);  comparatively deep (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, facies (gastrocnemialis) medialis (medial perspective), forma superficialis (unordered)  : concave, frequently an oblique sulcus (0);  concave distally, convex proximally (1);  (sub)planar (2).
Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, fossae retropatellares, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, shallow (1);  present, deep (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, fossa retropatellaris, ostia pneumatica--- recessus et/aut foramina (pori) pneumatici---status et forma  : absent, neither recessus nor separate foramina/ pori evident (0);  present, limited to foramina et/aut pori (1);  present, recessus enclosing foramina et/aut pori (2).

Extremitas proximalis tibiotarsi, caput tibiotarsi, impressio ligamenti collateralis medialis, status et forma (ordered)  : present, prominent tuberculum, conspicuously convex caudomedially (0);  present, moderate eminentia, jugum, or distinct impressio evident (craniocaudal perspective) as medial convexity (1);  present, distinct impressio, a superficial feature not producing medial convexity (2).

Corpus tibiotarsi, crista fibularis, situs proximodistalis (unordered)  : proximal, crista fibularis entirely limited to proximal one-fourth of corpus tibiotarsi (0);  subproximal, crista fibularis entirely or largely limited to proximal one-third of corpus tibiotarsi (1);  subdistal, crista fibularis extending over majority of proximal one-half of corpus tibiotarsi (2);  distal, crista fibularis entirely or largely limited to intermediate one-third of corpus tibiotarsi (3).

Corpus tibiotarsi, facies cranialis, sulcus extensorius, pars distalis, situs relative to axis majoris corporis (ordered)  : distinctly medial (0);  approximately co-aligned (1);  distinctly lateral (2).

Corpus tibiotarsi et/aut extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, lineae m. fibularis (peronei), tuberculum retinaculi m. fibularis (peronei), status et forma (unordered)  : absent, at most indicated by linea aut jugum (0);  present, a moderately prominent tuberculum aut eminentia (1);  present, a prominent cristula (2).
Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, condylus lateralis, situs marginalis condyli relative to margo lateralis corpus tibiotarsi (ordered)  : distinctly lateral (0);  coplanar (1);  distinctly medial (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, condylus lateralis, breadth relative to condylus medialis (ordered)  : narrow, former distinctly less wide than latter (0);  of approximately equal width (1);  broad, former distinctly wider than latter (2).
Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, condylus medialis relative to condylus lateralis tibiotarsi, forma sensu distal extent (ordered)  : distinctly distal (0);  subequal (1);  distinctly proximal (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, facies cranialis, condyli medialis et lateralis, distinct departure in parallel from axis majoris tibiotarsi, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, laterad (1);  present, mediad (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, incisura intercondylaris, breadth relative to that of facies cranialis tibiotarsi (ordered)  : broad, approximately one-third of width of facies cranialis tibiotarsi (0);  narrow, less than one-third of width of facies cranialis tibiotarsi (1);  obsolete, condylae essentially unseparated cranially (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, facies cranialis, incisura intercondylaris (distal perspective), proximodistal depth relative to lateromedial width (at cranial extremities of condylae), forma (ordered)  : short---former distinctly less than one-half of latter, typically sulci caudalis et cranialis of comparable depths (0);  intermediate---former between one-half and equality of latter (1);  long---former at least as great as latter (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, facies cranialis, incisura intercondylaris, area intercondylaris, forma lateromedialis (ordered)  : fossa of variable depth, in most taxa not prominent in regio lateral to condylus medialis (0);  sulcus extending between condylae but narrowed and more shallow laterally through infilling by basis lateralis retinaculum (1);  obsolete or narrow sulcus extending and of uniform width between condylae (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, facies cranialis, incisura intercondylaris, area intercondylaris, status et forma circumcondylaris (ordered)  : distally delimiting pila transversa intercondylaris (new term) comparatively prominent distally, virtually occluding (craniocaudal perspective) incisura intercondylaris distally (0);  distally delimiting pila transversa intercondylaris (new term) comparatively recessed distally, but accommodating approximately one-half of distal depth (craniocaudal perspective) of incisura intercondylaris (1);  absent, incisura uninterrupted, continuous around extremitas distalis tibiotarsi (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, facies cranialis, incisura intercondylaris, area intercondylaris, comparative (craniocaudal) depth (ordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, moderately deep (1);  present, exceptionally deep, distinctly deeper than more-distal pila transversa intercondylaris (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, incisura intercondylaris, area intercondylaris, impressio ligamenti intercondylaris, forma et situs (unordered)  : comparatively central, essentially encompassed within area intercondylaris (0);  comparatively medial, delimiting bifurcate, medial invaginationes on facies lateralis of condylus medialis (1);  profoundly medial, manifesting a distinct excavatio in facies lateralis of condylus medialis (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, impressio et sulcus capitis tibiale m. fibularis (peronei) brevis, forma profunda et proximodistalis (unordered)  : depressio et sulcus shallow, indistinctly delimited (0);  depressio moderately deep, distinctly delimited, sulcus shallow, poorly defined (1);  depressio deep, distinctly delimited, sulcus raised, well distinguished, infrequently refined to margines of retinaculum or osseous canalis (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, trochlea cartilaginis tibialis, cristae trochleares, bilateral symmetry of margines medialis et lateralis, status et forma (unordered)  : symmetrical, margines trochleares essentially proximodistally oriented (0);  symmetrical, margines trochleares approximately equally convergent by ``proximal tapering'' or opposing slope toward axis majoris corporis (1);  asymmetrical, margo trochlearis medialis displaced distolateralis (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, trochlea cartilaginis tibialis, margo proximalis trochlearis, vertices proximomedialis et proximolateralis (new terms), forma sensu relative proximal extents (unordered)  : medial distinctly less than lateral (0);  approximately equal (1);  medial extremity distinctly proximad to lateral, often with either or both termina subtubercular (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, facies cranialis, pons supratendineus definitivum, status  : absent, constraint of tendines (at least among included Neornithes) typically imposed by retinaculum ligamentosus (0);  present (1);  State 2 (2).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, facies cranialis (sulcus extensorius), pons supratendineus, canalis extensorius, situs lateromedialis (ordered)  : medial (0);  mesial (1);  lateral (2);  noncomparable by absence of vestigia of pons et/aut canalis (ratites) (3).

Extremitas distalis tibiotarsi, facies cranialis, pons supratendineus, canalis extensorius, ostium distomedialis, orientation relative to condylus medialis et incisura intercondylaris (unordered)  : directly toward incisura intercondylaris, typically ostium extending across lateromedial expanse of incisura (0);  laterad to facies lateralis of condylus medialis or obliquely through incisura intercondylaris (1);  essentially toward condylus medialis proprius (2);  noncomparable by absence of pons (ratites, Psittaciformes, Strigiformes, some Caprimulgiformes) (3).
Caput fibulae, facies articularis tibialis, margo (terminalis) proximalis (lateral perspective), forma (ordered)  : convex (0);  sharply linear (1);  distinctly concave (2).
Caput fibulae, facies articularis tibialis, forma (ordered)  : distinctly, variably deeply concave (0);  essentially planar (1);  distinctly convex (2).

Caput fibulae, fovea (sulcus) m. poplitea, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete, surface flat (0);  present, sulcus shallow, covering less than two- thirds the width of corpus fibulae (1);  present, sulcus variably deep, covering more than two-thirds the width of corpus fibulae (2).

Corpus fibulae, pars proximalis, axis (majoris) proximodistalis fibulae, caudal departure from parallelism with axis (majoris) proximodistalis tibiotarsi, status et forma (ordered)  : absent, os fibula virtually parallel to axis majoris tibiotarsi throughout length, including extremitas proximalis (0);  present, moderate (1);  present, pronounced, typically delimiting (lateral perspective) a fissuriform foramen between elements proximally (2).

Corpus fibulae, tuberculum insertii m. iliofibularis, situs proximodistalis relative to crista fibularis tibiotarsi (ordered)  : opposite (lateral) to terminus proximalis cristae (0);  opposite (lateral) to pars intermedia cristae, typically approximately centered (1);  opposite (lateral) to terminus distalis cristae (2);  noncomparable by obsolescence of tuberculum (Caprimulgiformes) (3).

Ossa metatarsalia et trochleae metatarsalia propriae, numerus modalis (ordered)  : four, retaining ossa metatarsalia et trochleae metatarsalia I--IV (0);  three, retaining ossa metatarsalia et trochleae metatarsalia II--IV (1);  two, complete, retaining ossa metatarsalia et trochleae metatarsalia III (tertius) et IV (quartus), with os metatarsale II (secundi) distally truncated approximately distal one-fifth corpus and trochlea lost or vestigial) (2);  State 3 (3).

Os metatarsale II (secundum) aut III (tertium), facies dorsalis, tuberculum insertii m. tibialis cranialis, status, forma et situs (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, distinct tuberculum, on approximate midpoint of facies dorsalis (1);  present, distinct subtabulate eminentia, on pars proximalis of facies dorsalis (2);  present, indistinct tuberositates or jugulae, on pars proximalis of facies dorsalis (3).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, area intercotylaris, fovea menisci lateralis, status et forma (unordered)  : absent or obsolete, area intercotylaris subplanar (0);  present, moderately deep, subelliptical (1);  present, exceptionally deep (2).
Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus ligamentosus, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete (0);  present, shallow (1);  present, deep (2).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, cotyla lateralis, crista cotylaris lateralis (new term), forma sensu relative proximal elevation distinctly greater than cotyla medialis (ordered)  : distinctly less (0);  subequal (1);  distinctly greater (2).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, cotylae lateralis et medialis (dorsal perspective), relative proximal elevation (ordered)  : cotyla lateralis distinctly distal to cotyla medialis (0);  cotyla lateralis subequal to cotyla medialis (1);  cotyla lateralis distinctly proximal to cotyla medialis (2).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, cotylae lateralis et medialis, rima cotylarum, sectio dorsalis, distinct diminishment and distal displacement, effecting dorsal slant of cotylae, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, approximately symmetrical (1);  present, margo dorsalis cotylae lateralis obsolete (2).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, fossa parahypotarsalis medialis, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or indistinct, area without marked departure from general curvature of element (0);  present, small to moderately deep (1);  present, broad and deep, often manifesting distinct triangular terminus of impressio origii m. flexor hallucis brevis (2).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, fossa infracotylaris dorsalis (aut fossa extensorius), tuberositas (area tuberculata tendinis) insertii m. tibialis cranialis, forma (ordered)  : obsolete or small, subcircular tuberositas (0);  moderately elevated, tumulus aut area tuberculata tendinis (1);  prominent jugum, typically angling toward facies medialis corporis (2).

Extremitas proximalis tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, fossa infracotylaris dorsalis, translucentia infracotylaris medialis (new term), status et situs (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, latus lateralis fossae (1);  present, latus medialis fossae (2).

Hypotarsus, length relative to width (ordered)  : length distinctly greater than width (0);  length subequal to width (1);  length distinctly less than width (2);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (3).

Hypotarsus, cristae hypotarsalia (i.e., lateralis, intermediae, medialis, if present), approximate mean proximodistal length relative to mean for fossa parahypotarsalia lateralis et/aut medialis, forma (ordered)  : at least majority of latter (0);  approximately one-half of latter (1);  significantly less than one-half of latter, termini proximoplantares extremely truncate (2);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Strigiformes) (3).

Hypotarsus, crista lateralis hypotarsi, plantar prominence relative to adjacent surfaces of hypotarsus (including internum hypotarsi), status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, extension plantad to basis hypotarsi modest or intermediate (1);  present, extension plantad to basis hypotarsi substantial (2);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (3).

Hypotarsus, crista medialis hypotarsi, plantar extension relative to adjacent surfaces of hypo- tarsus, status (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, crista moderately plantar to basis hypotarsi (1);  present, crista substantially plantar to basis hypotarsi (2);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (3).

Hypotarsus, canales et/aut sulci hypotarsi--- ``tendinal passage 2'' of Strauch (1978) or ``midmedial canal'' of Stallcup (1954  : 6)---canalis tendinis insertii m. flexor perforatus digiti II (Vanden Berge and Storer 1995 (0);  8), status et forma modalis (unordered) (1);  absent, indiscernable or shallow sulcus (2);  present, deep, majority-delimited sulcus or canalis (3);  present, conjoined with tendinal passage 4 of Strauch (1978), i.e., with canalis tendinis m. fibularis longus (4);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (5).

Hypotarsus, canales et/aut sulci hypotarsi--- ``tendinal passage 6'' of Strauch (1978) or ``posteromedial canal'' of Stallcup (1954  : 6)---canalis tendinis insertii m. flexor perforans et perforatus digiti III (Vanden Berge and Storer 1995 (0);  8)---status et forma modalis (unordered) (1);  absent, indiscernable or shallow sulcus (2);  present, deep, majority-delimited sulcus or canalis (3);  present, conjoined partly or completely with tendinal passages 1--5 of Strauch (1978), i.e., with two or more other canales tendinorum mm. flexores (4);  noncomparable (palaeognathous Neornithes, Dromornithidae) (5).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, margines medialis (interna) et lateralis (externa), relative dorsal prominence (ordered)  : medial distinctly less prominent than lateral (0);  medial and lateral essentially equally prominent (1);  medial distinctly more prominent than lateral, especially proximally (2).

Corpus tarsometatarsi (ossa metatarsalia II-- IV), facies dorsalis, foramina (fenestrae) intertarsometatarsalia lateralis et medialis (new terms), forma (unordered)  : small, limited to pars proximalis metatarsalia as small foramina parahypotarsalia (new term) that entail variable degrees of internal and dorsal obstruction (0);  medium, in some foramen medialis is twice the size of lateral counterpart and bounded medially by narrow, columnar os metatarsale IV (1);  large, fenestrae extending majority of lengths of bordering ossa metatarsalia, foramina vascularia proximalia enclosed within termina proximales fenestralia as partitioned (medialis) or common (lateralis) ostia (2).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, processus calcaris, status definitivum (typically adult males) et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, singular at basis, afurcate distally (1);  present, two or more separately based processes (2).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies dorsalis, sulcus extensorius, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or present, shallow to approximate midpoint, diminishing distad, thereby effecting distal extension of fossa infracotylaris dorsalis (0);  present, and delimited moderately well by both cristulae subcutaneae lateralis et medialis (new term), and typically extending distad the majority of length of corpus tarsometatarsi (1);  present, deep to cavernous, both cristulae subcutaneae lateralis et medialis (new terms) bounding cavitas extensorius (new term), and typically extending distad virtually the entirety of corpus tarsometatarsi (2).

Corpus tarsometatarsi, facies plantaris, sulcus flexorius (plantar perspective), status et forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete, medial narrowing and decreased depth imposed either by (i) convex facies plantaris or (ii) enlarged crista medioplantaris (0);  present, moderately distinct (1);  present, deep (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, foramen vasculare distale, status (ordered)  : absent, among Neornithes related to absence of distal, delimiting pons (0);  present and complete, situated at variably proximodistal positions between ossa metatarsalia III et IV, and possessing both ostia foraminis dorsalis et plantaris (1);  present but occluded, situated distally between ossa metatarsalia III et IV, and lacking ostium foraminis plantaris (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, foramen vasculare distale (dorsal perspective), dorsoplantar orientation and proximodistal positions of ostia distalis et proximalis (respectively) for canalis interosseus (intertrochlearis) tendineus distalis and foramen vascularia propria, forma (unordered)  : only ostia proximalis of canalis dorsalis visible (0);  ostia moderately separated proximodistad and both visible in dorsal perspective (1);  ostia considerably separated proximodistad and exposed in dorsal perspective (2);  noncomparable (Casuariidae, Sphenisciformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, foramen vasculare distale (plantar perspective), ostium foraminis plantaris (new term), forma (unordered)  : not continued distad by distinct sulcus intermetatarsalis to incisura intertrochlearis lateralis (0);  continued distad by distinct sulcus intermetatarsalis to incisura intertrochlearis lateralis (1);  emerging well distad, within distinct sulcus intermetatarsalis (2);  noncomparable (Palaeognathidae exclusive of Tinamiformes, Sphenisciformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, canalis aut sulcus interosseus (intertrochlearis) tendineus distalis (foramen tendinis m. extensor brevis digiti IV), forma dorsalis (ordered)  : foramen continued distad by dorsoventrally exposed sulcus tendineus, including taxa lacking foramen distale (0);  foramen continued distad by complete canalis tendineus (1);  foramen continued distad (obliquely, proximo- dorsal to distoplantar) by ventrally exposed sulcus tendineus (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochleae accessoriae group I (i.e., primarily or solely involving trochlea metatarsi I, with secondary implications for trochleae II et IV), trochlea accessoria (Sehnenhalter) metatarsi I (primus), status et forma (ordered)  : absent, associated with anisodactyly (0);  present, moderately developed and limited to os metatarsi I, functionally associated with rudimentary propamprodactyly (1);  present, well developed and accompanied by changes in trochleae metatarsalia II et IV, functionally associated with pamprodactyly proprius (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi II, sulcus trochlearis (new term), especially facies dorsalis, status (unordered)  : absent or obsolete, latter manifested by plantar segment or truncated sulcus on facies medialis trochlearis (0);  present, essentially complete rudimentum aut vestigium, exceptionally shallow and variably defined (1);  present, distinct and virtually circumcentrally positioned throughout (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi II (secundi), facies lateralis trochlearis, foveae ligamentorum collateralium, status et forma sensu depth and width relative to that of associated trochlea (ordered)  : present, prominent fovea (0);  present, variable, shallow to moderately distinct depressio (1);  essentially absent (2);  noncomparable by absence or modification of trochlea (Struthio, Psittaciformes) (3).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi III, dorsoplantar position relative to (i) those of trochleae metatarsalia II et IV and (ii) that of corpus tarsometatarsi at midpoint (ordered)  : comparable, subparallel (0);  moderately elevated dorsally, subequal to that of corpus (1);  prominently elevated dorsally, distinctly greater than that of corpus and trochleae metatarsalia II et IV almost in articulation plantad to trochlea metatarsale III (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi (secundi) II, eminentia (medio)plantaris (new terms), status et forma (unordered)  : obsolete or indistinctly differentiated, including taxa having obliquely formed trochlea or effect of simple torsion or intratrochlear slant (0);  present, variably and subsymmetrically developed (1);  present, conspicuously enlarged (2);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (3).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsi IV (quarti), eminentia (latero)plantaris (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent or aspect wholly or largely the result of differential positions of rimae trochleares (0);  present and moderately developed (1);  present and conspicuously enlarged (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, trochlea metatarsale II, prominent distomedial extent (relative to trochleae metatarsalia III--IV), defining by linear prominence a distinct, asymmetrical angulus with margo medialis tarsometatarsi (ordered)  : absent (0);  present (1);  present, extremely developed, with angulus medialis occupied by proximally articulating, elongated os metatarsale I having relatively enlarged trochlea. Proximodistal characteristics relating trochleae tarsometatarsalia (2).

Extremitas distalis tarsometatarsi, os metatarsale II (secundum), trochlea metatarsi, ventral torsion (rotation) of facies medialis trochlearis about axis proximodistalis of corpus tarsometatarsi (in cluding distal extension through trochlea metatarsi III), status (ordered)  : absent or limited to conformity with widespread, modest dorsal convexity of trochleae (0);  present, moderate, trochlea oblique with respect to corpus (1);  present, pronounced, trochlea subperpendicular with respect to corpus (2);  noncomparable (Struthionidae) (3).

Ossa digitorum pedis, numerus digitorum cum phalanges (ordered)  : five (0);  four (1);  three (tridactyly), hallux lacking (2);  two (didactyly), hallux et digitus secundus (with associated os metacarpalis I et trochlea digiti II) absent (3).
Digiti II--IV pedis, forma sensu relative total lengths (ordered)  : digitus III > digitus II > digitus IV (0);  digitus III > digitus IV > digitus II (1);  digitus IV > digitus III > digitus II (2).

Digitus I pedis (hallux), forma sensu robustness and length relative to that of other digiti pedis (ordered)  : present, functional, comparable in proportion to other digiti pedis (0);  vestigial, phalanges short and feeble (1);  absent (2).
Digitus II (secundus) pedis, phalanges digiti (including digitus ungualis), status et numerus modalis (ordered)  : present, four (0);  present, three (1);  absent, zero (2).

Digitus II (secundus) pedis, phalanx proximalis, basis phalangis, cotyla articularis lateralis, facies lateralis, distinct but variably extensive cavitas articularis interphalangealis (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, moderately deep (1);  present, deep, extensive (2).

Digitus III (tertius) pedis, phalanx proximalis, length relative to that of corpus tarsometatarsi (ordered)  : former distinctly less than one-third of latter (0);  former approximately one-third of latter (1);  former distinctly greater than one-third of latter (2).

Digitus IV (quartus) pedis, phalanges digiti (including phalanx ungualis), numerus modalis (unordered)  : six (0);  five (1);  four, evidently by synostosis phalangiorum proungualis et ungualis (2);  four, evidently by synostosis phalangiorum (prounguales) intermediae (3).

Digitus IV (quartus) pedis, ordination of lengths of phalanges within homologous digitus, in which phalanges within digitus (lettered proximodistally---`` a,'' ``b,'' ..., ``u'') are sequenced in order of descending length, wherein equalities were resolved by assigning first position to the most-proximal element (unordered)  : a > b > c > d (0);  c > d >{a âˆ¨ b} (1);  a > b > d > c (2);  noncomparable by loss of (presumably proungual) phalanx (Dromaiidae, Dromornithidae) (3).

Digiti II--IV pedis, phalanges proximales et intermediae, capitulum phalangis, fovea ligamentum collateralis, status et forma (ordered)  : indistinct impressiones (0);  moderately deep, distinct fovea (1);  very deep, conspicuous concavitates (2).

Digiti I--IV pedis (especially digitus I), phalanx ungualis (terminalis), basis phalangis, tuberculum flexorium, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or obsolete, facies ventralis ungualis essentially continuous with facies ventralis of basis phalangis (0);  present, tuberculum of intermediate depth, depth composing up to one-half depth of phalanx proprius (1);  present, prominent, tuberculum approximately as deep (dorsoplantad) as phalanx proprius, typically accompanied by substantial, lateromedial angularities (2).

Digiti I--IV pedis, phalanx ungualis (terminalis), basis phalangis, tuberculum flexorium, relatively great proximodistal extent and ventral rugosity, status et proximodistal extent (unordered)  : absent (0);  present (especially digitus I), essentially limited to proximal half (1);  present, extending virtually over entire facies (2).

Digiti II--IV pedis, phalanx ungualis (terminalis), basis et facies dorsolateralis phalangis, sulci aut canali neurovasculariae (bilaterally paired), numerus per latus et forma (unordered)  : one (0);  two, sulci throughout, rami dorsoventrally separated basally and converging distally to unite immediately proximal to apex in lateromedial perspective (1);  two, sulci except where ramus plantaris passes through arcus proximally, both rami uniting distad (2);  noncomparable (Podicipedidae, Phoenicopterygiformes) (3).

Digiti II--IV pedis, phalanges unguales, dorsoventral compression of corpus and spatulate lateromedial conformation of apex, status (unordered)  : absent, apices variably acuminate (0);  present, apices subcircular and blunt, dorsoventral compression of corpus intermediate (1);  present, apices broadly rounded or transversely sublinear (2).

Mm. adductor mandibulae externus, pseudotemporalis superficialis, et pterygoideus, tendo insertii ossificans, status (ordered)  : absent, entirely without ossification (0);  present, ossification limited to m. pseudotemporalis superficialis (1);  present, ossification including both mm. adductor mandibulae externus, pseudotemporalis superficialis et pterygoideus (2).
M. adductor mandibulae externus, pars coronoidea, caput mediale, origo, limitation to paries caudolateralis orbitae, status et situs (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, small (1);  present, large (2).
M. adductor mandibulae externus, pars coronoidea, caput mediale, origo, corpus postorbitalis (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, unipennate (1);  present, multipennate (2).

M. adductor mandibulae externus, pars superficialis, status et situs origii (ordered)  : absent or rudimentary (0);  present, primarily processus postorbitalis (1);  present, processus zygomatica et/aut aponeurosis zygomatica (2).

M. adductor mandibulae externus, pars articularis, caput externa, origo, situs calvarii (ordered)  : extends rostrad on aponeurosis zygomatica to processus postorbitalis and adjacent calvaria (0);  restricted to region of processus zygomatica and proximal portion of aponeuorosis zygomatica (1);  extends caudal to processus zygomatica ventral to fossa musculorum temporalium (2);  noncomparable by absence of caput externus (palaeognathous taxa, Procellariiformes, Apodiformes) (3).
M. adductor mandibulae externus, pars articularis, caput interna, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or vestigial (0);  present, moderately to poorly developed (1);  present, well developed (2).

M. pseudotemporalis superficialis, pars lateralis, caput orbitale (new term), origo, situs (ordered)  : area extends to dorsal half of paries orbitalis (0);  restricted to ventral half of paries orbitalis (1);  substantially reduced or absent (2).

M. pseudotemporalis superficialis, pars lateralis, tendo insertii, relative to tendo insertii m. adductor mandibulae externus (pars coronoidea), situs (unordered)  : adjacent or coincident (0);  caudoventromedial (1);  ventral (2).

M. pseudotemporalis superficialis, pars medialis, status et forma (ordered)  : absent or minute lobus (0);  present, restricted to ventral half of paries orbitalis (1);  present, extending to dorsal half of paries orbitalis (2).

M. pseudotemporalis superficialis, pars medialis, insertio, situs (unordered)  : tendo majoris partis lateralis (0);  adjacent to insertio tendinis majoris (1);  rostral to tendo majoris (2);  noncomparable by absence of pars medialis (3).
M. pseudotemporalis profundus, status et forma (unordered)  : present, moderately to well developed (0);  present, substantially reduced (1);  absent (2).

M. pterygoideus, pars lateralis, caput rostrale, situs insertii including facies lateralis rami mandibulae, status et forma (ordered)  : absent (0);  present (1);  present, in addition to tuberculum m. pterygoidei (processus dorsolateralis) quadrati (2).
M. pterygoideus, pars lateralis, caput caudale, situs origii including septum interorbitalis, status  : absent (0);  present (1);  State 2 (2).

M. pterygoideus, pars lateralis, caput caudale, origo, rostral extent on arcus pterygopalatina (ordered)  : extremitas distalis ossis pterygoidei (0);  junctura pterygopalatina (1);  os palatinum (2);  noncomparable by absence of caput craniale (palaeognathous taxa) (3).

M. pterygoideus, pars lateralis, capita rostrale et caudale, divisio corporis (ordered)  : absent (0);  limited, narrow furrow or overlap between capita (1);  complete, hiatus between capita (2);  noncomparable (palaeognathous taxa) (3).

M. hyoglossus obliquus, status et forma (unordered)  : present, massive, occupying entirety of spatium subparaglossorum (new term) and encompassing by vagina m. hypoglossorum (new term) on terminus rostralis of os basihyale (0);  present, rudimentary (1);  absent (2).

M. cucullaris capitis, pars clavicularis (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, simple, comprising only deep layer inserting along margo cranialis sterni or extremitas omalis claviculae (1);  present, complex, comprising both (variably developed) superficial layer supportive of the ingluvies (crop)---part of tunica adventia---and deeper counterpart inserting along much of scapus claviculae (2).

M. pectoralis, pars propatagialis, status (unordered)  : absent or vestigial (0);  present, only moderately developed, limited to corpus at articulatio acrocoracoclavicularis sensu stricto (1);  present, robust, comprising tendo clavicularis (new term) at articulatio acrocoracoclavicularis sensu stricto (2).
M. rhomboideus superficialis, status (ordered)  : present (0);  rudimentary or vestigial (1);  absent (2).

Mm. rhomboideus superficialis et profundus, corpus, relative craniocaudal positions, forma (unordered)  : significant overlap---``semisyntopy'' (0);  adjacent---``paratopy'' (1);  spatium aut hiatus interpartorum---``allotopy.'' (2).
M. latissimus dorsi, pars caudalis, status (ordered)  : present, including corpus (0);  vestigial, comprising aponeurosis or fascia tendinosa (1);  absent entirely (2).

Mm. latissimus dorsi, partes cranialis et caudalis, hiatus partorum m. latissimus dorsi (new term), status et forma (ordered)  : present, hiatus between partes significant (0);  absent, partes essentially continuous (``paratopy'') with margines attached, the conjoined pair termed by some ``m. latissimus dorsi communis'' (1);  absent, partes distinctly overlapping significantly proximal to insertiones (2);  noncomparable by absence of at least one pars (Otididae, Trochilidae, Meropidae) (3).

M. scapulohumeralis caudalis, ambitus distalis (ordered)  : extremitas caudalis (apex) scapulae (0);  proximal (cranial) two-thirds to three-fourths of scapus scapulae (1);  proximal (cranial) one-half or less of scapus scapulae (2).

M. deltoideus, pars propatagialis, corpus, status et magnitudo (ordered)  : present, hypertrophic, typically concealing (dorsal perspective) majority or entirety of underlying m. deltoideus major (0);  present, moderately robust (1);  absent (2).

M. deltoideus, pars propatagialis, pars caudale, tendo brevis, primary configuration, forma (unordered)  : tendo single, width variable, united throughout or partially divided distad into rami proximalis et distalis tendinis brevis, the latter bifucation often largely on retinaculum or facies craniodorsalis m. extensor (meta)carpi radialis (0);  tendines (distalis et proximalis) doubled and subparallel throughout common length, tendo distalis partially divided distad (rami proximalis et distalis), but latter typically united proximad (craniad) for majority of length (1);  tendines (distalis et proximalis) doubled, tendo proximalis partially divided distad (rami proximalis et distalis), but typically united proximad (craniad) for majority of length (2);  noncomparable by absence of propatagium (ratites) or strongly apomorphic m. deltoideus propatagialis (Spheniscidae, Apodiformes) (3).

M. deltoideus, pars major, caput craniale, status (ordered)  : absent, undifferentiated, musculus evidently unicapitate (0);  present, partially partitioned, typically progressing proximodistad (1);  present, complete (2);  noncomparable (Apterygidae) (3).

M. deltoideus, pars minor, capita dorsale (externa) et ventrale (interna), status (unordered)  : both capita dorsale et ventrale present (0);  caput dorsale alone present or (rarely) with caput ventrale vestigialis (1);  caput ventrale alone present or with caput dorsale vestigialis (2);  noncomparable (Rheidae, Apterygidae) (3).

M. biceps brachii, (especially) corpus et tendo insertii, relative lengths (ordered)  : corpus distinctly greater than tendo (or fibers) insertii (0);  corpus approximately equal to tendo insertii (1);  corpus distinctly shorter than tendo insertii (2).

M. biceps brachii, capita coracoideum et/aut humerale et tendines insertiorum, divisio(nes), status et forma (ordered)  : capita variably united, tendines insertii variably united by vinculum from corpus to variable extent proximal to bifurcatio (if present) insertiorum ulnare et radiale---tendo capitis coracoideum more frequently undergoing bifurcatio tendinis than that of (0);  capita variably united, tendines insertii distinct throughout but enclosed within loose common vagina fasciata (1);  capita et tendines fully separate (2);  noncomparable by absence of musculus or caput (Spheniscidae, Balaeniceps, Mesitornithidae, Heliornithidae, Apodidae) (3).
M. expansor secundariorum, status modalis (ordered)  : present (0);  vestigial or rudimentary (1);  absent (2).

M. brachialis, impressio insertii, situs (unordered)  : extremitas proximalis ulnae, facies ventrocranialis (0);  extremitates proximales ulnae et radii, facies ventrocranialis et cranioventralis, respectively (1);  extremitas proximalis radii, facies cranioventralis (2).
M. pronator superficialis (sublimus), status et forma (ordered)  : well developed (0);  distinctly reduced (1);  absent (2).

M. pronator superficialis, numerus capitorum origii et forma corporis (unordered)  : one, ellipsoidal (0);  one, but corpus bilobate (1);  two, augmented by caput accessoria proximalis (new term) uniting proximoventrad with basis corporis m. pronator superficialis proprius (2);  noncomparable (Spheniscidae) (3).

Mm. pronatores superficialis et profundus, corpora, distal union as single functional unit including tendo insertii, status et forma (unordered)  : absent (0);  present, proximal (1);  present, distal (2);  noncomparable (Apterygidae, Spheniscidae) (3).

M. flexor digitorum superficialis (sublimus), corpus and (to lesser extent) associated ligamentum humerocarpale, status (ordered)  : well developed (0);  vestigial, tendo or fascia only (1);  absent (2).

M. flexor digitorum profundus, origo, caput accessoria superficiale (new term), status et forma origii (ordered)  : absent, single caput origii distoventral to insertio m. brachialis (0);  present, primary caput augmented ventrad by caput accessoria superficiale (new term), arising by fibers (interposed between origiones mm. pronatores, and merging with corpora mm. flexores digitorum superficialis et profundus (1);  present, primary caput augmented ventrad by caput accessoria superficiale (new term), arising by tendo humeralis (interposed between origiones mm. pronatores, and merging with corpora mm. flexores digitorum superficialis et profundus (2);  noncomparable (Spheniscidae) (3).

M. flexor digitorum profundus, tendo insertii phalangis digiti alulae (new term), status natalis et definitivum (unordered)  : present, (presumptively) all ages (0);  present, natalis only (1);  absent, throughout ontogeny and adulthood (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Spheniscidae) (3).

M. extensor (meta)carpi ulnaris, tendo insertii, situs (unordered)  : os metacarpale (majus) II, typically on margo spatii intermetacarpalis, often on processus intermetacarpalis (0);  os carpi ulnare, synostosis intermetacarpalis proximalis, including processus pisiformis aut extensorius (1);  os metacarpale (minus) III, facies dorsalis, proximal to spatium intermetacarpale (2);  noncomparable (Spheniscidae) (3).

M. flexor (meta)carpi ulnaris, status et situs (ordered)  : hypertrophied, including extension of corpus to os metacarpale, sine retinaculum (0);  well developed, comprising corpus et tendo, cum retinaculum (1);  vestigial, comprising tendo only (2).

M. extensor longus alulae, capita, numerus et situs (unordered)  : two, comprising both capita radiale et ulnare present (0);  one, caput radiale only (1);  one, caput ulnare only (2);  noncomparable by absence of digitus alularis (Dromaiidae, Casuariidae, Spheniscidae) (3).
M. extensor longus digiti (indicus) majoris, pars distalis (caput distale), status modalis (ordered)  : present (0);  vestigial (1);  absent (2);  noncomparable (ratites, Spheniscidae) (3).

M. ulnometacarpalis dorsalis, status (unordered)  : present, bicapitate, comprising both capita dorsale et ventrale (0);  present, unicapitate, provisionally representing caput dorsale (1);  absent (2).

M. ulnometacarpalis ventralis, status et forma (ordered)  : present, substantial, length at least one-half that of ulna (0);  present, moderate, length less one-half that of ulna (1);  vestigial or absent (2).

M. interosseus dorsalis (volaris), corpus, status et magnitudo (ordered)  : present, corpus at least of equal size to m. interosseus ventralis (0);  present, corpus distinctly smaller than that of m. interosseus ventralis (1);  vestigial or absent, typically associated with reduction of spatium intermetacarpale (2).
M. abductor digiti majoris (indicus), status (ordered)  : present, including corpus (0);  vestigial, principally or wholly tendinous (1);  absent (2).

M. abductor digiti majoris (indicus), caput accessoriale (new term), status (ordered)  : absent (0);  present, weakly differentiated but distinctly augmented (1);  present, strongly developed, especially proximoventrally (2).

Musculi membri pelvici, ossificatio(nes) tendinorum insertii, status et musculi (ordered)  : absent or limited to sectio distalis tendinis m. flexor digitorum longus (0);  present, throughout tendines mm. flexores digitorum longus et/aut hallucis longus (1);  present, extensive in several or most musculi pelvici (2).
M. iliotibialis lateralis, pars acetabularis, status et forma (ordered)  : present, corpus (0);  present, aponeurosis (1);  absent (2).
M. iliotibialis lateralis, pars postacetabularis, status et forma (ordered)  : present, robust (0);  present, reduced (1);  absent (2).
Ansa m. iliofibularis, status et numerus ligamentorum (unordered)  : present, two or three (0);  present, single (1);  absent (2).
M. iliofemoralis externus, status et forma (ordered)  : present, well developed (0);  present, diminutive (1);  absent (2).
